[{"date": "20210202160300", "headline": "Amazon.com Announces Financial Results and CEO Transition", "summary": "SEATTLE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN) today announced financial results for its fourth quarter ended December 31, 2020. Operating cash flow increased 72% to $66.1 billion for the trailing twelve months, compared with $38.5 billion for the trailing twelve months ended December 31, 2019. Free cash flow increased to $31.0 billion for the trailing twelve months, compared with $25.8 billion for the trailing twelve months ended December 31, 2019. Free cash flow less principal repayments of finance leases and financing obligations increased to $20.3 billion for the trailing twelve months, compared with $16.2 billion for the trailing twelve months ended December 31, 2019. Free cash flow less equipment finance leases and principal repayments of all other finance leases and financing obligations increased to $21.4 billion for the trailing twelve months, compared with $12.5 billion for the trailing twelve months ended December 31, 2019. Common shares outstanding plus shares underlying stock-based awards totaled 518 million on December 31, 2020, compared with 512 million one year ago. Fourth Quarter 2020 Net sales increased 44% to $125.6 billion in the fourth quarter, compared with $87.4 billion in fourth quarter 2019. Excluding the $1.7 billion favorable impact from year-over-year changes in foreign exchange rates throughout the quarter, net sales increased 42% compared with fourth quarter 2019. Operating income increased to $6.9 billion in the fourth quarter, compared with operating income of $3.9 billion in fourth quarter 2019. Net income increased to $7.2 billion in the fourth quarter, or $14.09 per diluted share, compared with net income of $3.3 billion, or $6.47 per diluted share, in fourth quarter 2019. Full Year 2020 Net sales increased 38% to $386.1 billion, compared with $280.5 billion in 2019. Excluding the $1.4 billion favorable impact from year-over-year changes in foreign exchange rates throughout the year, net sales increased 37% compared with 2019. Operating income increased to $22.9 billion, compared with operating income of $14.5 billion in 2019. Net income increased to $21.3 billion, or $41.83 per diluted share, compared with net income of $11.6 billion, or $23.01 per diluted share, in 2019. Amazon is also announcing today that Jeff Bezos will transition to the role of Executive Chair in the third quarter of 2021 and Andy Jassy will become Chief Executive Officer at that time. \u201cAmazon is what it is because of invention. We do crazy things together and then make them normal. We pioneered customer reviews, 1-Click, personalized recommendations, Prime\u2019s insanely-fast shipping, Just Walk Out shopping, the Climate Pledge, Kindle, Alexa, marketplace, infrastructure cloud computing, Career Choice, and much more,\u201d said Jeff Bezos, Amazon founder and CEO. \u201cIf you do it right, a few years after a surprising invention, the new thing has become normal. People yawn. That yawn is the greatest compliment an inventor can receive. When you look at our financial results, what you\u2019re actually seeing are the long-run cumulative results of invention. Right now I see Amazon at its most inventive ever, making it an optimal time for this transition.\u201d Highlights Investing in Employee Safety and Providing Good Jobs Amazon is working to ensure that its front-line employees receive vaccines as soon as possible. The company is closely monitoring the availability of COVID-19 vaccines worldwide, advocating on behalf of its employees, and working in partnership with global medical experts, governments, and health providers to accelerate vaccination programs. Amazon continues to ramp up its in-house COVID-19 testing program as part of its investments to keep front-line employees safe. More than 700 employees are now tested every hour, and Amazon\u2019s dedicated COVID-19 labs have processed more than one million tests globally. Amazon recognized front-line employees by investing $2.5 billion in additional pay in 2020. This is on top of the company\u2019s industry-leading starting wage of at least $15 an hour, which is double the federal minimum wage. All full-time employees also receive healthcare and full benefits from their first day on the job. Amazon received the Lee Anderson Veteran and Military Spouse Employment Award for excellence in hiring, training, and retaining veterans, transitioning service members, and military spouses. Amazon employs more than 40,000 veterans and military spouses across the U.S. Supporting Communities Amazon announced a new Housing Equity Fund, a $2 billion commitment to preserve and create over 20,000 affordable housing units in Washington State\u2019s Puget Sound region; Arlington, Virginia; and Nashville, Tennessee. The Fund provides below-market loans and grants to housing partners, public agencies, and minority-led organizations. It started with initial investments totaling $567 million for 2,300 affordable apartment homes. Amazon announced plans to provide free cloud skills training to 29 million people around the world by 2025, as it continues to invest in upskilling and career development for its customers and employees. The AWS-designed programs range from self-paced online courses to intensive upskilling programs that help participants build new careers in the technology industry. This expands on Amazon\u2019s Upskilling 2025 initiative, a $700 million commitment to upskill 100,000 U.S. employees by helping them transition into high-demand, high-paying jobs, as well as Career Choice, a program that pre-pays tuition for employees looking to earn degrees in in-demand fields. Amazon unveiled plans for the second phase of construction for its headquarters in Arlington, Virginia. Amazon plans to build 2.8 million square feet of office space as part of its commitment to create 25,000 jobs and invest $2.5 billion in the community over the next decade. The project will create more than 2.5 acres of open space for the local community, run on renewable energy, and bring retail and other services to local residents. Amazon in the UK expanded its long-standing partnership with nonprofit Magic Breakfast to reach more children at risk of hunger. In addition to being a significant financial donor, Amazon distributed more than two million free, healthy breakfasts to children studying at home due to COVID-19 who would normally receive these meals at school. In the UK, Amazon delivered more than six million COVID-19 testing kits free of charge, in support of the government\u2019s COVID-19 testing program. Globally, Amazon has donated over 65,000 Echo devices, Fire Tablets, and other devices throughout the COVID-19 crisis to organizations that support frontline workers and first responders, and to help keep patients, students, and communities impacted by the pandemic connected. In support of World AIDS Day and Giving Tuesday, Amazon announced the limited-edition (echo)RED. Available in the all-new spherical design, (echo)RED offers premium sound and a built-in smart home hub. Amazon will donate $10 of every (echo)RED sale to support (RED)\u2019s fight against AIDS and COVID-19 in sub-Saharan Africa. Customers can also donate to (RED)\u2019s fight against the COVID-19 and HIV/AIDS pandemics on any Alexa-enabled device by simply saying, \u201cAlexa, donate to RED.\u201d Ring announced a new program with Habitat for Humanity, a global nonprofit that shares Ring\u2019s commitment to help make homes and neighborhoods safer, including a donation of $1 million worth of Ring Video Doorbells to provide Habitat homeowners with added peace of mind. Protecting the Planet Amazon became the world\u2019s largest corporate purchaser of renewable energy, taking another step in its journey to be net-zero carbon by 2040. The company is investing in the building of 26 new utility-scale wind and solar projects in Australia, France, Germany, Italy, South Africa, Sweden, the UK, and the U.S., bringing Amazon\u2019s total number of renewable energy projects to 127. Amazon\u2019s investments will supply its operations with more than 18,000 gigawatt hours (GWh) of renewable energy annually, helping put the company on a path to achieve 100% renewable energy by 2025, five years ahead of the initial 2030 target. Thirty-one organizations have signed The Climate Pledge, a commitment co-founded by Amazon and Global Optimism to achieve net-zero carbon by 2040. Twenty of those companies signed The Climate Pledge last quarter: Atos, Boom Supersonic, Brooks, Cabify, Canary Wharf Group, Coca-Cola European Partners, ERM, Groupe SEB France, Harbour Air, Henkel, ITV, JetBlue, Microsoft, Neste, Rivian, Rubicon, Signify, Uber, Unilever, and Vaude. Amazon joined the Food Loss and Waste 2030 Champions group, an effort by the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency and Department of Agriculture to reduce food loss and waste within U.S. company operations by 50% by 2030. Amazon expanded Climate Pledge Friendly, a program to help customers discover and shop for more sustainable products, in five countries across Europe. The program launched with over 40,000 Climate Pledge Friendly products in France, Germany, Italy, Spain, and the UK. Empowering Small and Medium-Sized Businesses The 2020 holiday season was the best ever for independent businesses selling on Amazon\u2014nearly all of which are small and medium-sized businesses\u2014with worldwide sales growing over 50% compared to the same period in 2019. Sellers surpassed $4.8 billion in worldwide sales from Black Friday through Cyber Monday, growing about 60% from the previous year. During the holiday season as a whole, small and medium-sized businesses in the U.S. sold nearly one billion products in Amazon\u2019s store. Since the start of the COVID-19 pandemic, Amazon has incurred more than $5 billion in operational costs on behalf of independent businesses selling in Amazon\u2019s store, and expects to invest billions more through 2021. In 2020, Amazon increased square footage across its fulfillment and logistics network by 50%, dedicated 60% of fulfillment center capacity to seller products, and postponed annual selling fee adjustments until June 2021. As part of the AWS Activate program, Amazon provided more than $1 billion in AWS credits during 2020 to help early stage startups launch their businesses and accelerate their growth. With this help, startups are using scalable, reliable, and secure cloud services like compute, storage, database, analytics, Internet of Things, machine learning, and many others from AWS to scale their businesses. [{"date": "20210210190000", "headline": "AWS Teams with the National Hockey League to be the Official Cloud Infrastructure Provider of the NHL", "summary": "SEATTLE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Today, Amazon Web Services, Inc. (AWS), an Amazon.com, Inc. company (NASDAQ: AMZN), announced that it has entered into an agreement with the National Hockey League (NHL) to become the Official Cloud, Artificial Intelligence, and Machine Learning Infrastructure Provider of the NHL. By tapping into the breadth and depth of AWS services, the NHL will be able to automate video processing and content delivery in the cloud and leverage its Puck and Player Tracking (PPT) System, which runs on AWS cloud infrastructure, to better capture the details of game play for its fans, teams, and media partners. The NHL will also build an enterprise video platform on AWS to aggregate video, data, and related applications into one central repository that will enable easier search and retrieval of archival video footage, give broadcasters instant access to NHL content for syndication and licensing, and facilitate the creation and delivery of new in-game analyses, predictions, and video highlights to enhance mobile, online, and broadcast experiences. The NHL will work with the Amazon Machine Learning Solutions Lab to apply AWS\u2019s deep portfolio of machine learning services to game video and official NHL data \u2013 including data from the NHL\u2019s new Puck and Player Tracking (PPT) System and from the NHL\u2019s Hockey Information & Tracking System (HITS) real-time stats \u2013 to develop and share advanced game analytics and metrics that take fans deeper into the game. In addition, the NHL intends to use AWS Elemental Media Services to develop and manage a cloud-based HD and 4K video content delivery system that will provide a complete view of the game to NHL officials, coaches, players, and fans. Powered by AWS, the system will encode, process, store, and transmit game footage from a series of new camera angles to provide continuous video feeds that capture plays and events outside the field of view of traditional broadcast cameras. In addition, by leveraging AWS analytics services including Amazon Kinesis (AWS\u2019s service for easily collecting, processing, and analyzing video and data streams in real time) and machine learning services such as Amazon SageMaker (AWS\u2019s service that enables data scientists and developers to build, train, and deploy machine learning models quickly), the NHL will be able to audit its feeds to broadcast partners in real time. This capability will enable the NHL to create a smart monitoring system that detects and automatically fixes potential feed issues, offering fans a seamless in-game experience across viewing platforms. \u201cAWS\u2019s state-of-the-art technology and services will provide us with capabilities to deliver analytics and insights that highlight the speed and skill of our game to drive deeper fan engagement,\u201d said NHL Commissioner Gary Bettman. \u201cAWS is unmatched in the portfolio of cloud services that it delivers, including computer vision and machine learning, and we intend to leverage them across the board to provide advanced analysis to our teams, officials, and media partners faster than ever before. We\u2019re thrilled to have AWS join the NHL\u2019s family of blue-chip technology partners as we continue our focus on innovation and building the most advanced technology solutions in sports.\u201d \u201cAWS is working with the world\u2019s most renowned sports leagues to better understand their data and innovate upon it using our deep portfolio of machine learning services,\u201d said Andy Jassy, CEO of Amazon Web Services, Inc. \u201cWith this agreement, AWS will provide our industry-leading cloud technology to the NHL, becoming a foundational partner in delivering NHL performance analytics and collaborating to enhance the way people experience hockey by providing more engaging content and greater insights to fans. AWS\u2019s breadth and depth of services, our proven experience in sports analytics, and our relentless focus on innovation give the NHL the ability to bring an entirely new perspective and layer of fan involvement to the game of hockey.\u201d The NHL will be introducing its new analytics using AWS services and technology throughout the upcoming season. For more information, please visit www.aws.amazon.com/sports. PressReleases: [{"date": "2021-02-17 03:01:00", "headline": "20 NEW COMPANIES SPANNING AGRICULTURE, RENEWABLE ENERGY, HOSPITALITY, FINANCIAL SERVICES, CREATIVE SERVICES, TECHNOLOGY, FORESTRY, AND THE CONSTRUCTION SECTOR JOIN THE CLIMATE PLEDGE", "description": "SEATTLE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--TODAY, AMAZON AND GLOBAL OPTIMISM ANNOUNCED THAT 20 NEW SIGNATORIES AROUND THE WORLD HAVE JOINED THE CLIMATE PLEDGE: ACCIONA, COLIS PRIVE, CRANSWICK PLC, DAABON, FREE NOW, GENERATION INVESTMENT MANAGEMENT, GREEN BRITAIN GROUP, HOTELBEDS, IBM, ICELAND FOODS, INTERFACE, JOHNSON CONTROLS, MIIR, \u00d8RSTED, PROSEGUR CASH, PROSEGUR COMPA\u00d1IA DE SEGURIDAD, SLALOM, S4CAPITAL, UPM, AND VANDERLANDE. IMPLEMENT DECARBONIZATION STRATEGIES IN LINE WITH THE PARIS AGREEMENT THROUGH REAL BUSINESS CHANGES AND INNOVATIONS, INCLUDING EFFICIENCY IMPROVEMENTS, RENEWABLE ENERGY, MATERIALS REDUCTIONS, AND OTHER CARBON EMISSION ELIMINATION STRATEGIES. TOGETHER, WE CAN USE OUR COLLECTIVE SCALE TO HELP DECARBONIZE THE ECONOMY AND PRESERVE EARTH FOR FUTURE GENERATIONS.\u201d AMAZON AND GLOBAL OPTIMISM WELCOME THESE NEW SIGNATORIES AND THANK THEM FOR THEIR COMMITMENT: ACCIONA ACCIONA (ANA.MC) IS A GLOBAL LEADER IN SUSTAINABLE SOLUTIONS, RANGING FROM RENEWABLE ENERGY TO WATER TREATMENT PLANTS, MASS TRANSIT SYSTEMS, AND OTHER RESILIENT, LOW-CARBON SOCIAL INFRASTRUCTURE. IN LINE WITH THE LATEST CLIMATE SCIENCE, ACCIONA IS COMMITTED TO REDUCING ITS DIRECT AND ENERGY CONSUMPTION EMISSIONS BY 60% BETWEEN 2017 AND 2030, AS WELL AS A 47% DECREASE IN VALUE CHAIN EMISSIONS, CONSISTENT WITH THE PARIS CLIMATE AGREEMENT\u2019S MOST AMBITIOUS GOAL OF LIMITING GLOBAL WARMING TO NO MORE THAN 1.5\u00baC ABOVE PRE-INDUSTRIAL LEVELS. WE\u2019RE THRILLED TO BE THE FIRST PARCEL DELIVERY COMPANY TO JOIN THE CLIMATE PLEDGE, AND WE LOOK FORWARD TO WORKING WITH AMAZON, GLOBAL OPTIMISM, AND OTHER SIGNATORIES TO BECOME CARBON-NEUTRAL BY 2040.\u201d CRANSWICK PLC AS ONE OF THE LARGEST FOOD PRODUCERS IN BRITAIN, CRANSWICK PLC IS COMMITTED TO INTEGRATING SUSTAINABLE PRACTICES THROUGHOUT ITS OPERATIONS, FROM FARMING TO SOURCING AND PRODUCING. TO ACHIEVE THESE AMBITIOUS GOALS, THE COMPANY IS INVESTING MILLIONS IN SUPPORTING DRIVERS TO SWITCH TO ELECTRIC VEHICLES AND PROMOTING ELECTRIC OPTIONS AMONG CUSTOMERS. \u201cIT IS OUR AMBITION AND OUR COMMITMENT TO THE CITIES WHERE WE OPERATE TO DO OUR BIT TO REDUCE EMISSIONS AND MAKE IT EASIER FOR PEOPLE TO MAKE ENVIRONMENTALLY FRIENDLY CHOICES,\u201d SAID MARC BERG, FREE NOW CEO. \u201cWE ARE PROUD OF THE PROGRESS WE\u2019VE ALREADY MADE TOWARD OUR COMMITMENTS, BUT WE CAN GO MUCH FURTHER. And Shopify is my selection for Stock of the Decade.", "source": "The Motley Fool"}, {"date": "20210220081000", "headline": "Better Buy: Amazon.com vs. Walmart", "summary": "Does Walmart's competitive response to Amazon.com make it a better investment?", "source": "The Motley Fool"}, {"date": "20210220195100", "headline": "20 novas empresas de diversos setores, incluindo agricultura, energia renov\u00e1vel, hospitalidade, servi\u00e7os financeiros, servi\u00e7os criativos, tecnologia, silvicultura e setor de constru\u00e7\u00e3o juntam-se ao The Climate Pledge", "summary": "SEATTLE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Amazon e a Global Optimism anunciaram hoje que 20 novos signat\u00e1rios ao redor do mundo juntaram-se ao The Climate Pledge: ACCIONA, Colis Prive, Cranswick plc, Daabon, FREE NOW, Generation Investment Management, Green Britain Group, Hotelbeds, IBM, Iceland Foods, Interface, Johnson Controls, MiiR, \u00d8rsted, Prosegur Cash, Prosegur Compa\u00f1ia de Seguridad, Slalom, S4Capital, UPM, e Vanderlande. Com o acr\u00e9scimo destes novos signat\u00e1rios, 53 empresas de 18 setores e 12 pa\u00edses, se comprometeram a trabalhar em dire\u00e7\u00e3o a zero emiss\u00f5es de carbono em seus neg\u00f3cios mundiais \u2014 agregando o potencial de reduzir significativamente as emiss\u00f5es corporativas de carbono. Cada organiza\u00e7\u00e3o est\u00e1 em um est\u00e1gio diferente nesta jornada para emiss\u00f5es l\u00edquidas de carbono zero, mas todas as 53 signat\u00e1rias est\u00e3o comprometidas em alcan\u00e7ar o ambicioso objetivo do The Climate Pledge de atender o Acordo de Paris 10 anos antes. Os signat\u00e1rios do The Climate Pledge concordam em: Medir e informar regularmente as emiss\u00f5es de gases de efeito estufa. Implementar estrat\u00e9gias de descarboniza\u00e7\u00e3o alinhadas ao Acordo de Paris por meio de mudan\u00e7as e inova\u00e7\u00f5es reais nos neg\u00f3cios, incluindo melhorias de efici\u00eancia, energia renov\u00e1vel, redu\u00e7\u00e3o de materiais e outras estrat\u00e9gias de elimina\u00e7\u00e3o de emiss\u00f5es de carbono. Neutralizar as emiss\u00f5es restantes com compensa\u00e7\u00f5es adicionais, quantific\u00e1veis, reais, permanentes e socialmente ben\u00e9ficas para atingir zero emiss\u00f5es anuais de carbono at\u00e9 2040 \u2014 uma d\u00e9cada antes do objetivo para 2050 do Acordo de Paris. Os 20 novos signat\u00e1rios representam diversos setores econ\u00f4micos, desde energia a agricultura e servi\u00e7os financeiros. Cada empresa est\u00e1 implementando mudan\u00e7as de alto impacto, baseadas na ci\u00eancia, para ajudar a descarbonizar a cadeia de suprimentos, incluindo inova\u00e7\u00e3o em economia circular, lan\u00e7amentos de solu\u00e7\u00f5es de energia limpa e mobilizando cadeias de suprimentos para alcan\u00e7ar l\u00edquido zero at\u00e9 2040. \u201cEnquanto os EUA d\u00e3o um importante passo na luta contra a mudan\u00e7a clim\u00e1tica voltando a fazer parte do Acordo de Paris nesta semana, estou empolgado para dar as boas-vindas \u00e0s 20 novas empresas ao The Climate Pledge, que desejam caminhar ainda mais r\u00e1pido\u201d, disse Jeff Bezos, fundador e diretor executivo da Amazon. \u201cA Amazon cofundou o The Climate Pledge em 2019 para incentivar empresas a alcan\u00e7arem os objetivos do Acordo de Paris 10 anos antes do prazo, e estamos vendo um impulso incr\u00edvel por tr\u00e1s do compromisso com 53 empresas de 18 setores de 12 pa\u00edses que j\u00e1 aderiram. Juntos, podemos utilizar nossa escala coletiva para ajudar a descarbonizar a economia e preservar a Terra para futuras gera\u00e7\u00f5es\u201d. A Amazon e a Global Optimism d\u00e3o as boas-vindas a estes novos signat\u00e1rios e agradece por seus comprometimentos: ACCIONA A ACCIONA (ANA.MC) \u00e9 uma l\u00edder global em solu\u00e7\u00f5es sustent\u00e1veis, desde energia renov\u00e1vel a esta\u00e7\u00f5es de tratamento de \u00e1gua, sistemas de tr\u00e2nsito em massa, e outras infraestruturas socias resilientes e de baixo carbono. A atenua\u00e7\u00e3o da mudan\u00e7a clim\u00e1tica e seus efeitos est\u00e1 no cora\u00e7\u00e3o da l\u00f3gica de neg\u00f3cios da empresa. A ACCIONA \u00e9 a empresa de servi\u00e7os p\u00fablicos mais ecol\u00f3gica do mundo, operando apenas com energia renov\u00e1vel, e uma inovadora em todos os campos de infraestrutura sustent\u00e1vel. A ACCIONA se tornou neutra em carbono em 2016, a primeira empresa nos setores de energia e infraestrutura a alcan\u00e7ar isso. Em sintonia com a mais recente ci\u00eancia clim\u00e1tica, a ACCIONA est\u00e1 comprometida a reduzir suas emiss\u00f5es diretas e de consumo de energia em 60% entre 2017 e 2030, como tamb\u00e9m uma redu\u00e7\u00e3o de 47% em emiss\u00f5es de cadeia de suprimentos, consistente com o objetivo mais ambicioso do Acordo de Paris em limitar o aquecimento global em n\u00e3o mais que 1,5\u00ba C em rela\u00e7\u00e3o aos n\u00edveis pr\u00e9-industriais. As metas de redu\u00e7\u00e3o de emiss\u00f5es da ACCIONA foram certificadas pela iniciativa Metas Baseadas na Ci\u00eancia (Science Based Targets initiative, SBTi). \u201cPrecisamos urgentemente que mais empresas se comprometam com caminhos regenerativos de crescimento de carbono l\u00edquido zero para evitar a amea\u00e7a da mudan\u00e7a clim\u00e1tica catastr\u00f3fica e irrevers\u00edvel\u201d, afirmou Jos\u00e9 Manuel Entrecanales, presidente e diretor executivo da ACCIONA. \u201cEspero que mais empresas inscrevam-se no The Climate Pledge para mostrar \u00e0 massa cr\u00edtica de empresas que realmente precisamos mudar o comportamento de emiss\u00f5es de carbono\u201d. Colis Prive L\u00edder em opera\u00e7\u00f5es de \u00faltima milha, a Colis Prive \u00e9 especializada em entrega domiciliar e retransmiss\u00e3o, coletando pacotes de comerciantes eletr\u00f4nicos e realizando a entrega final. Desde sua funda\u00e7\u00e3o em 1993, a empresa continua a se orgulhar em buscar melhorias consistentes em seus servi\u00e7os de entrega. Com quatro centros na Fran\u00e7a e uma rede de 3.500 associados de entregas, a Colis Prive j\u00e1 entregou mais de 63 milh\u00f5es de pacotes. Conhecendo o significativo impacto de suas opera\u00e7\u00f5es no meio ambiente, a Colis Prive est\u00e1 comprometida a limitar suas emiss\u00f5es de g\u00e1s de efeito estufa (greenhouse gas, GHG), com um foco especial em reduzir aquelas resultantes de entregas do \u00faltimo quil\u00f4metro. A empresa tamb\u00e9m est\u00e1 dobrando sua efici\u00eancia energ\u00e9tica gra\u00e7as \u00e0 implementa\u00e7\u00e3o do padr\u00e3o energ\u00e9tico ISO 50001, focado em fornecer a empresas globais uma estrutura precisa para criar um sistema de gest\u00e3o operacional e de energia sustent\u00e1vel para reduzir continuamente seu uso de energia. \u201cNa Colis Prive estamos comprometidos em administrar uma empresa respons\u00e1vel em nossas opera\u00e7\u00f5es, e isto inclui priorizar pr\u00e1ticas sustent\u00e1veis\u201d, disse Fr\u00e9d\u00e9ric Pons, cofundador e presidente da Colis Prive. \u201cFazer parte deste projeto global confirma nosso compromisso com a Amazon para adaptar, aprender, medir e aperfei\u00e7oar nossos processos. Estamos empolgados por sermos a primeira empresa de entrega de pacotes a juntar-se ao The Climate Pledge, e esperamos trabalhar com a Amazon, a Global Optimism e outros signat\u00e1rios para nos tornarmos neutros em carbono at\u00e9 2040\u201d. Cranswick plc Como um dos maiores produtores de alimentos no Gr\u00e3-Bretanha, a Cranswick plc est\u00e1 comprometida a integrar pr\u00e1ticas sustent\u00e1veis em suas opera\u00e7\u00f5es, da agricultura, abastecimento e produ\u00e7\u00e3o. Com sua estrat\u00e9gia de sustentabilidade Second Nature no centro, a empresa est\u00e1 focada em descarbonizar suas fazendas e reduzir significativamente a perda de alimentos e desperd\u00edcio geral de recursos na sua cadeia de suprimentos e produ\u00e7\u00e3o, tudo at\u00e9 2040. Nos dois \u00faltimos anos a Cranswick plc obteve progressos significativos, incluindo a mudan\u00e7a para energia 100% renov\u00e1vel fornecida pela rede, reduzindo o desperd\u00edcio de alimentos comest\u00edveis para 0,4% da produ\u00e7\u00e3o total, e removendo mais de 1.200 toneladas de pl\u00e1stico de suas opera\u00e7\u00f5es. \u201cNa Cranswick estamos comprometidos a administrar uma empresa respons\u00e1vel em nossas opera\u00e7\u00f5es, e isto inclui priorizar pr\u00e1ticas sustent\u00e1veis\u201d, afirmou Adam Couch, diretor executivo da Cranswick plc. \u201cQueremos fazer parte da solu\u00e7\u00e3o para a mudan\u00e7a clim\u00e1tica, e ajudar a inspirar mudan\u00e7as positivas na cadeia de suprimentos mais ampla. Acreditamos que fazer parte do The Climate Pledge refor\u00e7a nosso comprometimento com a sustentabilidade e ter\u00e1 um papel cr\u00edtico nos permitindo ser esta influ\u00eancia positiva\u201d. Daabon Com sede em Santa Marta, Col\u00f4mbia, o Daabon Group \u00e9 um l\u00edder na produ\u00e7\u00e3o e processamento de culturas org\u00e2nicas como bananas, abacate Hass, caf\u00e9 e \u00f3leo de palma na Am\u00e9rica do Sul. A empresa tem trabalhado extensivamente para administrar e desenvolver seus processos de produ\u00e7\u00e3o de uma maneira sustent\u00e1vel. A Daabon foi a primeira empresa de \u00f3leo de palma org\u00e2nico a ser certificada como sustent\u00e1vel pela Rainforest Alliance e RSPO na Am\u00e9rica Latina. A empresa desenvolveu um processo inovador que captura o g\u00e1s metano produzido pelo res\u00edduo org\u00e2nico a ser utilizado como combust\u00edvel para energia. \u201cNa Daabon nossa ambi\u00e7\u00e3o \u00e9 administrar um neg\u00f3cio sustent\u00e1vel e socialmente respons\u00e1vel\u201d, afirmou Manuel Juli\u00e1n D\u00e1vila, diretor executivo do Daabon Group. \u201cEstamos orgulhosos do que nossa equipe tem alcan\u00e7ado para enfrentar desafios ambientais, mas podemos ir muito mais longe. Estamos convencidos que ao nos unir ao The Climate Pledge, faremos progresso significativo para alcan\u00e7ar carbono l\u00edquido zero at\u00e9 2040\u201d. FREE NOW Atendendo mais de 50 milh\u00f5es de passageiros em mais de 150 pa\u00edses na Europa, a FREE NOW reconhece a necessidade urgente de transportes mais compat\u00edveis com o meio ambiente. A empresa j\u00e1 est\u00e1 comprometida a mudar 50% dos seus ve\u00edculos FREE NOW na Europa para emiss\u00f5es zero at\u00e9 2025 e tornar todas as viagens de passageiros livres de emiss\u00f5es at\u00e9 2030. Para alcan\u00e7ar estes objetivos ambiciosos, a empresa est\u00e1 investindo milh\u00f5es apoiando motoristas pra que mudem para ve\u00edculos el\u00e9tricos e promovendo op\u00e7\u00f5es el\u00e9tricas entre clientes. \u201c\u00c9 nossa ambi\u00e7\u00e3o e nosso comprometimento com as cidades onde operamos para fazer nossa parte na redu\u00e7\u00e3o de emiss\u00f5es e facilitar que as pessoas fa\u00e7am escolhas ambientalmente amig\u00e1veis\u201d, disse Marc Berg, diretor executivo da FREE NOW. \u201cEstamos orgulhosos do progresso que j\u00e1 fizemos em prol dos nossos compromissos, mas podemos ir mais longe. Estamos entusiasmados por nos juntarmos a outras empresas orientadas para a sustentabilidade com o The Climate Pledge\u201d. Generation Investment Management A Generation Investment Management (Generation), fundada em 2004, est\u00e1 desempenhando um papel integral no desenvolvimento de investimentos sustent\u00e1veis e na demonstra\u00e7\u00e3o dos benef\u00edcios a longo prazo desta abordagem. A empresa integra fatores de sustentabilidade em suas decis\u00f5es de investimentos, envolvimento com empresas do portf\u00f3lio, e uma ampla gama de iniciativas de defesa e impacto. A Generation est\u00e1 comprometida a alinhar os portf\u00f3lios de investimentos com zero emiss\u00f5es de gases de efeito estufa (GHG) at\u00e9 2040 ou antes, de acordo com as metas do Acordo de Paris para mudan\u00e7a clim\u00e1tica. A empresa est\u00e1 ajudando a liderar esfor\u00e7os no setor de gest\u00e3o de investimentos, para construir uma coaliz\u00e3o de gestores dispostos a assumir um compromisso coletivo para a meta de zero emiss\u00f5es l\u00edquidas. Em dezembro de 2020, isto levou ao lan\u00e7amento da iniciativa Net Zero Asset Managers no quinto anivers\u00e1rio da conclus\u00e3o do Acordo de Paris. A iniciativa foi lan\u00e7ada com 30 gestores de ativos como signat\u00e1rios fundadores, respons\u00e1veis por mais de US$ 9 trilh\u00f5es de ativos sob gest\u00e3o. \u201cAcreditamos que a mudan\u00e7a clim\u00e1tica demanda a\u00e7\u00e3o urgente e universal\u201d, disse David Blood, s\u00f3cio s\u00eanior da Generation. \u201cAinda h\u00e1 tempo de evitar que as temperaturas aumentem para n\u00edveis realmente catastr\u00f3ficos, mas \u00e9 necess\u00e1rio um grande esfor\u00e7o para reduzir as emiss\u00f5es globais nesta d\u00e9cada. Estamos com companheiros signat\u00e1rios do The Climate Pledge em um compromisso para l\u00edquido zero at\u00e9 2040. Ao aderir ao The Climate Pledge, refor\u00e7amos nosso compromisso com a sustentabilidade e, com prazer, nos associamos a uma comunidade que compartilhar\u00e1 conhecimento, ideias e melhores pr\u00e1ticas\u201d. Green Britain Group O Green Britain Group existe na busca da sustentabilidade atrav\u00e9s do neg\u00f3cio. Suas principais opera\u00e7\u00f5es s\u00e3o a Ecotricity, a primeira empresa de energia ecol\u00f3gica do mundo, e o clube de futebol Forest Green Rovers (FGR), reconhecido pelo corpo governante global, FIFA, como o mais ecol\u00f3gico no jogo. Fundado pelo empres\u00e1rio Dr. Dale Vince OBE, o Green Britain Group est\u00e1 focado na abordagem de quest\u00f5es ambientais e de sustentabilidade em tr\u00eas \u00e1reas: energia, transporte e alimenta\u00e7\u00e3o. A Ecotricity atualmente abastece mais de 200.000 resid\u00eancias e empresas com eletricidade 100% renov\u00e1vel e g\u00e1s neutro em carbono, a partir de sua ampla rede no Reino Unido de parques e\u00f3licos e solares. O FGR se tornou o primeiro clube esportivo a receber a certifica\u00e7\u00e3o neutro em carbono pelas Na\u00e7\u00f5es Unidas em 2017 ,e \u00e9 reconhecido como o clube de futebol mais ecol\u00f3gico do mundo. O FGR recentemente recebeu permiss\u00e3o de planejamento para a constru\u00e7\u00e3o do Eco Park, um novo est\u00e1dio pioneiro, totalmente de madeira, projetado para mostrar o que \u00e9 poss\u00edvel na busca pela sustentabilidade. \u201cQuando eu comecei a Ecotricity em 1995, fomos a primeira empresa de energia ecol\u00f3gica do mundo, e em 25 anos, as coisas percorreram um longo caminho \u2014 mas ainda h\u00e1 muito que precisamos fazer para termos um pa\u00eds sem emiss\u00f5es de carbono\u201d, disse o Dr. Dale Vince OBE, fundador do Green Britain Group. \u201cTer uma vida mais ecol\u00f3gica n\u00e3o \u00e9 abrir m\u00e3o de coisas \u2014 s\u00f3 precisamos fazer as coisas que fazemos, mas de forma diferente. Estamos ansiosos para trabalhar com a Amazon, a Global Optimism e outros no The Climate Pledge. Empresas de todos os tamanhos precisam colaborar e encontrar novas maneiras de tratar a mudan\u00e7a clim\u00e1tica, e temos que levar todos nesta jornada conosco\u201d. Hotelbeds A Hotelbeds est\u00e1 dobrando seus comprometimentos ambientais para ajudar a liderar o foco no turismo sustent\u00e1vel. Cerficada neutra em carbono pela Carbon Footprint Ltd. pelo terceiro ano consecutivo, a empresa, que trabalha juntamente com o Conselho Global de Turismo Sustent\u00e1vel (Global Sustainable Tourism Council, GSTC), j\u00e1 est\u00e1 fazendo grandes avan\u00e7os priorizando a redu\u00e7\u00e3o de carbono em suas opera\u00e7\u00f5es. Em 2020 a empresa lan\u00e7ou o The Green Hotels Program, com o objetivo de acelerar a transi\u00e7\u00e3o do setor de turismo para a sustentabilidade. A Hotelbeds possui mais de 15.000 propriedades no seu portf\u00f3lio certificadas como sustent\u00e1veis. \u201cComo os l\u00edderes em nosso setor, temos uma clara responsabilidade em demonstrar \u00e0s nossas partes interessadas que operamos um modelo de neg\u00f3cios respons\u00e1vel e transparente, e que levamos muito a s\u00e9rio o impacto ambiental que causamos\u201d, disse Joan Vil\u00e0, presidente executivo da Hotelbeds. \u201cReconhecemos nossa responsabilidade cr\u00edtica para proteger nosso planeta e os destinos onde operamos, e acreditamos que \u00e9 a hora de dobrar nosso investimento para criar um futuro mais sustent\u00e1vel. Estamos empolgados para continuar este trabalho como parte do The Climate Pledge\u201d. Iceland Foods A Iceland Foods busca desenvolver um neg\u00f3cio crescente, lucrativo e respons\u00e1vel que faz a coisa certa para seus clientes, parceiros, comunidades e o planeta. A empresa possui um longo hist\u00f3rico de cuidados com meio ambiente e por exercer pr\u00e1ticas sustent\u00e1veis, alinhando suas ambi\u00e7\u00f5es com os Objetivos de Desenvolvimento Sustent\u00e1vel das Na\u00e7\u00f5es Unidas. Ahora, 53 organizaciones han firmado The Climate Pledge y est\u00e1n enviando un mensaje importante de que habr\u00e1 un r\u00e1pido crecimiento de la demanda de productos y servicios que ayuden a reducir las emisiones de carbono. Para obtener m\u00e1s informaci\u00f3n, visite www.theclimatepledge.com. Computer vision brings the speed and accuracy needed to identify defects consistently; however, implementing traditional computer vision solutions can be complex. Building computer vision models from scratch requires large amounts of carefully labeled images for each element of the manufacturing process. Then, teams of data scientists need to build, train, deploy, monitor, and fine tune computer vision models to analyze each individual phase of the product inspection process. (AWS), an Amazon.com company (NASDAQ:AMZN), today announced the launch of a second full region in Japan, the AWS Asia Pacific (Osaka) Region. For more information on AWS\u2019s global infrastructure, go to: https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/global-infrastructure/. \u201cWe launched the AWS Osaka Local Region to help select customers run specific workloads in western Japan. Since then, customers have asked AWS to launch a second full region with multiple Availability Zones and broad service selection in the country, and today we're excited to deliver on those requests,\u201d said Peter DeSantis, Senior Vice President of Global Infrastructure and Customer Support, AWS. \u201cTogether with the AWS Asia Pacific (Tokyo) Region, the AWS Asia Pacific (Osaka) Region provides customers with even lower latency to end users in Japan, as well as the ability to architect workloads across multiple Availability Zones and multiple regions in Japan for even greater fault tolerance, resiliency, and availability.\u201d \u201cCongratulations on the opening of AWS Osaka Region. The government has adopted a \"cloud-by-default\u201d principle and basic policy prioritizing the use of cloud services, and we welcome AWS as a part of our services,\u201d said Takuya Hirai, Member of the House of Representatives and Minister of State for Digital Transformation. \u201cThe mission of the Japan Digital Transformation Agency, scheduled to be established in September 2021, is to think about how systems should be run on the cloud in order to promote standardization and interoperability, which are necessary for both national and local governments to promote digitalization. In cooperation with various companies, including AWS, we will do our utmost to promote the digitalization of Japan.\u201d AWS Regions are comprised of Availability Zones, which place infrastructure in separate and distinct geographic locations with enough distance to significantly reduce the risk of a single event impacting customers\u2019 business continuity, yet near enough to provide low latency for high availability applications. Each Availability Zone has independent power, cooling, and physical security and is connected via redundant, ultra-low-latency networks. AWS customers focused on high availability can design their applications to run in multiple Availability Zones and across multiple regions to achieve even greater fault tolerance. Additionally, Japanese customers, from startups to enterprises and the public sector, will have additional infrastructure to leverage advanced technologies including compute, storage, analytics, database, machine learning, Internet of Things (IoT), mobile services, and more to drive innovation. The launch of a second AWS Region in Japan provides customers with even lower latency across the country and supports disaster recovery applications for business continuity. Customers and AWS Partners welcome the new AWS Asia Pacific (Osaka) Region Millions of active customers use AWS each month in over 190 countries around the world, and hundreds of thousands of active customers use AWS services in Japan each month to accelerate innovation, increase agility, and drive cost savings. Organizations across Japan moving their mission-critical workloads to the cloud include customers such as Bellsystem24, Gibraltar Life Insurance, KDDI, Kindai University, Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, Nabtesco Corporation, NRI, NTT East, OGIS-RI CO. ltd., Prudential Life Insurance, Sony Bank, Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, Tokio Marine & Nichido Fire Insurance, and many more. Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), whose business operations include commercial banks, trust banks, securities, and credit cards, adopted a cloud-first strategy and announced its full AWS deployment in 2017. \u201cWe have been making steady progress in IT architecture transformation and digitalization by leveraging AWS to build new systems,\u201d said Hiroki Kameda, Managing Corporate Executive and Group CIO of MUFG. \u201cAWS enabled us to build a big data platform for all our bank and group data so that we can use it flexibly, streamline administrative processes such as tremendous data entry work using AI, migrate a part of a market risk management system, and conduct applied research in more advanced AI algorithms and other new technologies. We reduced large costs by migrating and building a new system on AWS compared to on-premises. PressReleases: [{"date": "2021-03-02 09:00:00", "headline": "PGA TOUR SELECTS AWS AS ITS OFFICIAL CLOUD PROVIDER", "description": "SEATTLE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--TODAY, AMAZON WEB SERVICES, INC. (AWS), AN AMAZON.COM, INC. COMPANY (NASDAQ: AMZN), ANNOUNCED THAT THE PGA TOUR (TOUR) HAS SELECTED AWS AS THE OFFICIAL CLOUD PROVIDER OF THE TOUR. AWS AND THE TOUR ARE PARTNERING TO TRANSFORM THE WAY GOLF CONTENT IS CREATED, DISTRIBUTED, AND EXPERIENCED, BRINGING FANS CLOSER TO THE ACTION ON THE COURSE WHILE ALSO HELPING THE TOUR STREAMLINE ITS MEDIA OPERATIONS. THE TOUR WILL USE AWS MACHINE LEARNING, STORAGE, COMPUTE, ANALYTICS, DATABASE, AND MEDIA SERVICES TO QUICKLY PROCESS AND DISTRIBUTE VIDEO FOOTAGE FROM EACH GOLF TOURNAMENT, WHILE ALSO GIVING FANS NEW WAYS TO ENGAGE WITH TOUR CONTENT. THE TOUR CAPTURES HUNDREDS OF HOURS OF RAW FOOTAGE AT EACH TOURNAMENT AND WILL LEVERAGE AWS TO RAPIDLY TRANSFORM THIS CONTENT INTO EXCITING NEW DIGITAL EXPERIENCES THAT PROVIDE FANS WITH A MORE COMPLETE AND PERSONALIZED EXPERIENCE ACROSS TOUR COMPETITION. FOR INSTANCE, EVERY SHOT LIVE, AN OVER-THE-TOP (OTT) STREAMING PLATFORM POWERED BY AWS, WILL GIVE VIEWERS LIVE ACCESS TO EVERY SHOT FROM EVERY PLAYER IN A TOURNAMENT. DURING A TOURNAMENT LIKE THE PLAYERS CHAMPIONSHIP, FANS WILL HAVE ACCESS TO MORE THAN 32,000 SHOTS FROM A STARTING FIELD OF 144 GOLFERS. THE FANS CAN CHOOSE TO FOLLOW ANY PLAYER IN REAL TIME AND EXPERIENCE EACH SHOT VIA STREAMING CONTENT. IN ADDITION, AWS WILL POWER TOURCAST, AN EVOLUTION OF THE TOUR LEADERBOARD THAT WILL GIVE FANS VIDEO GAME-LIKE CONTROL OF THE GOLF VIEWING EXPERIENCE, ALLOWING THEM TO CHANGE THEIR VIEWING PERSPECTIVE WITH ALTERNATIVE CAMERA ANGLES, NAVIGATE AROUND THE COURSE, VIEW SPEED ROUNDS, AND DISPLAY PLAYER AND SHOT STATS ON DEMAND. THE TOUR WILL ALSO USE AWS MEDIA SERVICES TO MAKE IT FASTER TO DELIVER VIDEO CONTENT FOR TELEVISED EVENT COVERAGE AND OTT STREAMING FOR ONLINE VIEWERS. TO ACCOMPLISH THIS, THE TOUR WILL USE AWS TO SIMULTANEOUSLY PROCESS AND DISTRIBUTE OTT CONTENT, FORMATTING IT FOR RELIABLE VIEWING OVER A VARIETY OF DELIVERY PLATFORMS AND DEVICES, INCLUDING SMARTPHONES AND TABLETS. USING AWS MEDIA SERVICES, THE TOUR WILL MAKE TOURNAMENT FOOTAGE AVAILABLE GLOBALLY TO AUTHENTICATED BROADCASTERS, CONTENT SUBSCRIBERS FROM AWS, AND OTHER SOURCES. FANS, TOO, WILL BENEFIT FROM ENHANCED ACCESS TO YEARS OF THIS TAGGED AND ARCHIVED GOLF FOOTAGE AND HIGHLIGHTS THROUGH THE TOUR\u2019S WEB AND MOBILE APPS. TO ROUND OUT THE PARTNERSHIP, AWS WILL BECOME A TRUSTEE OF FIRST TEE, A YOUTH DEVELOPMENT ORGANIZATION SUPPORTED BY THE TOUR THAT REACHES MORE THAN 3.7 MILLION YOUNG PEOPLE ACROSS THE UNITED STATES AND SELECT INTERNATIONAL LOCATIONS EACH YEAR, HELPING THEM BUILD THEIR STRENGTH OF CHARACTER THROUGH THE GAME OF GOLF. AS PART OF WIDE-RANGING SUPPORT FOR FIRST TEE, AWS WILL ASSIST THE ORGANIZATION IN DEVELOPING AN ONLINE COMMUNITY FOR COACHES, PARENTS, AND PARTICIPANTS WHERE THEY CAN ACCESS THE FIRST TEE CURRICULUM AND RESOURCES AND CONNECT WITH PEERS IN THE PROGRAM. \u201cTHIS TRANSFORMATIONAL PARTNERSHIP WITH AWS WILL GIVE OUR FANS THE OPPORTUNITY TO EXPERIENCE THE PGA TOUR LIKE NEVER BEFORE,\u201d SAID PGA TOUR COMMISSIONER JAY MONAHAN. \u201cGROWING AND DIVERSIFYING OUR FAN BASE IS A TOP PRIORITY FOR US, AND THANKS TO THE COLLABORATION AND INNOVATION FROM AWS, WE ARE CREATING MORE WAYS TO EXPERIENCE THE GAME OF GOLF, WHILE PERSONALIZING OUR CONTENT TO ENABLE FANS TO ENGAGE WITH THE TOURNAMENTS AND PLAYERS THEY SUPPORT.\u201d \u201cTHE WORLD\u2019S TOP SPORTS ORGANIZATIONS \u2013 FOR INSTANCE, THE NFL, NHL, FORMULA ONE, NASCAR, BUNDESLIGA, AND NOW THE PGA TOUR \u2013 CONTINUE TO TURN TO AWS TO HELP THEM INNOVATE FOR THEIR FANS AND PLAYERS AT AN UNPRECEDENTED RATE,\u201d SAID ANDY JASSY, CEO OF AMAZON WEB SERVICES, INC. \u201cTHE PARTNERSHIP AND EXPERIENCE WE CREATE WITH THE TOUR WILL BE UNIQUE. UNLIKE OTHER SPORTS, THERE\u2019S MORE THAN ONE BALL IN PLAY ON A GOLF COURSE, WHICH MAKES IT HARDER FOR FANS TO FOLLOW HOW EVERY PLAYER IS PERFORMING. OUR COLLABORATION WITH THE TOUR WILL CHANGE THE WAY THAT FANS WILL BE ABLE TO CONNECT WITH THE SPORT BY GIVING THEM REAL-TIME ACCESS TO VIRTUALLY EVERY MOMENT ON THE COURSE AND LETTING THEM DETERMINE HOW THEY EXPERIENCE THE GAME.\u201d FOR MORE INFORMATION, PLEASE VISIT WWW.AWS.AMAZON.COM/SPORTS. ABOUT AMAZON WEB SERVICES FOR ALMOST 15 YEARS, AMAZON WEB SERVICES HAS BEEN THE WORLD\u2019S MOST COMPREHENSIVE AND BROADLY ADOPTED CLOUD PLATFORM. AWS HAS BEEN CONTINUALLY EXPANDING ITS SERVICES TO SUPPORT VIRTUALLY ANY CLOUD WORKLOAD, AND IT NOW HAS MORE THAN 200 FULLY FEATURED SERVICES FOR COMPUTE, STORAGE, DATABASES, NETWORKING, ANALYTICS, MACHINE LEARNING AND ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI), INTERNET OF THINGS (IOT), MOBILE, SECURITY, HYBRID, VIRTUAL AND AUGMENTED REALITY (VR AND AR), MEDIA, AND APPLICATION DEVELOPMENT, DEPLOYMENT, AND MANAGEMENT FROM 80 AVAILABILITY ZONES (AZS) WITHIN 25 GEOGRAPHIC REGIONS, WITH ANNOUNCED PLANS FOR 15 MORE AVAILABILITY ZONES AND FIVE MORE AWS REGIONS IN AUSTRALIA, INDIA, INDONESIA, SPAIN, AND SWITZERLAND. MEMBERS ON THE PGA TOUR REPRESENT THE WORLD\u2019S BEST PLAYERS, HAILING FROM 29 COUNTRIES AND TERRITORIES (94 MEMBERS ARE FROM OUTSIDE THE UNITED STATES). (AWS), an Amazon.com company (NASDAQ: AMZN), announced new Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) One Zone storage classes that reduce storage costs by 47% compared to existing Amazon EFS storage classes, while delivering the same features and benefits. One Zone storage classes redundantly store data within a single Availability Zone (AZ) and are ideal for customers who want cost-optimized file storage options for workloads and applications that do not require the level of availability and durability offered by regional Amazon EFS storage classes that redundantly store data across multiple geographically separated AZs. With One Zone storage classes for Amazon EFS there are no minimum commitments or up-front fees, and customers pay only for the amount of file system storage used. To get started with One Zone storage classes for Amazon EFS visit http://aws.amazon.com/efs/. Customers use Amazon EFS as a simple, serverless, elastic file system with AWS (and on-premises via AWS Direct Connect or AWS VPN) for a broad range of workloads. Traditionally, Amazon EFS storage classes (EFS Standard and EFS Standard-Infrequent Access) store data across multiple, geographically-separated AZs that comprise an AWS Region to offer the highest level of availability and durability. Customers use Amazon EFS for their business critical applications like SAP and Oracle; however, there are some workloads (e.g. content management, developer applications, etc.) that do not require the multi-AZ availability and durability provided by Amazon EFS\u2019s existing storage classes. As a result, these customers either end up paying for more durability and availability than their applications may require, or customers choose to deploy self-managed file systems for these kinds of workloads (resulting in a higher TCO and more time spent on management). With new One Zone storage classes for Amazon EFS, customers now have the choice of a simple, serverless, fully managed file system that runs in a single AZ, and that costs 47% less than regional Amazon EFS storage classes. One Zone storage classes allow customers to achieve a blended storage price of $0.043/GB-month, while also offering higher availability and durability than self-managed file systems. One Zone storage classes provide these lower costs while delivering the same elasticity and scalability benefits of Amazon EFS Standard and EFS Standard-Infrequent Access, as well as features like lifecycle management, and integration with AWS compute services, including Amazon Elastic Container Service (ECS), Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), AWS Fargate, and AWS Lambda. One Zone storage classes are ideal for developer workloads like build and staging environments, and applications like analytics, simulation, and media transcoding that do not require the highest levels of availability and durability of regional Amazon EFS storage classes. One Zone storage classes are also ideal for storing replicas, secondary copies of data residing on-premises, data that can be easily recreated, and data used by applications with built-in replication and high availability features. One Zone for Amazon EFS offers two storage classes (One Zone and One Zone-Infrequent Access). One Zone file systems are configured with a Lifecycle Management policy of 30 days to automatically and transparently move less frequently used files to the One Zone-Infrequent Access storage class, delivering 92% additional savings on storage costs compared to One Zone storage class. \u201cWhen we set out to build Amazon EFS, we designed it with multi-Availability Zone redundancy to deliver the highest levels of durability and availability. Amazon EFS regional storage classes are designed to provide 99.99% (4 9\u2019s) availability, while One Zone for Amazon EFS is designed to provide 99.9% (3 9\u2019s) availability. For added data protection, Amazon EFS file systems in One Zone storage classes are automatically backed up using AWS Backup, and can be restored to any AZ within a Region, or copied to a different Region. Those who make less than $15 an hour are significantly less likely to say they can afford basic human needs such as shopping for groceries, paying for prescription drugs, or a doctor\u2019s visit. (AWS), an Amazon.com company (NASDAQ:AMZN) and Red Hat, the world\u2019s leading provider of enterprise open source solutions, announced the general availability of Red Hat OpenShift Service on AWS (ROSA), a new managed service available via the AWS Console that makes it easier for Red Hat OpenShift customers to build, scale, and manage containerized applications on AWS. With ROSA, customers can enjoy more simplified Kubernetes cluster creation using the familiar Red Hat OpenShift console, features, and tooling without the burden of manually scaling and managing the underlying infrastructure. ROSA streamlines moving on-premises Red Hat OpenShift workloads to AWS, and offers a tighter integration with other AWS services. ROSA also enables customers to access Red Hat OpenShift with billing and support directly through AWS, delivering the simplicity of a single-vendor experience to customers running Red Hat OpenShift on AWS. There are no up-front investments required to use ROSA, and customers pay only for the container clusters and nodes used. To get started, visit aws.amazon.com/rosa. Containers have proven popular with AWS and Red Hat customers because they increase developer velocity and improve application portability. Currently, AWS offers the broadest range of containers technology in the cloud, including Amazon Elastic Containers Service (ECS) for customers that want the deepest integration with AWS services and Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) for customers that prioritize running Kubernetes. AWS customers that value a fully serverless containers experience can also use AWS Fargate to run containers without having to manage the underlying servers or clusters. Global Fortune 500 businesses, government agencies, and many more organizations use Red Hat OpenShift, Red Hat\u2019s enterprise-ready Kubernetes platform that extends the capabilities of base Kubernetes built for the cloud production stack, to run containerized applications with the same common foundation and tooling in any environment. Many customers have chosen to self-manage Red Hat OpenShift clusters on top of AWS. While the elasticity, scalability, and security of AWS have proven very popular with Red Hat OpenShift customers, self-managing clusters requires added effort and expense, and customers also have to manage two provider relationships for support and billing. These customers have asked for an AWS managed service for Red Hat OpenShift that works seamlessly with other AWS services at scale, and integrates support and billing into the AWS user experience. With ROSA, customers can quickly and easily create Kubernetes clusters using familiar Red Hat OpenShift Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) and tooling, and seamlessly access the full breadth and depth of AWS services \u2013 all from within the AWS console. INDUSTRIAL COMPANIES ARE CONSTANTLY WORKING TO IMPROVE OPERATIONAL EFFICIENCY BY AVOIDING UNPLANNED DOWNTIME DUE TO EQUIPMENT FAILURE. OVER TIME, MANY OF THESE COMPANIES HAVE INVESTED HEAVILY IN PHYSICAL SENSORS, DATA CONNECTIVITY, DATA STORAGE, AND DASHBOARDS TO MONITOR THEIR EQUIPMENT HEALTH AND PERFORMANCE. The post The Final Frontier Will Be a Profitable Frontier appeared first on InvestorPlace.", "source": "InvestorPlace"}, {"date": "20210414211602", "headline": "2 Great Tech Stocks to Buy Now Amid Hot Start to Q1 Earnings", "summary": "Today we explore highly-ranked technology stocks to buy amid the strong start to the first quarter earnings season.", "source": "Zacks Investment Research"}, {"date": "20210415033000", "headline": "New F1 Insights Powered by AWS Will Help FORMULA 1 Fans Make Sense of Split-Second Decisions on the Track", "summary": "SEATTLE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Today, Amazon Web Services (AWS), an Amazon.com, Inc. company (NASDAQ: AMZN), and FORMULA 1 (F1) (NASDAQ: FWONA, FWONK) are introducing six new F1 Insights powered by AWS that will roll out through the 2021 racing season. The new additions mean a total of 18 AWS-powered stats will be available to fans by the end of the season. F1 Insights powered by AWS are real-time racing statistics, displayed as on-screen graphics, that transform the fan experience before, during, and after each race by providing the data and analysis fans need to interpret driver and team race strategy and performance. The first new stat, Braking Performance, will debut at the GRAND PRIX in Italy, April 16-18. The new set of statistics for 2021 will use a range of AWS technologies, including machine learning, to help fans better understand and highlight potential race outcomes and compare their favorite drivers and cars. For more information about AWS and its involvement with F1, including the 12 previously released F1 Insights, please visit: https://aws.amazon.com/f1/. F1 racing is a data-driven sport where much of the thrill for fans comes from poring over statistics before and after a race to gain a deeper understanding of driver and team decisions and cars\u2019 performance on the track. F1 Insights powered by AWS add a new real-time dimension to statistics and place context around race data to help fans better appreciate key moments on the track. More than 300 sensors on each race car generate over 1.1 million data points per second that F1 transmits from the cars to the pit and onto AWS for processing. F1 relies on the breadth and depth of AWS services to stream and analyze that flood of data as it\u2019s generated, and then present it in a meaningful way for TV and online viewers around the world through the F1 Insights. The first F1 Insight to be introduced this season, Braking Performance, shows how a driver\u2019s braking style during a cornering maneuver can deliver an advantage coming out of the corner. When executed well, braking optimizes a car\u2019s speed through the phases of cornering and enables the driver to gain a better position on the track. This stat displays and compares drivers\u2019 braking styles and performance by measuring how closely they approach the apex of a corner before braking. In addition, it will show the key performance metrics that lead to how the car and driver perform together when cornering, such as top speed on approach, speed decrease through braking, the braking power (KWH) utilized, and the immense G-forces drivers undergo while cornering. Braking Performance builds on the existing Corner Analysis statistic, which shows how cars physically perform while cornering. Braking Performance and the other five new F1 Insights powered by AWS (detailed below) will debut as on-screen graphics from April through December this season. Each new stat offers fans more visibility into the split-second action on the track and the decision-making behind the pit wall. Car Exploitation shows fans when F1 drivers are pushing their cars to performance limits in areas like tire traction, braking, acceleration, and maneuvering during key points in a race. The stat reveals the data in real-time by displaying a car\u2019s current performance during a race compared to a theoretical performance limit, and then calculates the time gained or lost per lap as a result. The stat debuts June 11-13 at the FORMULA 1 HEINEKEN GRAND PRIX DU CANADA 2021. Energy Usage provides insights into how the high-tech engines powering F1 cars utilize energy during a race, including when teams unleash energy to overtake another car. The stat demonstrates energy flows through each component of the advanced F1 engine, known as the Power Unit, and shows how much battery energy is left at any given moment in a race. The F1 engine propels a vehicle by using a combination of internal combustion and hybrid systems that recover energy from braking and from the turbo charger. However, there are limits to the Power Unit\u2019s energy storage capacity and the amount of energy that can move through it during each race lap. Race teams track this data to help maximize their car\u2019s performance at key moments in a race, determining when to deploy energy in steady streams to achieve the best lap times or unleash it in focused moments to gain or maintain position when battling another driver. Energy Usage allows fans to see those decisions in real time. The stat debuts July 16-18 at the FORMULA 1 PIRELLI BRITISH GRAND PRIX 2021. Start Analysis displays which driver was the quickest on the pedal and picked the perfect line, as well as which drivers struggled off the starting grid and why. Achieving the perfect start is a core driver skill, and Start Analysis will help fans understand how a driver\u2019s decisions earn or sacrifice an early advantage in the race. The stat debuts September 10-12 at the FORMULA 1 HEINEKEN GRAN PREMIO D\u2019ITALIA 2021. Pitlane Performance analyzes pit stop performance, adding excitement to the portion of the race that takes place behind the pit wall. Pit stops are an essential and precisely coordinated, but time-draining element of an F1 race. Pitlane Performance offers insights beyond a car\u2019s stationary stop time, like unpacking how the driver and team perform during each step of a pit stop in the pitlane and highlighting total pitlane time lost or gained due to how efficiently the team works. The stat debuts October 8-10 at the FORMULA 1 JAPANESE GRAND PRIX 2021. Undercut Threat helps fans anticipate which cars are at risk of being overtaken as the result of an \u201cundercut.\u201d The undercut is an F1 race strategy where a chasing driver enters the pit for fresh tires with the expectation that improved lap time resulting from the new tires will allow the driver to overtake the car in front once that car has pitted. F1 introduced a similar stat, Pit Strategy Battle, in June 2020 to highlight an undercut battle as it happens and help fans assess in real time how successful each driver\u2019s strategy will be. Undercut Threat adds a new layer of predictive insight by analyzing race performance before either car has pitted, adding to fan excitement and the sense of jeopardy around potential action to come. It visualizes data on gaps between cars, average pit loss time, and tire performance to help identify which cars are at risk. The stat debuts November 19-21 at the FORMULA 1 ROLEX AUSTRALIAN GRAND PRIX 2021. To create the new insights, F1 uses historical race data stored in Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) and combines it with live data streamed from F1 race cars and trackside sensors to AWS through Amazon Kinesis, a service for real-time data collection, processing, and analysis. F1 engineers and scientists will use this data to leverage machine learning models with Amazon SageMaker, AWS\u2019s service that helps developers and data scientists build, train, and deploy machine learning models quickly in the cloud and at the edge. F1 is able to analyze race performance metrics in real-time by deploying those machine learning models on AWS Lambda, which is a serverless compute service that can run code without the need to provision or manage servers. All of the insights will be integrated into the races\u2019 international broadcast feeds around the globe, including F1\u2019s digital platform, F1TV, helping fans to understand the split-second decisions and race strategies made by drivers or teams that can dramatically affect a race outcome. \u201cF1 Insights Powered by AWS give fans an insider\u2019s view of how car, driver, and team function together so that they can better appreciate the action on the track,\u201d said Rob Smedley, chief engineer of FORMULA 1. \u201cWith this new set of racing statistics for 2021, we are going deeper than ever before. New Insights like Braking Performance and Undercut Threat peel back additional layers of race strategies and performance and use advanced visualizations to make the sport of racing even more understandable and exciting. Race car technology improves all the time, and thanks to AWS, our fans can appreciate how that technology impacts race outcomes.\u201d \u201cData has become a critical piece of the story for modern sports, and for F1\u2014where literally each second on the track produces more than a million data points\u2014they require a partner that can translate that raw data into meaning in real time. En 2020, Visa a \u00e9mis une obligation verte de 500 millions USD, consid\u00e9r\u00e9e comme la premi\u00e8re du genre par un r\u00e9seau de paiements num\u00e9riques, \u00e0 l'appui de ces efforts. Visa continue \u00e9galement d'inspirer et de renforcer le commerce durable, gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 des partenariats et des programmes strat\u00e9giques ax\u00e9s sur l'int\u00e9gration de la durabilit\u00e9 dans les cartes de paiement et les comptes, et \u00e0 favoriser des comportements durables gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 son travail dans les transports en commun, la recharge des v\u00e9hicules \u00e9lectriques, les voyages et le tourisme. \u00ab Chez Visa, nous sommes d\u00e9termin\u00e9s \u00e0 assurer la durabilit\u00e9 et \u00e0 cr\u00e9er un avenir plus durable \u00bb, a d\u00e9clar\u00e9 Alfred F. Kelly Jr., pr\u00e9sident-directeur g\u00e9n\u00e9ral de Visa. \u00ab Nous sommes fiers de rejoindre l'Engagement Climat dans le cadre de notre engagement \u00e0 des \u00e9missions nulles d'ici 2040, et nous sommes impatients de collaborer avec les signataires pour faire avancer cet important travail \u00bb. \u00c0 propos de l'Engagement Climat En 2019, Amazon et Global Optimism ont cofond\u00e9 l\u2019Engagement Climat, qui vise \u00e0 honorer l\u2019Accord de Paris sur le climat avec 10 ans d\u2019avance sur les objectifs, et \u00e0 atteindre la neutralit\u00e9 carbone d\u2019ici 2040. \u00c0 ce jour, 105 organisations ont sign\u00e9 l\u2019Engagement Climat, envoyant ainsi un signal fort : il faut s'attendre \u00e0 une croissance rapide de la demande en produits et services contribuant \u00e0 r\u00e9duire les \u00e9missions de carbone. Pour plus d\u2019informations, rendez-vous sur www.theclimatepledge.com. \u00c0 propos d'Amazon Amazon est guid\u00e9e par quatre principes : une focalisation sur le client plut\u00f4t que sur la concurrence, une passion pour l\u2019invention, un engagement envers l\u2019excellence op\u00e9rationnelle, et une r\u00e9flexion \u00e0 long terme. PressReleases: [{"date": "2021-04-22 10:02:00", "headline": "THE CLIMATE PLEDGE ANUNCIA MAIS DE 100 SIGNAT\u00c1RIOS COMPROMETIDOS COM A OBTEN\u00c7\u00c3O EMISS\u00c3O L\u00cdQUIDA ZERO DE CARBONO AT\u00c9 2040 OU ANTES", "description": "SEATTLE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--HOJE, A AMAZON E A GLOBAL OPTIMISM ANUNCIARAM QUE MAIS DE 100 EMPRESAS J\u00c1 ASSINARAM O THE CLIMATE PLEDGE. ENTRE OS 52 NOVOS SIGNAT\u00c1RIOS QUE SE JUNTAM AO THE CLIMATE PLEDGE HOJE EST\u00c3O MARCAS BEM CONHECIDAS, INCLUINDO ALASKA AIRLINES, COLGATE-PALMOLIVE, HEINEKEN, PEPSICO, TELEF\u00d3NICA E VISA. OS SIGNAT\u00c1RIOS DO PLEDGE NO TOTAL GERAM MAIS DE US$ 1,4 TRILH\u00c3O EM VENDAS ANUAIS GLOBAIS E T\u00caM MAIS DE 5 MILH\u00d5ES DE FUNCION\u00c1RIOS EM 25 SETORES EM 16 PA\u00cdSES - DEMONSTRANDO O IMPACTO COLETIVO QUE O THE CLIMATE PLEDGE PODE TER NA ABORDAGEM DAS MUDAN\u00c7AS CLIM\u00c1TICAS. OS SIGNAT\u00c1RIOS DO THE CLIMATE PLEDGE CONCORDAM EM: MEDIR E INFORMAR REGULARMENTE AS EMISS\u00d5ES DE GASES DE EFEITO ESTUFA. IMPLEMENTAR ESTRAT\u00c9GIAS DE DESCARBONIZA\u00c7\u00c3O ALINHADAS AO ACORDO DE PARIS POR MEIO DE MUDAN\u00c7AS E INOVA\u00c7\u00d5ES REAIS NOS NEG\u00d3CIOS, INCLUINDO MELHORIAS DE EFICI\u00caNCIA, ENERGIA RENOV\u00c1VEL, REDU\u00c7\u00c3O DE MATERIAIS E OUTRAS ESTRAT\u00c9GIAS DE ELIMINA\u00c7\u00c3O DE EMISS\u00d5ES DE CARBONO. NEUTRALIZAR AS EMISS\u00d5ES RESTANTES COM COMPENSA\u00c7\u00d5ES ADICIONAIS, QUANTIFIC\u00c1VEIS, REAIS, PERMANENTES E SOCIALMENTE BEN\u00c9FICAS PARA ATINGIR EMISS\u00c3O ANUAIS ZERO DE CARBONO AT\u00c9 2040\u2014UMA D\u00c9CADA ANTES DO OBJETIVO PARA 2050 DO ACORDO DE PARIS. TODOS OS SIGNAT\u00c1RIOS EST\u00c3O TOMANDO A\u00c7\u00d5ES DE ALTO IMPACTO BASEADAS NA CI\u00caNCIA PARA ENFRENTAR AS MUDAN\u00c7AS CLIM\u00c1TICAS, INOVANDO NA EFICI\u00caNCIA DA CADEIA DE SUPRIMENTOS, TRANSPORTE SUSTENT\u00c1VEL, ECONOMIA CIRCULAR, SOLU\u00c7\u00d5ES DE ENERGIA LIMPA E MUITO MAIS. MUITAS ORGANIZA\u00c7\u00d5ES TAMB\u00c9M EST\u00c3O ENVOLVENDO SIGNIFICATIVAMENTE OS CLIENTES EM SUA JORNADA PARA CHEGAR A ZERO COM INICIATIVAS FOCADAS EM EMBALAGENS INOVADORAS E DESIGN E DESENVOLVIMENTO DE PRODUTOS SUSTENT\u00c1VEIS, ENQUANTO FORNECEM SOLU\u00c7\u00d5ES PARA CAPACITAR OS CLIENTES A REDUZIR SUAS PR\u00d3PRIAS EMISS\u00d5ES COM CAMPANHAS EDUCACIONAIS E EXPERI\u00caNCIAS DE COMPRA SUSTENT\u00c1VEIS. \u201cMENOS DE DOIS ANOS ATR\u00c1S, A AMAZON COFUNDOU O THE CLIMATE PLEDGE E CONVOCOU OUTRAS EMPRESAS PARA CHEGAR AO ACORDO DE PARIS 10 ANOS ANTES - HOJE, MAIS DE 100 EMPRESAS COM MAIS DE US$ 1,4 TRILH\u00c3O EM RECEITAS ANUAIS GLOBAIS E MAIS DE 5 MILH\u00d5ES DE FUNCION\u00c1RIOS ASSINARAM A PROMESSA\u201d, DISSE JEFF BEZOS, FUNDADOR E DIRETOR EXECUTIVO DA AMAZON. \u201cESTAMOS ORGULHOSOS DE ESTAR AO LADO DE OUTROS SIGNAT\u00c1RIOS PARA USAR NOSSA ESCALA PARA DESCARBONIZAR A ECONOMIA POR MEIO DE MUDAN\u00c7AS E INOVA\u00c7\u00d5ES REAIS NOS NEG\u00d3CIOS.\u201d \u201cAJUDAMOS A INICIAR O THE CLIMATE PLEDGE PARA PROVAR UM MODELO QUE ACELERA A DESCARBONIZA\u00c7\u00c3O COM AS EMPRESAS MAIS AMBICIOSAS\u201d, DISSE CHRISTIANA FIGUERES, EX-CHEFE DO CLIMA DA ONU E AGORA S\u00d3CIA FUNDADORA DA GLOBAL OPTIMISM. \u201cHOJE, MAIS DE 100 EMPRESAS, INCLUINDO MARCAS DOM\u00c9STICAS E EMPRESAS DE TODOS OS SETORES DA IND\u00daSTRIA, ADERIRAM AO THE CLIMATE PLEDGE COM SUA META DE ZERO L\u00cdQUIDO AT\u00c9 2040. ELES EST\u00c3O DEMONSTRANDO QUE AVAN\u00c7AR MAIS RAPIDAMENTE PARA A DESCARBONIZA\u00c7\u00c3O DE SEUS NEG\u00d3CIOS \u00c9 UM CAMINHO PARA OBTER VANTAGEM COMPETITIVA. N\u00c3O H\u00c1 D\u00daVIDA DE QUE ESTAMOS EM UM PONTO CR\u00cdTICO PARA ESTABELECER A ECONOMIA DE BAIXO CARBONO PREVISTA NO ACORDO DE PARIS. ELOGIO A LIDERAN\u00c7A DAS EMPRESAS QUE J\u00c1 ADERIRAM AO THE CLIMATE PLEDGE E ESTOU ANSIOSO PARA DAR AS BOAS-VINDAS \u00c0S PR\u00d3XIMAS 100\u201d. A AMAZON E O GLOBAL OPTIMISM D\u00c3O AS BOAS-VINDAS AOS NOVOS SIGNAT\u00c1RIOS QUE SE COMPROMETERAM COM O THE CLIMATE PLEDGE. INFORMA\u00c7\u00d5ES SOBRE TODOS OS 52 NOVOS SIGNAT\u00c1RIOS QUE SE COMPROMETERAM COM O THE CLIMATE PLEDGE EST\u00c3O DISPON\u00cdVEIS NO BLOG SOBRE A AMAZON, COM NOVOS SIGNAT\u00c1RIOS, INCLUINDO: ALASKA AIRLINES A ALASKA AIRLINES ATENDE A MAIS DE 120 DESTINOS NOS ESTADOS UNIDOS, M\u00c9XICO, CANAD\u00c1 E COSTA RICA, E ATINGE DESTINOS EM TODO O MUNDO POR MEIO DA ONEWORLD ALLIANCE. A EMPRESA TEM UM COMPROMISSO DE LONGA DATA COM O CUIDADO COM AS PESSOAS E O MEIO AMBIENTE E EST\u00c1 SE PREPARANDO PARA UM CAMINHO OUSADO PARA REDUZIR O IMPACTO CLIM\u00c1TICO A CURTO E LONGO PRAZO PARA ATINGIR AS EMISS\u00c3O L\u00cdQUIDA ZERO AT\u00c9 2040. ISSO INCLUI MELHORIAS CONT\u00cdNUAS NA EFICI\u00caNCIA DE SUA FROTA; PADRONIZAR E EXPANDIR O USO DA INTELIG\u00caNCIA ARTIFICIAL IN\u00c9DITA E TECNOLOGIA DE APRENDIZADO DE M\u00c1QUINA PARA PLANEJAR ROTAS OTIMIZADAS, REDUZIR A QUEIMA DE COMBUST\u00cdVEL E AS EMISS\u00d5ES DE CARBONO; TRABALHAR COM O GOVERNO E A IND\u00daSTRIA PARA EXPANDIR A DISPONIBILIDADE E O USO DE COMBUST\u00cdVEIS DE AVIA\u00c7\u00c3O SUSTENT\u00c1VEIS, QUE T\u00caM AT\u00c9 80% MENOS EMISS\u00d5ES DE CARBONO EM UM CICLO DE VIDA; EXPLORAR E AVAN\u00c7AR NOVAS ABORDAGENS DE PROPULS\u00c3O QUE SUPORTAM TECNOLOGIAS DE ELETRIFICA\u00c7\u00c3O PARA VOOS REGIONAIS; E INVESTIR EM COMPENSA\u00c7\u00d5ES DE CARBONO CONFI\u00c1VEIS \u200b\u200bPARA FECHAR QUAISQUER LACUNAS PARA O OBJETIVO. A EMPRESA J\u00c1 EST\u00c1 REDUZINDO AS EMISS\u00d5ES POR MEIO DA OTIMIZA\u00c7\u00c3O DA FROTA, ECONOMIZANDO COMBUST\u00cdVEL COM OS WINGLETS DE DESIGN EXCLUSIVO DE SUAS AERONAVES E TECNOLOGIA DE NAVEGA\u00c7\u00c3O QUE FORNECE A ROTA MAIS EFICIENTE. POR MEIO DE SEU PROGRAMA DE SUSTENTABILIDADE SOCIAL E AMBIENTAL MAIS AMPLO, LIFT, ALASKA AIRLINES CONVIDA OS CLIENTES A DOAR SUAS MILHAS PARA APOIAR ORGANIZA\u00c7\u00d5ES SEM FINS LUCRATIVOS COMO A NATURE CONSERVANCY E UNCF, COMPRAR COMPENSA\u00c7\u00d5ES DE CARBONO COM THE GOOD TRAVELLER E REDUZIR O DESPERD\u00cdCIO POR MEIO DA RECICLAGEM EM VOO (TEMPORARIAMENTE PAUSADO DEVIDO \u00c0 PANDEMIA COVID-19), E VIAJANDO COM GARRAFAS DE \u00c1GUA REUTILIZ\u00c1VEIS \u200b\u200bPOR MEIO DA INICIATIVA #FILLBEFOREYOUFLY DA EMPRESA. \u201cNA ALASKA AIRLINES, SABEMOS QUE AS VIAGENS PODEM FAZER UMA GRANDE DIFEREN\u00c7A NA VIDA DAS PESSOAS E TEMOS O COMPROMISSO DE OPERAR DE FORMA SOCIAL E AMBIENTALMENTE RESPONS\u00c1VEL\u201d, DISSE BEN MINICUCCI, DIRETOR EXECUTIVO DA ALASKA AIRLINES. \u201cESTAMOS EM UMA JORNADA PARA GARANTIR QUE A SUSTENTABILIDADE SEJA UMA PARTE ESSENCIAL DE NOSSA CULTURA E SOMOS GRATOS AOS PARCEIROS DENTRO DA IND\u00daSTRIA DA AVIA\u00c7\u00c3O E AL\u00c9M QUE EST\u00c3O TRABALHANDO CONOSCO PARA TORNAR O CAMINHO PARA A REDE ZERO UMA REALIDADE. {"date": "2021-04-23 13:47:00", "headline": "THE CLIMATE PLEDGE ANUNCIA QUE M\u00c1S DE 100 SIGNATARIOS SE HAN COMPROMETIDO A LLEGAR A CERO EMISIONES NETAS DE CARBONO HACIA 2040 O ANTES", "description": "SEATTLE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--HOY, AMAZON Y GLOBAL OPTIMISM ANUNCIARON QUE M\u00c1S DE 100 EMPRESAS YA HAN FIRMADO EL PROGRAMA THE CLIMATE PLEDGE. ENTRE LOS 52 SIGNATARIOS NUEVOS QUE SE INCORPORAN A THE CLIMATE PLEDGE HOY, HAY ALGUNAS MARCAS MUY CONOCIDAS, COMO ALASKA AIRLINES, COLGATE-PALMOLIVE, HEINEKEN, PEPSICO, TELEF\u00d3NICA Y VISA. LOS SIGNATARIOS DEL COMPROMISO GENERAN EN TOTAL M\u00c1S 1,4 BILLONES DE USD EN VENTAS ANUALES GLOBALES Y EMPLEAN A M\u00c1S DE 5 MILLONES DE PERSONAS EN 25 INDUSTRIAS Y 16 PA\u00cdSES, LO QUE DEMUESTRA EL IMPACTO COLECTIVO QUE EL PROGRAMA THE CLIMATE PLEDGE PUEDE TENER EN LA LUCHA CONTRA EL CAMBIO CLIM\u00c1TICO. LOS SIGNATARIOS DE THE CLIMATE PLEDGE ACEPTAN LO SIGUIENTE: MEDIR E INFORMAR DE LAS EMISIONES DE GASES DE EFECTO INVERNADERO DE FORMA REGULAR. IMPLEMENTAR ESTRATEGIAS DE DESCARBONIZACI\u00d3N ALINEADAS CON EL ACUERDO DE PAR\u00cdS A TRAV\u00c9S DE CAMBIOS COMERCIALES REALES E INNOVACIONES, COMO MEJORAS DE EFICACIA, ENERG\u00cdA RENOVABLE, REDUCCI\u00d3N DE MATERIALES Y OTRAS ESTRATEGIAS DE ELIMINACI\u00d3N DE LAS EMISIONES DE CARBONO. NEUTRALIZAR LAS EMISIONES RESTANTES CON COMPENSACIONES ADICIONALES, CUANTIFICABLES, REALES, PERMANENTES Y SOCIALMENTE BENEFICIOSAS PARA LOGRAR CERO EMISIONES ANUALES NETAS DE CARBONO PARA 2040: UNA D\u00c9CADA ANTES QUE EL OBJETIVO DE 2050 DEL ACUERDO DE PAR\u00cdS. TODOS LOS SIGNATARIOS EST\u00c1N TOMANDO MEDIDAS DE ALTO IMPACTO CON FUNDAMENTO CIENT\u00cdFICO PARA COMBATIR EL CAMBIO CLIM\u00c1TICO AL INNOVAR EN EFICIENCIA DE LA CADENA DE SUMINISTRO, TRANSPORTE SOSTENIBLE, ECONOM\u00cdA CIRCULAR, SOLUCIONES DE ENERG\u00cdA LIMPIA Y M\u00c1S. MUCHAS ORGANIZACIONES TAMBI\u00c9N INVOLUCRAN A LOS CLIENTES DE FORMA POSITIVA EN SU PROYECTO DE LOGRAR CERO EMISIONES NETAS MEDIANTE INICIATIVAS QUE SE ENFOCAN EN EMBALAJES INNOVADORES Y DISE\u00d1O Y DESARROLLO DE PRODUCTOS SOSTENIBLES, A LA VEZ QUE BRINDAN SOLUCIONES QUE LOS EMPODERAN PARA REDUCIR SUS PROPIAS EMISIONES CON CAMPA\u00d1AS EDUCATIVAS Y EXPERIENCIAS DE COMPRA SOSTENIBLES. \u201cHACE MENOS DE DOS A\u00d1OS, AMAZON COFUND\u00d3 THE CLIMATE PLEDGE Y CONVOC\u00d3 A OTRAS EMPRESAS PARA ALCANZAR EL OBJETIVO DEL ACUERDO DE PAR\u00cdS 10 A\u00d1OS ANTES. HOY, M\u00c1S DE 100 EMPRESAS CON INGRESOS ANUALES GLOBALES POR M\u00c1S DE 1,4 BILLONES DE USD Y M\u00c1S DE 5 MILLONES DE EMPLEADOS HAN FIRMADO EL COMPROMISO\u201d, DIJO JEFF BEZOS, FUNDADOR Y DIRECTOR EJECUTIVO DE AMAZON. \u201cES UN ORGULLO TRABAJAR JUNTO A OTROS SIGNATARIOS Y UTILIZAR NUESTRO TAMA\u00d1O PARA DESCARBONIZAR LA ECONOM\u00cdA MEDIANTE CAMBIOS REALES EN LOS NEGOCIOS E INNOVACI\u00d3N\u201d. \u201cAYUDAMOS A INICIAR THE CLIMATE PLEDGE PARA PROBAR UN MODELO QUE ACELERARA LA DESCARBONIZACI\u00d3N JUNTO A LAS EMPRESAS M\u00c1S AMBICIOSAS\u201d, DIJO CHRISTIANA FIGUERES, EXDIRECTORA CLIM\u00c1TICA DE LA ONU Y ACTUAL SOCIA FUNDADORA DE GLOBAL OPTIMISM. \u201cHOY, M\u00c1S DE 100 EMPRESAS, ENTRE MARCAS FAMOSAS Y EMPRESAS DE TODOS LOS SECTORES DE LA INDUSTRIA, SE HAN UNIDO A THE CLIMATE PLEDGE EN SU OBJETIVO DE LOGRAR CERO EMISIONES NETAS HACIA 2040. EST\u00c1N DEMOSTRANDO QUE IR M\u00c1S R\u00c1PIDAMENTE HACIA LA DESCARBONIZACI\u00d3N DE SUS NEGOCIOS ES UN CAMINO PARA LOGRAR LA VENTAJA COMPETITIVA. NO QUEDA DUDA DE QUE ESTAMOS EN UN MOMENTO CR\u00cdTICO PARA ESTABLECER LA ECONOM\u00cdA DE BAJO CARBONO QUE EL ACUERDO DE PAR\u00cdS IMAGIN\u00d3. FELICITO A LOS L\u00cdDERES DE LAS EMPRESAS QUE YA SE HAN INCORPORADO A THE CLIMATE PLEDGE Y ESPERO CON MUCHA IMPACIENCIA DAR LA BIENVENIDA A LAS PR\u00d3XIMAS 100\u201d. AMAZON Y GLOBAL OPTIMISM DAN LA BIENVENIDA A LOS SIGNATARIOS NUEVOS QUE SE HAN COMPROMETIDO CON THE CLIMATE PLEDGE. ALASKA AIRLINES ALASKA AIRLINES OPERA EN M\u00c1S DE 120 DESTINOS EN LOS ESTADOS UNIDOS, M\u00c9XICO, CANAD\u00c1 Y COSTA RICA, Y LLEGA A DESTINOS DE TODO EL MUNDO A TRAV\u00c9S DE ONEWORLD ALLIANCE. LA EMPRESA MANTIENE UN COMPROMISO DURADERO CON EL CUIDADO DE LAS PERSONAS Y DEL MEDIO AMBIENTE, Y EST\u00c1 COMENZANDO UN PLAN AUDAZ PARA REDUCIR EL IMPACTO CLIM\u00c1TICO A CERCANO Y LARGO PLAZO Y ALCANZAR LAS CERO EMISIONES NETAS HACIA 2040. ALGUNAS DE LAS MEDIDAS QUE ESTO IMPLICA SON LA MEJORA CONTINUA DE LA EFICIENCIA DE SU FLOTA; LA ESTANDARIZACI\u00d3N Y EXPANSI\u00d3N DEL USO DE LA PRIMERA INTELIGENCIA ARTIFICIAL DE ESTE TIPO Y TECNOLOG\u00cdA DE APRENDIZAJE AUTOM\u00c1TICO PARA PLANEAR RUTAS OPTIMIZADAS Y REDUCIR EL CONSUMO DE COMBUSTIBLE Y LAS EMISIONES DE CARBONO; EL TRABAJO JUNTO AL GOBIERNO Y LA INDUSTRIA PARA EXPANDIR LA DISPONIBILIDAD Y EL CONSUMO DE COMBUSTIBLES SOSTENIBLES PARA LA AVIACI\u00d3N, QUE EMITEN HASTA 80 % MENOS DE CARBONO SEG\u00daN EL CICLO DE VIDA; LA EXPLORACI\u00d3N Y EL DESARROLLO DE NUEVAS FORMAS DE PROPULSI\u00d3N QUE ADMITEN TECNOLOG\u00cdAS DE ELECTRIFICACI\u00d3N PARA VUELOS REGIONALES Y LA INVERSI\u00d3N EN COMPENSACIONES DE CARBONO CONFIABLES PARA CERRAR LAS POSIBLES BRECHAS Y LLEGAR AL OBJETIVO. LA EMPRESA YA EST\u00c1 REDUCIENDO LAS EMISIONES MEDIANTE LA OPTIMIZACI\u00d3N DE SU FLOTA, EL AHORRO DE COMBUSTIBLE GRACIAS A LOS WINGLETS DE DISE\u00d1O EXCLUSIVO DE SUS AERONAVES Y EL USO DE TECNOLOG\u00cdA DE NAVEGACI\u00d3N QUE OBTIENE LA RUTA M\u00c1S EFICIENTE. A TRAV\u00c9S DE SU PROGRAMA DE SOSTENIBILIDAD SOCIAL Y AMBIENTAL M\u00c1S AMPLIO, LIFT, ALASKA AIRLINES INVITA A LOS CLIENTES A DONAR SUS MILLAS PARA APOYAR A ORGANIZACIONES SIN FINES DE LUCRO, COMO NATURE CONSERVANCY Y UNCF, CON EL FIN DE ADQUIRIR COMPENSACIONES DE CARBONO CON THE GOOD TRAVELER, ADEM\u00c1S DE INSTARLOS A REDUCIR LOS DESECHOS MEDIANTE EL RECICLAJE DURANTE EL VUELO (TEMPORALMENTE EN PAUSA DEBIDO A LA PANDEMIA DE COVID-19) Y A VIAJAR CON SUS PROPIAS BOTELLAS REUTILIZABLES DE AGUA MEDIANTE LA INICIATIVA DE LA EMPRESA, #FILLBEFOREYOUFLY (\u201cLL\u00c9NELA ANTES DE VOLAR\u201d). \u201cEN ALASKA AIRLINES SABEMOS QUE VIAJAR PUEDE MARCAR UNA GRAN DIFERENCIA EN LA VIDA DE LA GENTE Y NOS COMPROMETEMOS A FUNCIONAR DE MODO SOCIAL Y MEDIOAMBIENTALMENTE RESPONSABLE\u201d, DIJO BEN MINICUCCI, DIRECTOR EJECUTIVO DE ALASKA AIRLINES. \u201cNOS HEMOS EMBARCADO EN EL PROYECTO DE ASEGURAR QUE LA SOSTENIBILIDAD SEA UN ASPECTO PRINCIPAL DE NUESTRA CULTURA Y AGRADECEMOS A NUESTROS SOCIOS DE LA INDUSTRIA DE LA AVIACI\u00d3N Y DEM\u00c1S SECTORES QUE TRABAJAN CON NOSOTROS PARA QUE EL OBJETIVO DE LAS CERO EMISIONES SE HAGA REALIDAD.
