ROSA streamlines moving on-premises Red Hat OpenShift workloads to AWS and offers a tighter integration with other AWS technologies. AWS announced the general availability of AQUA (Advanced Query Accelerator) for Amazon Redshift, an innovative new distributed and hardware-accelerated cache that delivers up to ten times better query performance than other cloud data warehouses. AQUA brings compute to the storage layer, helping customers avoid networking bandwidth limitations by eliminating unnecessary data movement between where data is stored and compute clusters. With AQUA, customers have more up-to-date dashboards, save development time, and their systems are easier to maintain. AWS announced the general availability of Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) X2gd instances, the next generation of advanced, memory-optimized instances powered by AWS-designed, Arm-based Graviton2 processors. New X2gd instances deliver up to 55% better price/performance compared to current generation x86-based X1 instances, while also offering increased memory per vCPU compared to other Graviton2-based instances. Together, the higher performance and additional memory of X2gd instances make it possible for customers to more efficiently run memory intensive workloads like in-memory databases, relational databases, electronic design automation (EDA) workloads, real-time analytics, and real-time caching servers. AWS announced Amazon Lookout for Equipment, a new service that uses AWS-developed machine learning models to help customers perform predictive maintenance on the equipment in their facilities. Amazon Lookout for Equipment ingests sensor data from a customer\u2019s industrial equipment (e.g., pressure, flow rate, RPMs, temperature, and power), and then trains a unique machine learning model to accurately predict early warning signs of machine failure or suboptimal performance using real-time data streams from the customer\u2019s equipment. With Amazon Lookout for Equipment, customers can detect abnormalities with speed and precision, quickly diagnose issues, reduce false alerts, and avoid expensive downtime by taking action before machine failures occur. AWS announced the general availability of Amazon Lookout for Vision, a service that analyzes images using computer vision and sophisticated machine learning capabilities to spot product or process defects and anomalies. By employing advanced machine learning techniques, Amazon Lookout for Vision is able to train a model using as few as 30 images, which can help detect manufacturing and production defects (e.g., cracks, dents, incorrect color, irregular shape, etc.) in their products and prevent costly errors from progressing down an operational line and reaching customers. AWS announced the general availability of Amazon Lookout for Metrics, a new fully managed machine learning service that helps customers monitor the most important metrics for their business (e.g., revenue, web page views, active users, transaction volume, and mobile app installations) with greater speed and accuracy. The service also makes it easier to diagnose the root cause of anomalies like unexpected dips in revenue, high rates of abandoned shopping carts, spikes in payment transaction failures, increases in new user sign-ups, and more. AWS announced new Amazon Elastic File System (EFS) One Zone storage classes that reduce storage costs by 47%, compared to existing Amazon EFS storage classes, while delivering the same features and benefits. One Zone storage classes redundantly store data within a single Availability Zone (AZ). These are ideal for customers who want cost-optimized file storage for workloads and applications (e.g., content management, developer applications, etc.) that do not require the level of availability and durability offered by regional Amazon EFS storage classes, which redundantly store data across multiple geographically separated AZs. "SEATTLE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Amazon Business today released the first 2021 B2B E-commerce in Evolution Report, which shares B2B trends and new insights from U.S. procurement professionals across industries and organizations of every size. For the report, which examines the rapid transformation B2B e-procurement has undergone in recent years, Amazon Business surveyed 250 B2B buyers and 250 B2B sellers who hold influential procurement roles across government, education, healthcare, and commercial industries in the U.S. This report also provides actionable insights for business decision-makers, on both the buying and selling sides, as they continue their digital transformation journey in 2021 and beyond. According to the findings, 85% of business buyers said that as a result of the pandemic, their organizations were propelled to move more of their procurement online, and 96% said they anticipate their organizations will continue doing more purchasing online, even after pre-pandemic business functions resume. The vast majority (91%) of buyers said they prefer e-procurement over traditional and offline purchasing methods. \u201cOur 2021 B2B E-commerce in Evolution report underlines the fact that simply leveraging e-procurement is no longer enough,\u201d said Todd Heimes, director of Amazon Business. \u201cUltimately, we think that organizations have a significant opportunity to maximize e-procurement technologies that will help them overcome operational challenges that diminish efficiency and waste budget. At Amazon Business, we\u2019re committed to helping buyers and sellers navigate the next chapters in their transformation journeys with our technology and expertise.\u201d Download the 2021 Amazon Business B2B E-commerce in Evolution Report here. Key takeaways include: The pandemic accelerated digital transformation, helping organizations achieve new goals. The COVID-19 pandemic further accelerated organizations\u2019 efforts to digitize procurement. According to the report\u2019s findings, 38% of buyers made more than 50% of purchases for their organizations online in 2020. Smaller commercial organizations were especially motivated to accelerate their digital transformation efforts in the last year. Fifty-six percent of small and-medium businesses (SMBs) said they more fully digitized their purchasing process due to COVID-19, compared to only 42% of enterprise commercial companies. This indicates that smaller organizations had to play \u201ccatch up\u201d to large enterprises when the pandemic upended in-person operations and forced a shift to remote work. Ultimately this acceleration to adopt and adapt to purchasing online has resulted in additional benefits for buyers and sellers by unlocking new features and technologies that will enable them to do more\u2014impacting their entire organization. Online features significantly outrank traditional ones in buyers\u2019 purchasing decision processes. When ranking the most valuable features of the purchasing process, buyers overwhelmingly indicated that online features, such as product comparisons or product videos, were more valuable than traditional ones, such as phone calls or viewing products in a store. Sellers, by contrast, ranked online features much lower than buyers. In the report, when looking at respondents who rated features a \u201c4\u201d or \u201c5\u201d (where 5 was most valuable): Buyers ranked online product comparison features the highest 83% of the time, whereas sellers only ranked them the highest 67% of the time. Buyers ranked product videos the highest 74% of the time, whereas sellers only ranked the feature highest 66% of the time. Sellers ranked viewing products in a physical store highest 68% of the time, compared to buyers who only ranked it highest 57% of the time. Sellers ranked phone and/or video calls with a sales rep highest 69% of the time, compared to buyers who only ranked it highest 63% of the time. For 2021, the top priority identified by sellers is providing a positive customer experience (62% of respondents), followed by expanding customer bases (59%), and selling products globally (40%). Meanwhile, the top priority for buyers is increasing efficiency, with 40% of respondents selecting this option. However, more than one-third (34%) of buyers said reducing costs is a top procurement priority this year\u2014though cost reduction is a higher priority in the education, government, and healthcare industries than in commercial industries. Social and environmental considerations are playing a larger role in the procurement process. Increasingly, over the past year, expectations between consumer and business purchasing experiences have become blurred as business buyers expect the same fast, convenient, and personalized digital buying capabilities they\u2019ve grown accustomed to at home. And consumers want to support diversity and sustainability products and initiatives from the brands they give their dollars to. The 2021 Amazon Business B2B E-commerce in Evolution report revealed that the consumer push to prioritize social and environmental issues is also important to both B2B buyers and sellers, in all industries. While increasing efficiency was the top buyer procurement priority for 2021 at 40%, improving sustainability in purchasing (39%), supporting local businesses within our community (37%), and increasing diversity among suppliers (35%) were all close behind. Additionally, 83% of buyers surveyed said their companies plan to increase their purchasing budgets reserved for Black and minority-owned businesses in 2021; and of those, almost half (48%) plan to increase their budgets by 20% or more. Priorities for 2021 vary across healthcare, education, government, and commercial industries. Of note, commercial business respondents identified the next two top procurement priorities for 2021 as supporting local businesses within the community (46%) and increasing diversity (39%); this indicates the growing importance of corporate social responsibility in the commercial sector. [{"date": "20210719171400", "headline": "AWS Announces General Availability of Amazon EBS io2 Block Express Volumes", "summary": "SEATTLE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Today, Amazon Web Services, Inc., (AWS), an Amazon.com, Inc. company (NASDAQ: AMZN), announced the general availability of Amazon EBS io2 Block Express volumes, delivering SAN capabilities in the cloud for the first time. EBS Block Express is a next-generation storage server architecture that provides the highest block storage performance without the cost or hassle of having to procure, scale, and maintain expensive on-premises SANs. With io2 volumes running on Block Express, customers can achieve sub-millisecond latency and provision a single io2 volume with up to 256,000 IOPS, 4,000 MB/second throughput, and 64 TB of capacity\u2014a 4x increase in performance, throughput, and capacity for existing io2 volumes. io2 Block Express volumes are ideal for the largest, most I/O-intensive, mission-critical deployments of Oracle databases, SAP HANA, Microsoft SQL Server, InterSystems database, and SAS Analytics. There are no upfront commitments or fees to use io2 Block Express volumes, and customers pay only for the storage capacity used. To get started with io2 Block Express volumes, visit: https://aws.amazon.com/ebs/provisioned-iops/. Customers choose io2 volumes (the latest generation of provisioned IOPS volumes) to run their critical, performance-intensive applications because io2 volumes are designed for 99.999% (five 9s) durability and 4x more IOPS than general purpose EBS volumes. Some applications require even higher IOPS, throughput, and capacity with lower latency than offered by a single io2 volume. To address the needed performance, customers often stripe multiple io2 volumes together, but the most demanding applications require more io2 volumes to be striped together than customers want to manage. For these highly demanding applications, many customers have historically used on-premises SANs (a set of disks accessed over the local network). However, SANs have numerous drawbacks. They are expensive due to high upfront acquisition costs, require complex forecasting to ensure sufficient capacity, are complicated and hard to manage, and consume valuable data center space and networking capacity. When a customer exceeds the capacity of a SAN, they have to buy another entire SAN, which requires even more upfront cost and forces customers to pay for unused capacity. Customers want the power of a SAN in the cloud, which hasn\u2019t existed\u2014until now. io2 Block Express volumes reinvent block storage and give customers the performance they expect from a SAN, but with the elasticity of AWS, unlimited scale, and flexibility of pay-as-you-go pricing\u2014at as low as half the cost of a typical SAN. io2 Block Express volumes are designed for applications that benefit from high-volume IOPS, high throughput, high durability, high storage capacity, and low latency. For example, using Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) R5b instances and io2 Block Express volumes, SQL Server runs up to 3x faster on AWS than the next fastest cloud provider. Customers can also stripe multiple io2 Block Express volumes together to get even better performance than a single volume can provide. Block Express helps io2 volumes achieve this performance by completely reinventing the underlying EBS hardware, software, and networking stacks. By decoupling the compute from the storage at the hardware layer and rewriting the software to take advantage of this decoupling, Block Express enables new levels of performance and reduces time to innovation. By also rewriting the networking stack to take advantage of the high-performance Scalable Reliable Datagrams (SRD) networking protocol, Block Express dramatically reduces latency. io2 Block Express volumes are available at the same price as io2 volumes and with no upfront commitments to use the volumes. These improvements allow customers to provision and scale capacity without the high upfront costs and idle capacity that is typical of a SAN. \u201cFor decades, customers who wanted to get the most performance for their throughput-intensive workloads were forced to use an on-premises SAN, which is not only expensive, but also complicated and resource intensive to manage,\u201d said Mai-Lan Tomsen Bukovec, Vice President, Storage, at AWS. \u201cio2 Block Express volumes are a game changer. Customers can scale their capacity by petabytes in minutes at as low as half the cost of a typical SAN, and the storage is managed by AWS with the same or better performance of many leading SAN storage products, and without the hassle of procuring, scaling, and maintaining an on-premises SAN.\u201d EBS io2 Block Express volumes are generally available today with many important SAN features, including Multi-Attach and Elastic Volumes. In the coming months, support for additional SAN features, including Fast Snapshot Restore, will be added. io2 Block Express volumes are available with R5b instances, the Amazon EC2 instance with the highest EBS bandwidth, in all regions where AWS offers R5b instances today: US East (Ohio), US East (N. Virginia), US West (Oregon), Asia Pacific (Singapore), Asia Pacific (Tokyo), and Europe (Frankfurt). In the coming months, support for additional EC2 instance types and regions will be added. Epic Systems is a global leader in electronic health record software. \u201cWith the combination of io2 Block Express and the AWS R5b instance, we've observed a scalability improvement of 125% when compared to the previous single database configuration in AWS,\u201d said Doug Hernandez, Server Systems Engineer, at Epic Systems. \u201cFor the first time our customers have the ability to scale further by scaling out their operational database architecture using InterSystem's Enterprise Cache Protocol (ECP) in a public cloud.\u201d Amway is the world\u2019s largest direct selling company, manufacturing and distributing nutrition, beauty, personal care, and home products\u2014which are exclusively sold in 100 countries through Amway Independent Business Owners. \u201cWe run an Oracle database-based application, where high performance is absolutely critical for our customers during our peak month end processing windows. It\u2019s currently running on dedicated compute, network, and VMAX storage, where transaction throughput depends on extremely low write latency,\u201d said Lee Beyer, Technical Lead, at Amway. \u201cA complete re-architecture is not possible for us, but we want to be able to take advantage of scalable infrastructure during peak processing windows and enable global deployments. With the performance of io2 Block Express volumes, we expect to meet our transaction throughput and write latency requirements, allowing us to take advantage of a more elastic scalable infrastructure, setting the stage for future modernization on cloud native services.\u201d Okta is the leading independent provider of identity on a mission to bring simple and secure access to people and organizations everywhere. \u201cAt Okta we leverage MySQL as the backend storage for our main application and several microservices. As demand on our data store grows, so does the need for more throughput, IOPS, and data storage. Net sales increased 27% to $113.1 billion in the second quarter, compared with $88.9 billion in second quarter 2020. Excluding the $2.5 billion favorable impact from year-over-year changes in foreign exchange rates throughout the quarter, net sales increased 24% compared with second quarter 2020. Operating income increased to $7.7 billion in the second quarter, compared with $5.8 billion in second quarter 2020. Amazon is investing over $300 million into safety projects in 2021, including redesigning and retrofitting workstations, re-engineering cross-dock operations and powered-industrial-truck barriers, and implementing new safety control systems. With io2 volumes running on Block Express, customers get a 4x increase in performance, throughput, and capacity for existing io2 volumes, making it ideal for the most I/O-intensive, mission-critical deployments of Oracle, SAP HANA, Microsoft SQL Server, and SAS Analytics. AWS announced the general availability of three new container services. AWS App Runner is a fully managed container application service that makes it easier and faster for customers to build, deploy, and run containerized web applications and APIs with just a few clicks. AWS Proton is an application delivery service that makes it easier for customers to provision, deploy, and monitor the microservices that form the basis of modern container and serverless applications. Amazon Elastic Container Service (ECS) Anywhere is a new capability for Amazon ECS that enables customers to easily run, scale, secure, and manage container-based applications on-premises and at edge environments using the same APIs, cluster management, workload scheduling, monitoring, and deployment pipelines they use with Amazon ECS on AWS. AWS announced the general availability of Amazon DevOps Guru, a fully managed operations service that uses machine learning to make it easier for developers to improve application availability by automatically detecting operational issues and recommending specific actions for remediation. Informed by years of Amazon.com and AWS operational excellence, Amazon DevOps Guru applies machine learning to automatically analyze data like application metrics, logs, events, and traces for behaviors that deviate from normal operating patterns so developers can identify and remediate issues long before they impact customers. AWS announced the general availability of Amazon Location Service, a new service that makes it easier and more cost-effective for customers to add location functionality to their applications, without compromising on user privacy or data security. With Amazon Location Service, customers can embed location functionality in their applications using data from location-based service providers Esri and HERE Technologies to provide maps, points of interest, geocoding (converting location information to a point on a map), route planning, geofencing (creating virtual perimeters), or asset tracking. News: [{"date": "20210902194748", "headline": "A Comprehensive Guide to Fintech ETFs", "summary": "Here we highlight some fintech ETFs that can gain from the growing financial technology market.", "source": "Zacks Investment Research"}, {"date": "20210902201200", "headline": "Amazon to roll out its own TV in U.S. by October - Business Insider", "summary": "Amazon.com Inc is planning to launch its Amazon-branded TV in the United States as soon as October, Business Insider reported on Thursday.", "source": "Reuters"}, {"date": "20210902203900", "headline": "Amazon annuncia investimenti in Brasile in soluzioni naturalistiche per la rimozione del carbonio insieme a The Nature Conservancy", "summary": "SEATTLE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Nell\u2019ambito dell\u2019impegno per lo sviluppo di soluzioni globali per la crisi climatica, Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN) ha annunciato oggi il lancio dell\u2019Acceleratore per il ripristino e l\u2019agroforestazione (Agroforestry and Restoration Accelerator) in collaborazione con The Nature Conservancy, un\u2019organizzazione ambientalista globale. Obiettivo dell\u2019Acceleratore sar\u00e0 la creazione di una fonte di reddito pi\u00f9 sostenibile per migliaia di agricoltori locali dello stato amazzonico brasiliano del Par\u00e1, unitamente al ripristino delle native foreste pluviali e alla lotta contro i cambiamenti climatici attraverso il sequestro e lo stoccaggio del carbonio. Secondo il Comitato intergovernativo sui cambiamenti climatici (Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, IPCC), le soluzioni naturalistiche sono determinanti per scongiurare gli effetti peggiori dei cambiamenti climatici. Tanto i governi quanto il settore privato possono ridurre le emissioni di carbonio e rimuovere il carbonio dall\u2019atmosfera investendo su larga scala in soluzioni naturalistiche. L\u2019Acceleratore per il ripristino e l\u2019agroforestazione \u00e8 uno di questi progetti di rimozione del carbonio e rientra negli impegni sottoscritti da Amazon nell\u2019ambito di The Climate Pledge, l\u2019iniziativa istituita dalla societ\u00e0 insieme a Global Optimism. I firmatari dell\u2019iniziativa si impegnano all\u2019azzeramento delle emissioni nette di carbonio entro il 2040, con 10 anni di anticipo rispetto all\u2019Accordo di Parigi. Nel rispetto dell\u2019impegno assunto con The Climate Pledge, Amazon intende innanzitutto continuare a innovare e investire nella decarbonizzazione delle proprie attivit\u00e0. La societ\u00e0 ha acquistato 100.000 veicoli elettrici per le consegne ed \u00e8 attualmente il maggiore acquirente aziendale di energia rinnovabile al mondo. Amazon sta inoltre investendo in soluzioni naturalistiche al di fuori della propria catena di valore attraverso il Right Now Climate Fund, che sostiene l\u2019Acceleratore e altri progetti finalizzati al ripristino di terreni degradati con modalit\u00e0 atte a migliorare il livello di vita delle comunit\u00e0 locali e a rimuovere il carbonio dall\u2019atmosfera. Attraverso l\u2019iniziativa pubblico-privata LEAF Coalition, annunciata di recente, volta alla mobilitazione di almeno 1 miliardo di dollari a protezione delle foreste tropicali del mondo, Amazon e altri partner stanno collaborando per porre un freno alla deforestazione tropicale, riducendo la quantit\u00e0 di carbonio immessa nell\u2019atmosfera. \u201cIl ripristino delle foreste mondiali \u00e8 una delle azioni pi\u00f9 significative che possiamo intraprendere ora per contrastare i cambiamenti climatici, il cui successo richiede soluzioni innovative\u201d, ha dichiarato Kara Hurst, vicepresidente per la sostenibilit\u00e0 mondiale di Amazon. \u201cSiamo orgogliosi di lanciare l\u2019Acceleratore per il ripristino e l\u2019agroforestazione in collaborazione con The Nature Conservancy per supportare soluzioni che privilegino un\u2019elevata integrit\u00e0 ambientale e vantaggi importanti per le comunit\u00e0. Amazon \u00e8 lieta di contribuire con la propria passione per l\u2019innovazione, oltre che con un supporto finanziario, al fine di migliorare il livello di vita delle comunit\u00e0 locali del Brasile, aiutando al contempo a proteggere il pianeta per le generazioni future.\u201d \u201cLa scienza non ha dubbi nel considerare i sistemi naturali come prioritari per l\u2019assorbimento del carbonio dall\u2019atmosfera, come sottolineato dall\u2019ultima relazione dell\u2019IPCC\u201d, ha dichiarato Christiana Figueres, cofondatrice di Global Optimism nonch\u00e9 ex responsabile principale per il clima nell\u2019ambito dell\u2019Accordo di Parigi. \u201cLa protezione degli ecosistemi perenni e il ripristino dei terreni degradati saranno strategie fondamentali per la mitigazione delle emissioni di carbonio, soprattutto nei prossimi dieci o venti anni. I progetti in grado di raggiungere questo obiettivo rispettando la natura e migliorando il livello di vita delle comunit\u00e0 locali hanno un valore inestimabile ai fini della trasformazione necessaria per prosperare superando la crisi climatica. But the company is still expanding.", "source": "The Motley Fool"}, {"date": "20210903080000", "headline": "Amazon's Growth Is Slowing: Why That's No Reason to Worry", "summary": "The deceleration is mostly contained in its less profitable segments.", "source": "The Motley Fool"}, {"date": "20210903080500", "headline": "Az Amazon bejelentette, hogy term\u00e9szetes alap\u00fa sz\u00e9n-dioxid-kivon\u00e1si megold\u00e1sokba fektet be Braz\u00edli\u00e1ban a The Nature Conservancy-val egy\u00fcttm\u0171k\u00f6dve", "summary": "SEATTLE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Az Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN) szeptember 2-\u00e1n bejelentette, hogy a kl\u00edmav\u00e1ls\u00e1g megold\u00e1s\u00e1t szolg\u00e1l\u00f3 glob\u00e1lis er\u0151fesz\u00edt\u00e9seket t\u00e1mogat\u00f3 tev\u00e9kenys\u00e9gei r\u00e9szek\u00e9nt a glob\u00e1lis k\u00f6rnyezetv\u00e9delmi szervezettel, a The Nature Conservancy-val egy\u00fcttm\u0171k\u00f6d\u00e9sben elind\u00edtja az agr\u00e1rerd\u00e9szet elterjeszt\u00e9s\u00e9t \u00e9s a term\u00e9szeti k\u00f6rnyezet helyre\u00e1ll\u00edt\u00e1s\u00e1t felgyors\u00edt\u00f3, Agroforestry and Restoration Accelerator elnevez\u00e9s\u0171 programj\u00e1t. Az Accelerator program fenntarthat\u00f3bb bev\u00e9teli forr\u00e1st hoz l\u00e9tre t\u00f6bb ezer helyi gazd\u00e1lkod\u00f3 sz\u00e1m\u00e1ra a braz\u00edliai Amazonas-medenc\u00e9ben tal\u00e1lhat\u00f3 Par\u00e1 \u00e1llamban, \u00e9s ugyanakkor a sz\u00e9n-dioxid elfog\u00e1sa \u00e9s t\u00e1rol\u00e1sa r\u00e9v\u00e9n hozz\u00e1j\u00e1rul a helyi es\u0151erd\u0151k helyre\u00e1ll\u00edt\u00e1s\u00e1hoz \u00e9s a kl\u00edmav\u00e1ltoz\u00e1s elleni k\u00fczdelemhez. Az \u00c9ghajlatv\u00e1ltoz\u00e1si Korm\u00e1nyk\u00f6zi Test\u00fclet (Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change [IPCC]) szerint a term\u00e9szetes m\u00f3dszereket alkalmaz\u00f3 megold\u00e1sok kulcsfontoss\u00e1g\u00fa szerepet j\u00e1tszanak a kl\u00edmav\u00e1ltoz\u00e1s legrosszabb hat\u00e1sainak elker\u00fcl\u00e9se ter\u00e9n. A korm\u00e1nyzatok \u00e9s a mag\u00e1nszektor egyar\u00e1nt cs\u00f6kkenthetik a sz\u00e9n-dioxid-kibocs\u00e1t\u00e1st \u00e9s elt\u00e1vol\u00edthatj\u00e1k a sz\u00e9n-dioxidot a l\u00e9gk\u00f6rb\u0151l, amennyiben megfelel\u0151 m\u00e9rt\u00e9k\u0171 befektet\u00e9seket eszk\u00f6z\u00f6lnek term\u00e9szetes m\u00f3dszereket alkalmaz\u00f3 megold\u00e1sokba. Az Agroforestry and Restoration Accelerator program is egy ilyen, a sz\u00e9n-dioxid kivon\u00e1s\u00e1t c\u00e9lz\u00f3 projekt, mely az Amazon \u00e9s a Global Optimism \u00e1ltal k\u00f6z\u00f6sen l\u00e9trehozott The Climate Pledge program keret\u00e9ben az Amazon \u00e1ltal tett k\u00f6telezetts\u00e9gv\u00e1llal\u00e1sok teljes\u00edt\u00e9s\u00e9t c\u00e9lozza. A The Climate Pledge meg\u00e1llapod\u00e1s al\u00e1\u00edr\u00f3i k\u00f6telezetts\u00e9get v\u00e1llalnak arra, hogy a P\u00e1rizsi Meg\u00e1llapod\u00e1s c\u00e9lkit\u0171z\u00e9sei k\u00f6zt szerepl\u0151 karbonsemlegess\u00e9get (azaz a nett\u00f3 nulla sz\u00e9n-dioxid-kibocs\u00e1t\u00e1st) a P\u00e1rizsi Meg\u00e1llapod\u00e1sban meghat\u00e1rozott id\u0151pontn\u00e1l 10 \u00e9vvel kor\u00e1bban, 2040-re \u00e9rik el. A The Climate Pledge program keret\u00e9ben v\u00e1llalt k\u00f6telezetts\u00e9ge teljes\u00edt\u00e9se \u00e9rdek\u00e9ben az Amazon els\u0151sorban tov\u00e1bb folytatja az innovat\u00edv megold\u00e1sok keres\u00e9s\u00e9t \u00e9s \u00fczleti egys\u00e9gei tev\u00e9kenys\u00e9ge karbonsemlegess\u00e9g\u00e9nek megval\u00f3s\u00edt\u00e1s\u00e1t. A v\u00e1llalat 100 000 elektromos sz\u00e1ll\u00edt\u00f3j\u00e1rm\u0171vet v\u00e1s\u00e1rolt, \u00e9s a vil\u00e1gon az egyik legt\u00f6bb meg\u00fajul\u00f3 energi\u00e1t v\u00e1s\u00e1rl\u00f3 c\u00e9g. Az Amazon ugyanakkor saj\u00e1t \u00e9rt\u00e9kl\u00e1nc\u00e1n k\u00edv\u00fcl is befektet term\u00e9szetes m\u00f3dszereket alkalmaz\u00f3 megold\u00e1sokba a Right Now Climate Fund elnevez\u00e9s\u0171 alapon kereszt\u00fcl, amely az Accelerator programot is t\u00e1mogatja, tov\u00e1bb\u00e1 olyan, a leromlott f\u00f6ldter\u00fcletek rehabilit\u00e1l\u00e1s\u00e1t c\u00e9lz\u00f3 projekteket hajt v\u00e9gre, amelyek ugyanakkor a helyi k\u00f6z\u00f6ss\u00e9gek meg\u00e9lhet\u00e9s\u00e9t is jav\u00edtj\u00e1k, illetve hozz\u00e1j\u00e1rulnak a sz\u00e9n-dioxid l\u00e9gk\u00f6rb\u0151l val\u00f3 kivon\u00e1s\u00e1hoz. Ezen fel\u00fcl a nemr\u00e9giben bejelentett LEAF Coalition nevet visel\u0151, \u00e1llami \u00e9s mag\u00e1nszektorbeli szervezetek \u00e1ltal a vil\u00e1g tr\u00f3pusi erdeinek v\u00e9delme \u00e9rdek\u00e9ben legal\u00e1bb 1 milli\u00e1rd USA doll\u00e1r felhaszn\u00e1l\u00e1s\u00e1t c\u00e9lz\u00f3, k\u00f6z\u00f6sen elind\u00edtott kezdem\u00e9nyez\u00e9s keret\u00e9ben az Amazon \u00e9s partnerei egy\u00fcttm\u0171k\u00f6dnek a tr\u00f3pusi erd\u0151k irt\u00e1s\u00e1nak meg\u00e1ll\u00edt\u00e1sa \u00e9s a l\u00e9gk\u00f6rbe kibocs\u00e1tott sz\u00e9n-dioxid mennyis\u00e9g\u00e9nek cs\u00f6kkent\u00e9se \u00e9rdek\u00e9ben. \u201eA vil\u00e1g erd\u0151inek helyre\u00e1ll\u00edt\u00e1sa az egyik legnagyobb jelent\u0151s\u00e9g\u0171 l\u00e9p\u00e9s, amit most megtehet\u00fcnk az \u00e9ghajlatv\u00e1ltoz\u00e1s meg\u00e1ll\u00edt\u00e1sa \u00e9rdek\u00e9ben, de ahhoz, hogy sikereket \u00e9rhess\u00fcnk el e t\u00e9ren, innovat\u00edv megold\u00e1sokra van sz\u00fcks\u00e9g\u201d \u2013 jelentette ki Kara Hurst, az Amazon glob\u00e1lis fenntarthat\u00f3s\u00e1g\u00e9rt felel\u0151s aleln\u00f6ke. \u201eB\u00fcszk\u00e9k vagyunk arra, hogy a The Nature Conservancy-val egy\u00fcttm\u0171k\u00f6dve elind\u00edtottuk az Agroforestry and Restoration Accelerator programot olyan megold\u00e1sok azonos\u00edt\u00e1sa \u00e9s t\u00e1mogat\u00e1sa c\u00e9lj\u00e1b\u00f3l, amelyek term\u00e9szetes m\u00f3dszereket alkalmaznak \u00e9s a k\u00f6z\u00f6ss\u00e9gek sz\u00e1m\u00e1ra is jelent\u0151s el\u0151ny\u00f6ket biztos\u00edtanak. Az Amazon \u00f6r\u00f6mmel v\u00e1rja, hogy az innov\u00e1ci\u00f3 ir\u00e1nti szenved\u00e9ly\u00e9t latba vetve \u00e9s p\u00e9nz\u00fcgyi t\u00e1mogat\u00e1st is ny\u00fajtva jav\u00edthassa a braz\u00edliai helyi k\u00f6z\u00f6ss\u00e9gek meg\u00e9lhet\u00e9s\u00e9t \u00e9s ugyanakkor seg\u00edthessen bolyg\u00f3nknak a k\u00f6vetkez\u0151 gener\u00e1ci\u00f3k sz\u00e1m\u00e1ra val\u00f3 meg\u0151rz\u00e9s\u00e9ben.\u201d \u201eA szakemberek minden k\u00e9ts\u00e9get kiz\u00e1r\u00f3an r\u00e1mutattak, hogy a term\u00e9szeti rendszerek j\u00e1tssz\u00e1k a legfontosabb szerepet a sz\u00e9n-dioxid leveg\u0151b\u0151l val\u00f3 elt\u00e1vol\u00edt\u00e1s\u00e1ban, \u00e9s ezt az IPCC legut\u00f3bbi jelent\u00e9se is al\u00e1t\u00e1masztja\u201d - magyar\u00e1zta Christiana Figueres, az Egyes\u00fclt Nemzetek Szervezet\u00e9nek P\u00e1rizsi Meg\u00e1llapod\u00e1s\u00e9rt felel\u0151s kor\u00e1bbi vezet\u0151je, a Global Optimism t\u00e1rsalap\u00edt\u00f3ja. \u201eAz \u00e9l\u0151, t\u00e1panyagban gazdag \u00f6kosziszt\u00e9m\u00e1k v\u00e9delme \u00e9s a leromlott f\u00f6ldter\u00fcletek helyre\u00e1ll\u00edt\u00e1sa kulcsfontoss\u00e1g\u00fa sz\u00e9n-dioxid-cs\u00f6kkent\u00e9si strat\u00e9gia lesz, k\u00fcl\u00f6n\u00f6sen az elk\u00f6vetkezend\u0151 egy vagy k\u00e9t \u00e9vtizedben. A term\u00e9szet fenntart\u00e1s\u00e1nak \u00e9s a helyi k\u00f6z\u00f6ss\u00e9gek meg\u00e9lhet\u00e9s\u00e9nek t\u00e1mogat\u00e1sa \u00e9rdek\u00e9ben ezeket a c\u00e9lokat megval\u00f3s\u00edt\u00f3 projektek rendk\u00edv\u00fcl \u00e9rt\u00e9kesek a kl\u00edmav\u00e1ls\u00e1g idej\u00e9n \u00e9s azt k\u00f6vet\u0151en is az \u00e9let felvir\u00e1goztat\u00e1s\u00e1hoz sz\u00fcks\u00e9ges \u00e1talakul\u00e1s szempontj\u00e1b\u00f3l. PressReleases: [{"date": "2021-09-03 02:13:00", "headline": "AMAZON ANUNCIA INVESTIMENTO EM SOLU\u00c7\u00d5ES DE REMO\u00c7\u00c3O DE CARBONO BASEADAS NA NATUREZA NO BRASIL COM A THE NATURE CONSERVANCY", "description": "SEATTLE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--COMO PARTE DESTE ESFOR\u00c7O PARA APOIAR SOLU\u00c7\u00d5ES GLOBAIS PARA A CRISE CLIM\u00c1TICA, A AMAZON (NASDAQ: AMZN) ANUNCIOU HOJE O LAN\u00c7AMENTO DO ACELERADOR DE AGROSSILVICULTURA E RESTAURA\u00c7\u00c3O EM PARCERIA COM A THE NATURE CONSERVANCY, UMA ORGANIZA\u00c7\u00c3O AMBIENTAL GLOBAL. O ACELERADOR CRIAR\u00c1 UMA FONTE DE RENDA MAIS SUSTENT\u00c1VEL PARA MILHARES DE AGRICULTORES LOCAIS NO ESTADO AMAZONENSE BRASILEIRO DO PAR\u00c1, ENQUANTO TAMB\u00c9M RESTAURA FLORESTAS NATIVAS E COMBATE MUDAN\u00c7AS CLIM\u00c1TICAS CAPTURANDO E ARMAZENANDO CARBONO NATURALMENTE. DE ACORDO COM O PAINEL INTERGOVERNAMENTAL SOBRE A MUDAN\u00c7A CLIM\u00c1TICA, SOLU\u00c7\u00d5ES BASEADAS NA NATUREZA EXERCEM UM PAPEL CR\u00cdTICO PARA EVITAR OS PIORES EFEITOS DAS MUDAN\u00c7AS CLIM\u00c1TICAS. GOVERNOS E O SETOR PRIVADO PODEM REDUZIR AS EMISS\u00d5ES DE CARBONO E REMOVER CARBONO DA ATMOSFERA INVESTINDO EM SOLU\u00c7\u00d5ES BASEADAS NA NATUREZA EM ESCALA. O ACELERADOR DE AGROSSILVICULTURA E RESTAURA\u00c7\u00c3O \u00c9 UM DESSES PROJETOS DE REMO\u00c7\u00c3O DE CARBONO, E PARTE DO COMPROMISSO DA AMAZON PARA CUMPRIR O THE CLIMATE PLEDGE, QUE A EMPRESA FUNDOU EM COLABORA\u00c7\u00c3O COM A GLOBAL OPTIMISM. OS SIGNAT\u00c1RIOS DO ACORDO COMPROMETERAM-SE EM ALCAN\u00c7AR CARBONO ZERO L\u00cdQUIDO AT\u00c9 2040 \u2013 10 ANOS ANTES DO ACORDO DE PARIS. COMO PARTE DO SEU COMPROMISSO PARA CUMPRIR O THE CLIMATE PLEDGE, A AMAZON EST\u00c1, ANTES DE MAIS NADA, CONTINUANDO A INOVAR E INVESTIR NA DESCARBONIZA\u00c7\u00c3O DE SEUS NEG\u00d3CIOS. A EMPRESA ADQUIRIU 100 MIL VE\u00cdCULOS EL\u00c9TRICOS DE ENTREGA, E \u00c9 A MAIOR COMPRADORA CORPORATIVA DE ENERGIA RENOV\u00c1VEL NO MUNDO. A AMAZON TAMB\u00c9M EST\u00c1 INVESTINDO EM SOLU\u00c7\u00d5ES BASEADAS NA NATUREZA FORA DA SUA CADEIA DE VALOR ATRAV\u00c9S DO RIGHT NOW CLIMATE FUND, QUE APOIA O ACELERADOR E OUTROS PROJETOS PARA RESTAURAR TERRAS DEGRADADAS DE MODO A MELHORAR A VIDA DE COMUNIDADES LOCAIS E REMOVER CARBONO DA ATMOSFERA. AL\u00c9M DISSO, ATRAV\u00c9S DA REC\u00c9M-ANUNCIADA LEAF COALITION \u2013 UMA INICIATIVA P\u00daBLICO-PRIVADA PARA MOBILIZAR PELO MENOS US$ 1 BILH\u00c3O PARA PROTEGER AS FLORESTAS TROPICAIS DO MUNDO \u2013 A AMAZON E OUTROS PARCEIROS EST\u00c3O TRABALHANDO PARA CONTER O DESMATAMENTO TROPICAL, REDUZINDO A QUANTIDADE DE CARBONO EMITIDO PARA A ATMOSFERA. \u201cRESTAURAR AS FLORESTAS DO MUNDO \u00c9 UMA DAS A\u00c7\u00d5ES MAIS SIGNIFICATIVAS QUE PODEMOS TOMAR AGORA PARA TRATAR DAS MUDAN\u00c7AS CLIM\u00c1TICAS, E EXIGIR\u00c1 SOLU\u00c7\u00d5ES INOVADORAS PARA ALCAN\u00c7ARMOS O SUCESSO\u201d, DISSE KARA HURST, VICE-PRESIDENTE DE SUSTENTABILIDADE MUNDIAL NA AMAZON. \u201cESTAMOS ORGULHOSOS POR LAN\u00c7AR O ACELERADOR DE AGROSSILVICULTURA E RESTAURA\u00c7\u00c3O COM A THE NATURE CONSERVANCY PARA APOIAR SOLU\u00c7\u00d5ES QUE PRIORIZAM A ALTA INTEGRIDADE AMBIENTAL E FORTES BENEF\u00cdCIOS PARA A COMUNIDADE. A AMAZON ESPERA CONTRIBUIR COM NOSSA PAIX\u00c3O PELA INOVA\u00c7\u00c3O JUNTAMENTE COM SUPORTE FINANCEIRO PARA MELHORAR AS VIDAS DE COMUNIDADES LOCAIS NO BRASIL, ENQUANTO AJUDA A PROTEGER O PLANETA PARA GERA\u00c7\u00d5ES FUTURAS.\u201d \u201cA CI\u00caNCIA \u00c9 INEQU\u00cdVOCA EM RELA\u00c7\u00c3O A SISTEMAS NATURAIS COMO A PRIORIDADE PARA ABSORVER O CARBONO DA ATMOSFERA E O MAIS RECENTE RELAT\u00d3RIO DO PAINEL INTERNACIONAL SOBRE MUDAN\u00c7A CLIM\u00c1TICA (INTERNATIONAL PANEL ON CLIMATE CHANGE, IPCC) DESTACA ISSO\u201d, DISSE CHRISTIANA FIGUERES, CO-FUNDADORA DA GLOBAL OPTIMISM E EX-CHEFE DO CLIMA DA ONU, RESPONS\u00c1VEL PELO ACORDO DE PARIS. \u201cPROTEGER ECOSSISTEMAS EXISTENTES E RESTAURAR TERRAS DEGRADADAS \u00c9 T\u00c3O CR\u00cdTICO QUANTO ESTRAT\u00c9GIAS DE MITIGA\u00c7\u00c3O DE CARBONO, ESPECIALMENTE NA PR\u00d3XIMA D\u00c9CADA OU DUAS. PROJETOS QUE ALCANCEM ISTO PARA SUSTENTAR TANTO A NATUREZA QUANTO AS VIDAS DA COMUNIDADE LOCAL S\u00c3O INESTIM\u00c1VEIS PARA A TRANSFORMA\u00c7\u00c3O NECESS\u00c1RIA PARA PROSPERAR MUITO AL\u00c9M DA CRISE CLIM\u00c1TICA. APLAUSOS PARA A AMAZON E A THE NATURE CONSERVANCY.\u201d O INVESTIMENTO INICIAL DA AMAZON NO ACELERADOR APOIAR\u00c1 3.000 AGRICULTORES E RESTAURAR\u00c1 APROXIMADAMENTE 20.000 HECTARES \u2013 UMA \u00c1REA DE TERRA DO TAMANHO DA CIDADE DE SEATTLE APROXIMADAMENTE \u2013 DENTRO DE TR\u00caS ANOS, REMOVENDO AT\u00c9 10 MILH\u00d5ES DE TONELADAS M\u00c9TRICAS DE DI\u00d3XIDO DE CARBONO DA ATMOSFERA AT\u00c9 2050. ZU DEN 86 NEUEN UNTERZEICHNERN, DIE THE CLIMATE PLEDGE BEITRETEN, GEH\u00d6REN PROCTER & GAMBLE, HP, SALESFORCE, ASOS UND NESPRESSO. DIE UNTERZEICHNER DER VERPFLICHTUNGSERKL\u00c4RUNG ERWIRTSCHAFTEN INSGESAMT EINEN WELTWEITEN JAHRESUMSATZ VON \u00dcBER 1,8 BILLIONEN USD UND HABEN MEHR ALS 7 MILLIONEN MITARBEITER IN 26 BRANCHEN IN 21 L\u00c4NDERN. DURCH DAS ERREICHEN VON NETTO-KOHLENSTOFFAUSSTOSS VON NULL BIS 2040, ALSO 10 JAHRE VOR DEM PARISER ABKOMMEN, WIRD ERWARTET, DASS DIE DERZEITIGEN UNTERZEICHNER DES CLIMATE PLEDGE KOLLEKTIV 1,98 MILLIARDEN TONNEN DER CO2-EMISSIONEN GEGEN\u00dcBER EINEM AUSGANGSWERT VON 2020 VERRINGERN WERDEN. DIES ENTSPRICHT 5,4 % DER DERZEITIGEN WELTWEITEN J\u00c4HRLICHEN EMISSIONEN \u2013 EIN BELEG F\u00dcR DIE KOLLEKTIVEN AUSWIRKUNGEN, DIE THE CLIMATE PLEDGE BEI DER BEK\u00c4MPFUNG DES KLIMAWANDELS HABEN UND ZU MEHR MASSNAHMEN ZUR BEW\u00c4LTIGUNG DER KLIMAKRISE ANREGEN WIRD. DIE UNTERZEICHNER VON THE CLIMATE PLEDGE STIMMEN ZU: TREIBHAUSGASEMISSIONEN REGELM\u00c4SSIG ZU MESSEN UND DAR\u00dcBER ZU BERICHTEN. DEKARBONISIERUNGSSTRATEGIEN IM EINKLANG MIT DEM \u00dcBEREINKOMMEN VON PARIS DURCH ECHTE GESCH\u00c4FTLICHE VER\u00c4NDERUNGEN UND INNOVATIONEN UMZUSETZEN, EINSCHLIESSLICH EFFIZIENZSTEIGERUNGEN, ERNEUERBARER ENERGIEN, MATERIALREDUZIERUNGEN UND ANDERER STRATEGIEN ZUR BESEITIGUNG VON CO2-EMISSIONEN. 2020)\u7ed3\u675f\u3002\u6b64\u6218\u7565\u4e8e2015\u5e74\u5ba3\u5e03\uff0c\u8bbe\u5b9a\u4e86\u81f32020\u5e74\u6bcf\u5e74\u51cf\u5c11\u8fd0\u8425\u78b3\u6392\u653e\u7684\u76ee\u6807\u3002\u8fd9\u4e2a\u9879\u76ee\u975e\u5e38\u6210\u529f\uff0c\u56e0\u4e3aASOS\u6bcf\u5e74\u90fd\u5728\u51cf\u5c11\u6392\u653e\uff0c\u5e76\u5728\u6b64\u8fc7\u7a0b\u4e2d\u51cf\u5c11\u4e8630%\u7684\u6392\u653e\u5f3a\u5ea6\u3002\u8fd9\u76f8\u5f53\u4e8e\u907f\u514d\u4e86\u603b\u8ba1\u8fbe11\u4e07\u5428\u7684\u78b3\u6392\u653e\u3002ASOS\u6b63\u4e0d\u65ad\u52aa\u529b\u4f7f\u5176\u8fd0\u8425\u8131\u78b3\uff0c\u4f8b\u5982\u901a\u8fc7\u4f18\u5148\u8003\u8651\u6d77\u4e0a\u3001\u516c\u8def\u548c\u94c1\u8def\u8d27\u8fd0\uff0c\u5e76\u4e0e\u4f9b\u5e94\u94fe\u4f19\u4f34\u5408\u4f5c\uff0c\u4ee5\u63a8\u8fdb\u4f4e\u78b3\u521b\u65b0\u3002\u8fd9\u4e9b\u52aa\u529b\u5305\u62ec\u4f7f\u7528\u7535\u52a8\u6c7d\u8f66\u9001\u8d27\uff0c\u5728ASOS\u7684\u529e\u516c\u5ba4\u7ec4\u5408\u4e2d\u5b9e\u65bd100%\u53ef\u518d\u751f\u80fd\u6e90\uff0c\u4ee5\u53ca\u6700\u5927\u9650\u5ea6\u5730\u56de\u6536\u5305\u88c5\u5185\u5bb9\u3002\u968f\u7740\u201c\u78b32020\u201d\u5373\u5c06\u7ed3\u675f\uff0cASOS\u6b63\u5728\u5236\u5b9a\u66f4\u5b8f\u5927\u7684\u957f\u671f\u76ee\u6807\uff0c\u4ee5\u51cf\u5c11\u5176\u78b3\u8db3\u8ff9\u3002 \u4eca\u5e74\u65e9\u4e9b\u65f6\u5019\uff0c\u60e0\u666e\u516c\u53f8\u53d1\u5e03\u4e86\u4e00\u7cfb\u5217\u96c4\u5fc3\u52c3\u52c3\u7684\u6c14\u5019\u627f\u8bfa\u3002\u52302040\u5e74\uff0c\u516c\u53f8\u7684\u6574\u4e2a\u4ef7\u503c\u94fe\uff08\u4ece\u8fd0\u8425\u5230\u4ea7\u54c1\uff0c\u518d\u5230\u5168\u7403\u4f9b\u5e94\u94fe\uff09\u5c06\u5b9e\u73b0\u78b3\u548c\u5176\u4ed6\u6e29\u5ba4\u6c14\u4f53\u7684\u51c0\u96f6\u6392\u653e\uff0c\u5305\u62ec\u81f32030\u5e74\u65f650%\u7684\u7edd\u5bf9\u51cf\u6392\uff08\u4e0e2019\u5e74\u76f8\u6bd4\uff09\u3002\u603b\u4f53\u800c\u8a00\uff0c\u60e0\u666e\u4e13\u6ce8\u4e8e\u52a0\u901f\u6218\u7565\uff0c\u65e8\u5728\u5c06\u4e1a\u52a1\u589e\u957f\u4e0e\u78b3\u6392\u653e\u548c\u8d44\u6e90\u6d88\u8017\u8131\u94a9\uff0c\u63a8\u52a8\u521b\u65b0\uff0c\u5e76\u6539\u53d8\u8bbe\u8ba1\u548c\u5546\u4e1a\u6a21\u5f0f\u3002\u5177\u4f53\u63aa\u65bd\u5305\u62ec\u5c06\u6253\u5370\u548c\u8ba1\u7b97\u673a\u4f5c\u4e3a\u670d\u52a1\u3001\u53ef\u6301\u7eed\u6750\u6599\u3001\u4f9b\u5e94\u94fe\u5408\u4f5c\u3001\u5bf9\u53ef\u518d\u751f\u7535\u529b\u7684\u6295\u8d44\u4ee5\u53ca\u4ea7\u54c1\u80fd\u6e90\u6548\u7387\u7684\u63d0\u9ad8\u7b49\u3002 \u5948\u65af\u6d3e\u7d22\u4ee5\u5176\u4ece\u5496\u5561\u8c46\u3001\u5496\u5561\u80f6\u56ca\u5230\u5496\u5561\u676f\u7684\u4e13\u4e1a\u77e5\u8bc6\u800c\u95fb\u540d\uff0c\u8be5\u516c\u53f8\u975e\u5e38\u81ea\u8c6a\u80fd\u591f\u5728\u6574\u4e2a\u4ef7\u503c\u94fe\u4e2d\u4f18\u5148\u8003\u8651\u8d1f\u8d23\u4efb\u548c\u53ef\u6301\u7eed\u7684\u5b9e\u8df5\uff0c\u540c\u65f6\u5728\u5176\u63d0\u4f9b\u7684\u4ea7\u54c1\u548c\u670d\u52a1\u4e2d\u79c9\u6301\u6700\u4e25\u683c\u7684\u8d28\u91cf\u6807\u51c6\u3002\u6bcf\u676f\u5496\u5561\u90fd\u6709\u78b3\u8db3\u8ff9\uff0c\u8fd9\u662f\u5176\u6574\u4e2a\u751f\u547d\u5468\u671f\uff08\u4ece\u519c\u573a\u5230\u751f\u547d\u7ed3\u675f\uff09\u7684\u6240\u6709\u6d3b\u52a8\u9020\u6210\u7684\u3002\u81ea2009\u5e74\u4ee5\u6765\uff0c\u5948\u65af\u6d3e\u7d22\u7684\u6c14\u5019\u8def\u7ebf\u56fe\u4e00\u76f4\u4e13\u6ce8\u4e8e\u5f00\u53d1\u89e3\u51b3\u65b9\u6848\uff0c\u51cf\u5c11\u4e0a\u8ff0\u751f\u547d\u5468\u671f\u5185\u7279\u5b9a\u6d3b\u52a8\u7684\u6e29\u5ba4\u6c14\u4f53\u6392\u653e\u3002\u516c\u53f8\u7684\u76ee\u6807\u662f\u5e26\u6765\u91cd\u5927\u5f71\u54cd\u7684\u6d3b\u52a8\uff0c\u65e0\u8bba\u662f\u5426\u5904\u4e8e\u5176\u76f4\u63a5\u63a7\u5236\u7684\u8303\u56f4\u4e4b\u5185\u3002\u4ece\u673a\u5668\u80fd\u6e90\u6548\u7387\u5230\u53ef\u518d\u751f\u80fd\u6e90\uff0c\u4ece\u53ef\u6301\u7eed\u519c\u4e1a\u5b9e\u8df5\u5230\u5faa\u73af\u5229\u7528\uff0c\u516c\u53f8\u5728\u8fd9\u4e9b\u65b9\u9762\u6240\u505a\u7684\u5de5\u4f5c\u5df2\u7ecf\u51cf\u5c11\u4e86\u6bcf\u4e00\u676f\u5948\u65af\u6d3e\u7d22\u5496\u5561\u7684\u78b3\u8db3\u8ff9\u30022020\u5e749\u6708\uff0c\u5948\u65af\u6d3e\u7d22\u5ba3\u5e03\u4e86\u516c\u53f8\u5e94\u5bf9\u6c14\u5019\u53d8\u5316\u4e4b\u65c5\u4e2d\u7684\u4e00\u9879\u91cd\u5927\u91cc\u7a0b\u7891\uff1a\u52302022\u5e74\uff0c\u5bb6\u5ead\u548c\u4e13\u4e1a\u573a\u6240\u7684\u6bcf\u4e00\u676f\u5948\u65af\u6d3e\u7d22\u5496\u5561\u90fd\u5c06\u8fbe\u5230\u78b3\u4e2d\u548c\u3002\u8fd9\u4e00\u627f\u8bfa\u5efa\u7acb\u5728\u516c\u53f8\u4e3a\u51cf\u5c11\u6bcf\u676f\u5496\u5561\u6392\u653e\u91cf\u6240\u91c7\u53d6\u7684\u6301\u7eed\u884c\u52a8\u7684\u57fa\u7840\u4e4b\u4e0a\uff0c\u4e0e2009\u5e74\u7684\u751f\u547d\u5468\u671f\u8bc4\u4f30\u7814\u7a76\u76f8\u6bd4\uff0c\u5176\u6392\u653e\u91cf\u51cf\u5c11\u4e8624%\u3002\u5728\u7535\u529b\u65b9\u9762\uff0c\u53ef\u518d\u751f\u80fd\u6e90\u5360\u5948\u65af\u6d3e\u7d22\u5de5\u5382\u6240\u4f7f\u7528\u7535\u529b\u7684100%\u3002 \u5b9d\u6d01(P&G) \u5b9d\u6d01\u62e5\u6709\u4e16\u754c\u77e5\u540d\u4e14\u503c\u5f97\u4fe1\u8d56\u7684\u4f18\u8d28\u9886\u5bfc\u54c1\u724c\u7ec4\u5408\uff0c\u4e3a\u5168\u740350\u4ebf\u6d88\u8d39\u8005\u63d0\u4f9b\u670d\u52a1\u30022007\u5e74\uff0c\u5b9d\u6d01\u5236\u5b9a\u4e86\u51cf\u5c11\u5176\u751f\u4ea7\u8bbe\u65bd\u4e2d\u7684\u6e29\u5ba4\u6c14\u4f53(GHG)\u6392\u653e\u7684\u9996\u4e2a\u76ee\u6807\u3002\u5982\u4eca\u5b9d\u6d01\u5df2\u6269\u5927\u5e76\u52a0\u901f\u4e86\u76f8\u5173\u5de5\u4f5c\uff0c\u4ee5\u89e3\u51b3\u6574\u4e2a\u4ea7\u54c1\u548c\u8fd0\u8425\u751f\u547d\u5468\u671f\u7684\u6e29\u5ba4\u6c14\u4f53\u6392\u653e\u3002\u81ea2010\u5e74\u4ee5\u6765\uff0c\u5b9d\u6d01\u5c06\u5168\u7403\u4e1a\u52a1\u7684\u7edd\u5bf9\u6392\u653e\u51cf\u5c11\u4e8652%\u3002\u516c\u53f8\u8fd8\u5c06\u53ef\u518d\u751f\u7535\u529b\u7684\u8d2d\u4e70\u91cf\u589e\u52a0\u4e8697%\uff0c\u5e76\u4e0e\u6d88\u8d39\u8005\u5408\u4f5c\uff0c\u5229\u7528\u6c70\u6e0d\u548c\u78a7\u6d6a\u7b49\u4ea7\u54c1\uff0c\u5728\u5bb6\u91cc\u8f7b\u677e\u4e3a\u53ef\u6301\u7eed\u53d1\u5c55\u505a\u51fa\u8d21\u732e\uff0c\u901a\u8fc7\u51b7\u6c34\u6d17\u6da4\u5e2e\u52a9\u51cf\u5c11\u4e861500\u4e07\u5428\u7684\u78b3\u6392\u653e\u3002\u5b9d\u6d01\u6700\u8fd1\u5ba3\u5e03\u5c06\u52a0\u901f\u63a8\u8fdb\u8fd9\u65b9\u9762\u7684\u8fdb\u5c55\uff0c\u8bbe\u5b9a\u4e86\u52302040\u5e74\u5b9e\u73b0\u4ece\u539f\u6750\u6599\u5230\u96f6\u552e\u5546\u7684\u8fd0\u8425\u3001\u8fd0\u8f93\u548c\u4f9b\u5e94\u94fe\u51c0\u96f6\u6392\u653e\u7684\u8fdc\u5927\u76ee\u6807\u3002\u8fd9\u9879\u6781\u5bcc\u96c4\u5fc3\u7684\u51c0\u96f6\u78b3\u76ee\u6807\u518d\u6b21\u8bc1\u660e\u5b9d\u6d01\u73b0\u5728\u5df2\u5c06\u51cf\u5c11\u6392\u653e\u4f5c\u4e3a\u4f18\u5148\u4e8b\u9879\uff0c\u5728\u4f7f\u7528\u73b0\u6709\u5de5\u5177\u7684\u540c\u65f6\u9762\u5411\u66f4\u73af\u4fdd\u7684\u672a\u6765\u8fdb\u884c\u521b\u65b0\u3002 2020)\u7d50\u675f\u3002\u6b64\u7b56\u7565\u65bc2015\u5e74\u5ba3\u5e03\uff0c\u8a2d\u5b9a\u4e86\u81f32020\u5e74\u6bcf\u5e74\u6e1b\u5c11\u71df\u904b\u78b3\u6392\u653e\u7684\u76ee\u6a19\u3002\u9019\u500b\u5c08\u6848\u975e\u5e38\u6210\u529f\uff0c\u56e0\u70baASOS\u6bcf\u5e74\u90fd\u5728\u6e1b\u5c11\u6392\u653e\uff0c\u4e26\u5728\u6b64\u904e\u7a0b\u4e2d\u6e1b\u5c11\u4e8630%\u7684\u6392\u653e\u5f37\u5ea6\u3002\u9019\u76f8\u7576\u65bc\u907f\u514d\u4e86\u7e3d\u8a08\u905411\u842c\u5678\u7684\u78b3\u6392\u653e\u3002ASOS\u6b63\u4e0d\u65b7\u52aa\u529b\u4f7f\u5176\u71df\u904b\u812b\u78b3\uff0c\u4f8b\u5982\u900f\u904e\u512a\u5148\u8003\u616e\u6d77\u4e0a\u3001\u516c\u8def\u548c\u9435\u8def\u8ca8\u904b\uff0c\u4e26\u8207\u4f9b\u61c9\u93c8\u5925\u4f34\u5408\u4f5c\uff0c\u4ee5\u63a8\u52d5\u4f4e\u78b3\u5275\u65b0\u3002\u9019\u4e9b\u52aa\u529b\u5305\u62ec\u4f7f\u7528\u96fb\u52d5\u6c7d\u8eca\u9001\u8ca8\uff0c\u5728ASOS\u7684\u8fa6\u516c\u5ba4\u7d44\u5408\u4e2d\u5be6\u65bd100%\u53ef\u518d\u751f\u80fd\u6e90\uff0c\u4ee5\u53ca\u6700\u5927\u9650\u5ea6\u5730\u56de\u6536\u5305\u88dd\u5167\u5bb9\u3002\u96a8\u8457\u300c\u78b32020\u300d\u5373\u5c07\u7d50\u675f\uff0cASOS\u6b63\u5728\u5236\u5b9a\u66f4\u5b8f\u5927\u7684\u9577\u671f\u76ee\u6a19\uff0c\u4ee5\u6e1b\u5c11\u5176\u78b3\u8db3\u8de1\u3002 \u60e0\u666e \u4eca\u5e74\u7a0d\u65e9\uff0c\u60e0\u666e\u516c\u53f8\u767c\u5e03\u4e86\u4e00\u7cfb\u5217\u96c4\u5fc3\u52c3\u52c3\u7684\u6c23\u5019\u627f\u8afe\u3002\u52302040\u5e74\uff0c\u516c\u53f8\u7684\u6574\u500b\u50f9\u503c\u93c8\uff08\u5f9e\u71df\u904b\u5230\u7522\u54c1\uff0c\u518d\u5230\u5168\u7403\u4f9b\u61c9\u93c8\uff09\u5c07\u5be6\u73fe\u78b3\u548c\u5176\u4ed6\u6eab\u5ba4\u6c23\u9ad4\u7684\u6de8\u96f6\u6392\u653e\uff0c\u5305\u62ec\u81f32030\u5e74\u664250%\u7684\u7d55\u5c0d\u6e1b\u6392\uff08\u82072019\u5e74\u76f8\u6bd4\uff09\u3002\u7e3d\u9ad4\u800c\u8a00\uff0c\u60e0\u666e\u5c08\u6ce8\u65bc\u52a0\u901f\u7b56\u7565\uff0c\u65e8\u5728\u5c07\u696d\u52d9\u6210\u9577\u8207\u78b3\u6392\u653e\u548c\u8cc7\u6e90\u6d88\u8017\u812b\u9264\uff0c\u63a8\u52d5\u5275\u65b0\uff0c\u4e26\u6539\u8b8a\u8a2d\u8a08\u548c\u5546\u696d\u6a21\u5f0f\u3002\u5177\u9ad4\u63aa\u65bd\u5305\u62ec\u5c07\u5217\u5370\u548c\u96fb\u8166\u4f5c\u70ba\u670d\u52d9\u3001\u6c38\u7e8c\u6750\u6599\u3001\u4f9b\u61c9\u93c8\u5408\u4f5c\u3001\u5c0d\u53ef\u518d\u751f\u96fb\u529b\u7684\u6295\u8cc7\u4ee5\u53ca\u7522\u54c1\u80fd\u6e90\u6548\u7387\u7684\u63d0\u9ad8\u7b49\u3002 Nespresso Nespresso\u4ee5\u5176\u5f9e\u5496\u5561\u8c46\u3001\u5496\u5561\u81a0\u56ca\u5230\u5496\u5561\u676f\u7684\u5c08\u696d\u77e5\u8b58\u800c\u805e\u540d\uff0c\u8a72\u516c\u53f8\u975e\u5e38\u81ea\u8c6a\u80fd\u5920\u5728\u6574\u500b\u50f9\u503c\u93c8\u4e2d\u512a\u5148\u8003\u616e\u8ca0\u8cac\u4efb\u548c\u6c38\u7e8c\u7684\u5be6\u8e10\uff0c\u540c\u6642\u5728\u5176\u63d0\u4f9b\u7684\u7522\u54c1\u548c\u670d\u52d9\u4e2d\u79c9\u6301\u6700\u56b4\u683c\u7684\u54c1\u8cea\u6a19\u6e96\u3002\u6bcf\u676f\u5496\u5561\u90fd\u6709\u78b3\u8db3\u8de1\uff0c\u9019\u662f\u5176\u6574\u500b\u751f\u547d\u9031\u671f\uff08\u5f9e\u8fb2\u5834\u5230\u751f\u547d\u7d50\u675f\uff09\u7684\u6240\u6709\u6d3b\u52d5\u9020\u6210\u7684\u3002\u81ea2009\u5e74\u4ee5\u4f86\uff0cNespresso\u7684\u6c23\u5019\u85cd\u5716\u4e00\u76f4\u5c08\u6ce8\u65bc\u958b\u767c\u89e3\u6c7a\u65b9\u6848\uff0c\u6e1b\u5c11\u4e0a\u8ff0\u751f\u547d\u9031\u671f\u5167\u7279\u5b9a\u6d3b\u52d5\u7684\u6eab\u5ba4\u6c23\u9ad4\u6392\u653e\u3002\u516c\u53f8\u7684\u76ee\u6a19\u662f\u5e36\u4f86\u91cd\u5927\u5f71\u97ff\u7684\u6d3b\u52d5\uff0c\u7121\u8ad6\u662f\u5426\u8655\u65bc\u5176\u76f4\u63a5\u63a7\u5236\u7684\u7bc4\u570d\u4e4b\u5167\u3002\u5f9e\u6a5f\u5668\u80fd\u6e90\u6548\u7387\u5230\u53ef\u518d\u751f\u80fd\u6e90\uff0c\u5f9e\u6c38\u7e8c\u8fb2\u696d\u5be6\u8e10\u5230\u5faa\u74b0\u5229\u7528\uff0c\u516c\u53f8\u5728\u9019\u4e9b\u65b9\u9762\u6240\u505a\u7684\u5de5\u4f5c\u5df2\u7d93\u6e1b\u5c11\u4e86\u6bcf\u4e00\u676fNespresso\u5496\u5561\u7684\u78b3\u8db3\u8de1\u30022020\u5e749\u6708\uff0cNespresso\u5ba3\u5e03\u4e86\u516c\u53f8\u56e0\u61c9\u6c23\u5019\u8b8a\u5316\u65c5\u9014\u4e2d\u7684\u4e00\u9805\u91cd\u5927\u91cc\u7a0b\u7891\uff1a\u52302022\u5e74\uff0c\u5bb6\u5ead\u548c\u5c08\u696d\u5834\u6240\u7684\u6bcf\u4e00\u676fNespresso\u5496\u5561\u90fd\u5c07\u9054\u5230\u78b3\u4e2d\u548c\u3002\u9019\u4e00\u627f\u8afe\u5efa\u7acb\u5728\u516c\u53f8\u70ba\u6e1b\u5c11\u6bcf\u676f\u5496\u5561\u6392\u653e\u91cf\u6240\u63a1\u53d6\u7684\u6301\u7e8c\u884c\u52d5\u7684\u57fa\u790e\u4e4b\u4e0a\uff0c\u82072009\u5e74\u7684\u751f\u547d\u9031\u671f\u8a55\u4f30\u7814\u7a76\u76f8\u6bd4\uff0c\u5176\u6392\u653e\u91cf\u6e1b\u5c11\u4e8624%\u3002\u5728\u96fb\u529b\u65b9\u9762\uff0c\u53ef\u518d\u751f\u80fd\u6e90\u5360Nespresso\u5de5\u5ee0\u6240\u4f7f\u7528\u96fb\u529b\u7684100%\u3002 \u5bf6\u50d1(P&G) \u5bf6\u50d1\u64c1\u6709\u4e16\u754c\u77e5\u540d\u4e14\u503c\u5f97\u4fe1\u8cf4\u7684\u512a\u8cea\u9818\u5c0e\u54c1\u724c\u7d44\u5408\uff0c\u70ba\u5168\u740350\u5104\u6d88\u8cbb\u8005\u63d0\u4f9b\u670d\u52d9\u30022007\u5e74\uff0c\u5bf6\u50d1\u5236\u5b9a\u4e86\u6e1b\u5c11\u5176\u751f\u7522\u8a2d\u65bd\u4e2d\u7684\u6eab\u5ba4\u6c23\u9ad4(GHG)\u6392\u653e\u7684\u9996\u500b\u76ee\u6a19\u3002\u5982\u4eca\u5bf6\u50d1\u5df2\u64f4\u5927\u4e26\u52a0\u901f\u4e86\u76f8\u95dc\u5de5\u4f5c\uff0c\u4ee5\u89e3\u6c7a\u6574\u500b\u7522\u54c1\u548c\u71df\u904b\u751f\u547d\u9031\u671f\u7684\u6eab\u5ba4\u6c23\u9ad4\u6392\u653e\u3002\u81ea2010\u5e74\u4ee5\u4f86\uff0c\u5bf6\u50d1\u5c07\u5168\u7403\u696d\u52d9\u7684\u7d55\u5c0d\u6392\u653e\u6e1b\u5c11\u4e8652%\u3002\u516c\u53f8\u9084\u5c07\u53ef\u518d\u751f\u96fb\u529b\u7684\u8cfc\u8cb7\u91cf\u589e\u52a0\u4e8697%\uff0c\u4e26\u8207\u6d88\u8cbb\u8005\u5408\u4f5c\uff0c\u5229\u7528\u6c70\u6f2c\u548c\u78a7\u6d6a\u7b49\u7522\u54c1\uff0c\u5728\u5bb6\u88e1\u8f15\u9b06\u70ba\u6c38\u7e8c\u767c\u5c55\u505a\u51fa\u8ca2\u737b\uff0c\u900f\u904e\u51b7\u6c34\u6d17\u6ecc\u5e6b\u52a9\u6e1b\u5c11\u4e861500\u842c\u5678\u7684\u78b3\u6392\u653e\u3002\u5bf6\u50d1\u6700\u8fd1\u5ba3\u5e03\u5c07\u52a0\u901f\u63a8\u52d5\u9019\u65b9\u9762\u7684\u9032\u5c55\uff0c\u8a2d\u5b9a\u4e86\u52302040\u5e74\u5be6\u73fe\u5f9e\u539f\u6750\u6599\u5230\u96f6\u552e\u5546\u7684\u71df\u904b\u3001\u904b\u8f38\u548c\u4f9b\u61c9\u93c8\u6de8\u96f6\u6392\u653e\u7684\u9060\u5927\u76ee\u6a19\u3002\u9019\u9805\u6975\u5bcc\u96c4\u5fc3\u7684\u6de8\u96f6\u78b3\u76ee\u6a19\u518d\u6b21\u8b49\u660e\u5bf6\u50d1\u73fe\u5728\u5df2\u5c07\u6e1b\u5c11\u6392\u653e\u4f5c\u70ba\u512a\u5148\u4e8b\u9805\uff0c\u5728\u4f7f\u7528\u73fe\u6709\u5de5\u5177\u7684\u540c\u6642\u9762\u5411\u66f4\u74b0\u4fdd\u7684\u672a\u4f86\u9032\u884c\u5275\u65b0\u3002 [{"date": "20210924193600", "headline": "AWS abrir\u00e1 centros de datos en Nueva Zelanda", "summary": "SEATTLE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Hoy, Amazon Web Services (AWS), una empresa de Amazon.com (NASDAQ: AMZN), anunci\u00f3 que planea abrir una regi\u00f3n de infraestructura en Aotearoa Nueva Zelanda en 2024. A nova infraestrutura da AWS nos ajudar\u00e1 a cumprir nossa vis\u00e3o, fornecer aos clientes acesso ainda mais r\u00e1pido a todos os nossos servi\u00e7os e sustentar nossa oferta da melhor experi\u00eancia digital para Kiwis por muitos anos.\u201d O Minist\u00e9rio da Justi\u00e7a Te T\u0101h o te Ture trabalha para ajudar a garantir que a Nova Zel\u00e2ndia seja um sociedade segura e justa. \u201cComo um servi\u00e7o essencial, os tribunais continuam lidando com os diversos lockdowns da COVID, e as restri\u00e7\u00f5es do que ainda \u00e9 um sistema amplamente baseado em pap\u00e9is destacaram a import\u00e2ncia da tecnologia para permitir a entrega remota de servi\u00e7os para garantir o acesso cont\u00ednuo \u00e0 justi\u00e7a. La R\u00e9gion sera d\u00e9tenue et exploit\u00e9e par une entit\u00e9 AWS locale en Nouvelle-Z\u00e9lande. \u00c0 l\u2019\u00e9chelle mondiale, AWS a annonc\u00e9 des plans pour 24 Zones de Disponibilit\u00e9 et huit R\u00e9gions AWS suppl\u00e9mentaires en Australie, en Inde, en Indon\u00e9sie, en Isra\u00ebl, en Espagne, en Suisse, aux \u00c9mirats arabes unis et dans la nouvelle R\u00e9gion AWS en Nouvelle-Z\u00e9lande. La nouvelle R\u00e9gion AWS Asie-Pacifique (Auckland) permettra \u00e0 encore plus de d\u00e9veloppeurs, de startups, d\u2019entreprises ainsi que d\u2019organisations gouvernementales, \u00e9ducatives et \u00e0 but non lucratif d\u2019ex\u00e9cuter leurs applications et de servir les utilisateurs finaux \u00e0 partir de centres de donn\u00e9es localis\u00e9s en Nouvelle-Z\u00e9lande, afin que les clients qui souhaitent conserver leurs donn\u00e9es en Nouvelle-Z\u00e9lande soient garantis de pouvoir le faire. AWS a \u00e9galement publi\u00e9 une \u00e9tude sur les retomb\u00e9es \u00e9conomiques (economic impact study, EIS) qui estime que cette initiative permettra de cr\u00e9er 1 000 nouveaux emplois gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 un investissement de 7,5 milliards NZD (5,3 milliards USD) dans la nouvelle R\u00e9gion AWS Asie-Pacifique (Auckland), avec un impact \u00e9conomique estim\u00e9 sur le PIB n\u00e9o-z\u00e9landais de 10,8 milliards NZD (7,7 milliards USD) au cours des quinze prochaines ann\u00e9es. Pour en savoir plus, rendez-vous sur aws.amazon.com/about-aws/global-infrastructure. \u00ab AWS soutient des milliers d\u2019organisations \u00e0 travers la Nouvelle-Z\u00e9lande dans leur volont\u00e9 d\u2019innover, de r\u00e9ussir et de se d\u00e9velopper \u00e0 l\u2019\u00e9chelle mondiale. La technologie du Cloud AWS offre de nouvelles fa\u00e7ons au gouvernement de s\u2019engager davantage avec les citoyens, aux entreprises d\u2019innover pour leur prochaine phase de croissance et aux entrepreneurs de cr\u00e9er des entreprises et de tenir t\u00eate \u00e0 la concurrence mondiale \u00bb, a d\u00e9clar\u00e9 Prasad Kalyanaraman, vice-pr\u00e9sident des Services d\u2019infrastructure chez AWS. \u00ab Nos investissements refl\u00e8tent l\u2019engagement profond et \u00e0 long terme d\u2019AWS envers la Nouvelle-Z\u00e9lande. Nous sommes ravis de construire de nouvelles infrastructures de classe mondiale au niveau local, de doter des N\u00e9o-Z\u00e9landais de comp\u00e9tences num\u00e9riques recherch\u00e9es et de continuer \u00e0 aider les organisations locales \u00e0 fournir des applications qui acc\u00e9l\u00e8rent la transformation num\u00e9rique et qui alimentent la croissance \u00e9conomique. \u00bb Les R\u00e9gions AWS comprennent des Zones de Disponibilit\u00e9 qui placent les infrastructures dans des emplacements g\u00e9ographiques s\u00e9par\u00e9s et distincts, suffisamment distanc\u00e9s les uns des autres pour aider \u00e0 soutenir la continuit\u00e9 des activit\u00e9s des clients, mais suffisamment proches pour fournir la faible latence n\u00e9cessaire aux applications \u00e0 disponibilit\u00e9 \u00e9lev\u00e9e qui utilisent de multiples Zones de Disponibilit\u00e9. Chaque Zone de Disponibilit\u00e9 poss\u00e8de une alimentation, une s\u00e9curit\u00e9 physique et un refroidissement ind\u00e9pendants, tout en \u00e9tant connect\u00e9e via des r\u00e9seaux redondants \u00e0 ultra faible latence. Les clients d\u2019AWS focalis\u00e9s sur la disponibilit\u00e9 \u00e9lev\u00e9e peuvent concevoir leurs applications de fa\u00e7on \u00e0 ce qu\u2019elles fonctionnent dans de multiples Zones de Disponibilit\u00e9, afin d\u2019atteindre une marge d\u2019erreur encore plus faible. La R\u00e9gion AWS Asie-Pacifique (Auckland) permettra aux clients locaux ayant des pr\u00e9f\u00e9rences en mati\u00e8re de r\u00e9sidence des donn\u00e9es de stocker en toute s\u00e9curit\u00e9 leurs donn\u00e9es \u00e0 Aotearoa, tout en offrant une latence encore plus faible \u00e0 travers le pays. Les clients, des startups aux entreprises, en passant par les organisations gouvernementales et les organisations \u00e0 but non lucratif, pourront utiliser les technologies avanc\u00e9es du premier cloud mondial pour stimuler l\u2019innovation. AWS propose le portefeuille de services le plus large et le plus complet qui soit, couvrant notamment l\u2019analyse, le calcul, la base de donn\u00e9es, l\u2019Internet des objets (IdO), l\u2019apprentissage automatique, les services mobiles, le stockage, et plus encore. Les clients en Nouvelle-Z\u00e9lande b\u00e9n\u00e9ficient d\u00e9j\u00e0 de l\u2019investissement continu d\u2019Amazon dans son r\u00e9seau dorsal mondial via le c\u00e2ble sous-marin Hawaiki, un syst\u00e8me de c\u00e2ble transpacifique de 9 300 miles (15 000 kilom\u00e8tres) en service depuis 2018 qui fournit une connexion \u00e0 faible latence et \u00e0 large bande passante de l\u2019Australie \u00e0 la Nouvelle-Z\u00e9lande et les \u00c9tats-Unis. Selon l\u2019EIS r\u00e9cemment publi\u00e9e, AWS pr\u00e9voit d\u2019investir 7,5 milliards NZD (5,3 milliards USD) en Nouvelle-Z\u00e9lande au cours des quinze prochaines ann\u00e9es via la nouvelle R\u00e9gion AWS Asie-Pacifique (Auckland), ce qui inclura des d\u00e9penses en capital pour la construction de centres de donn\u00e9es, des d\u00e9penses op\u00e9rationnelles pour les frais de services publics et d\u2019installation courants, et des achats de biens et de services aupr\u00e8s d\u2019entreprises r\u00e9gionales. L\u2019EIS estime que les d\u00e9penses de construction et d\u2019exploitation de l\u2019infrastructure d\u2019AWS en Nouvelle-Z\u00e9lande devraient augmenter le PIB de la Nouvelle-Z\u00e9lande d\u2019environ 10,8 milliards NZD (7,7 milliards USD) au cours des quinze prochaines ann\u00e9es. L\u2019EIS fait \u00e9galement valoir que la nouvelle R\u00e9gion AWS devrait apporter des avantages \u00e9conomiques directs et indirects, tels que de nouveaux emplois et de nouvelles ventes pour la cha\u00eene d\u2019approvisionnement des centres de donn\u00e9es et les secteurs connexes. Au total, ce sont environ 1 000 nouveaux emplois \u00e9quivalents temps plein (ETP) qui seront cr\u00e9\u00e9s en Nouvelle-Z\u00e9lande gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 cet investissement. Les clients et partenaires d\u2019AWS saluent l\u2019annonce de la nouvelle R\u00e9gion AWS Asie-Pacifique (Auckland) Les clients n\u00e9o-z\u00e9landais continueront de se joindre aux millions de clients actifs qui utilisent AWS chaque mois dans plus de 190 pays \u00e0 travers le monde. Un bon nombre d\u2019entreprises n\u00e9o-z\u00e9landaises utilisent d\u00e9j\u00e0 AWS pour ex\u00e9cuter leurs charges de travail afin de g\u00e9n\u00e9rer des \u00e9conomies de co\u00fbts et d\u2019acc\u00e9l\u00e9rer l\u2019innovation et la mise sur le march\u00e9 ; parmi ces entreprises, il convient de citer Air NZ, ANZ Bank, Bank of New Zealand (BNZ), Contact Energy, Education Perfect, Halter, le minist\u00e8re de la Conservation n\u00e9o-z\u00e9landais, Lancom, le minist\u00e8re de la Sant\u00e9 n\u00e9o-z\u00e9landais, le minist\u00e8re de la Justice n\u00e9o-z\u00e9landais, Orion Health, Sharsies, The Clinician, TVNZ, UneeQ, l\u2019Universit\u00e9 d\u2019Auckland, Vodafone, Xero, et bien d\u2019autres. Avec des investissements dans les nouvelles technologies, les citoyens seraient en mesure d\u2019acc\u00e9der plus facilement aux cours et tribunaux et d\u2019interagir avec ces derniers, et le minist\u00e8re serait assur\u00e9 de maximiser l\u2019utilisation de toutes ses ressources, les donn\u00e9es relatives aux tribunaux devant \u00eatre h\u00e9berg\u00e9es en Nouvelle-Z\u00e9lande conform\u00e9ment \u00e0 notre politique judiciaire \u00bb, a d\u00e9clar\u00e9 Tina Wakefield, secr\u00e9taire adjointe aux services g\u00e9n\u00e9raux et num\u00e9riques du minist\u00e8re de la Justice. \u00ab En investissant dans une R\u00e9gion en Nouvelle-Z\u00e9lande, AWS ouvre de nouvelles possibilit\u00e9s pour les organisations de services publics comme la n\u00f4tre en offrant une nouvelle option de cloud computing align\u00e9e sur nos pr\u00e9f\u00e9rences en mati\u00e8re d\u2019h\u00e9bergement des donn\u00e9es sur notre territoire. En utilisant des technologies h\u00e9berg\u00e9es au niveau local, nous allons pouvoir nous aligner encore plus \u00e9troitement sur la strat\u00e9gie du gouvernement n\u00e9o-z\u00e9landais ax\u00e9e sur le cloud et progresser vers de nouvelles m\u00e9thodes de travail qui am\u00e9lioreront l\u2019exp\u00e9rience des services de justice pour les intervenants des tribunaux, dans le but d\u2019am\u00e9liorer l\u2019acc\u00e8s \u00e0 la justice pour tous les N\u00e9o-Z\u00e9landais. \u00bb Education Perfect est une plateforme num\u00e9rique qui propose des cours align\u00e9s sur les programmes scolaires pour un apprentissage mixte en classe, ainsi que pour l\u2019enseignement \u00e0 domicile et le tutorat, et ce pour les ann\u00e9es scolaires allant du CM2 jusqu\u2019\u00e0 la Terminale. \u00ab Chez Education Perfect, notre mission est d\u2019humaniser la technologie pour les apprenants, quel que soit leur \u00e2ge, tout en aidant les \u00e9ducateurs \u00e0 utiliser des donn\u00e9es qui leur permettent de gagner du temps, d\u2019\u00e9clairer la prise de d\u00e9cision, de cr\u00e9er des exp\u00e9riences et des parcours d\u2019apprentissage personnalis\u00e9s et d\u2019am\u00e9liorer les r\u00e9sultats des \u00e9l\u00e8ves \u00bb, a d\u00e9clar\u00e9 Alex Burke, PDG d\u2019Education Perfect. \u00ab En tant qu\u2019entreprise native du cloud, Education Perfect mise tout sur AWS depuis le premier jour car nous nous appuyons sur une multitude de services s\u00e9curis\u00e9s et r\u00e9silients, notamment des outils avanc\u00e9s de gestion des donn\u00e9es et d\u2019apprentissage automatique. Une nouvelle R\u00e9gion AWS en Nouvelle-Z\u00e9lande offrira une disponibilit\u00e9, une vitesse et une fiabilit\u00e9 accrues, ce qui se traduira par un acc\u00e8s plus rapide et plus transparent \u00e0 notre plateforme. Datacom, l\u2019une des plus grandes entreprises technologiques locales de la r\u00e9gion, fait partie des partenaires de conseil de niveau Premier d\u2019AWS. \u00ab Datacom collabore avec AWS depuis 2015, tirant parti du Cloud AWS pour renforcer la fiabilit\u00e9 et l\u2019\u00e9volutivit\u00e9 de ses clients sans compromettre la s\u00e9curit\u00e9 et la conformit\u00e9 \u00bb, a d\u00e9clar\u00e9 Justin Gray, directeur g\u00e9n\u00e9ral de Datacom. \u00ab Nous aidons de grandes agences gouvernementales, et nos clients du march\u00e9 interm\u00e9diaire et des entreprises \u00e0 transformer les syst\u00e8mes de leur organisation, tout en am\u00e9liorant leurs performances et en augmentant l\u2019efficacit\u00e9 et la s\u00e9curit\u00e9. (AWS), an Amazon.com, Inc. company (NASDAQ: AMZN), announced the general availability of Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus, a scalable, secure, and highly available service that makes it easier for customers to monitor containerized applications. Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus is fully compatible with open-source Prometheus and provides the same familiar time series data model and Prometheus Query Language (PromQL) customers use today to monitor containerized applications. As a fully managed service, Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus automatically scales the infrastructure needed to ingest, store, and query operational metrics from containerized applications. Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus also integrates with AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) and AWS CloudTrail to allow customers to more easily control and audit access to data. There are no upfront commitments or fees to use Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus, and customers only pay for the operational metrics they ingest, store, and query. To get started with Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus, visit aws.amazon.com/prometheus. More and more customers are using containers to build modern applications because containers allow them to improve resource utilization and reduce costs. Containers typically run for a short amount of time, share infrastructure resources, and produce a large volume of operational metrics, which makes them hard to monitor using tools traditionally designed for applications running on bare metal or virtual servers. As a result, customers often struggle to understand the health and performance of containerized applications at scale and can be slow to respond to alarms or issues when they occur. This can lead to application disruptions and suboptimal end-user experiences. To overcome this challenge, many customers use the popular, open-source project Prometheus to monitor their applications. Prometheus is optimized to store operational metrics from containerized applications, and customers can easily set up alerts for potential application issues. However, scaling Prometheus securely across multiple servers and configuring it for high availability can take a lot of manual work and requires stitching together additional open-source and third-party tools. Once Prometheus is running, customers then must invest time patching and upgrading Prometheus and any additional tools they use on an ongoing basis. Customers also need to invest significant engineering time to optimize how Prometheus uses memory and storage resources to improve query response times and keep costs low. This complexity and operational overhead has led customers to make a trade-off between investing valuable time and resources maintaining their Prometheus deployment and its supporting infrastructure or building and innovating on behalf of their end users. Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus is a scalable, secure, and highly available monitoring service for containerized applications that automatically manages the infrastructure required to ingest, store, and query operational metrics to meet application and infrastructure monitoring demands. Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus is fully compatible with open-source Prometheus, and customers can use the same familiar time series data model and PromQL code to query operational metrics. Customers can send operational metrics to Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus from AWS container services (e.g. Amazon Elastic Container Service, Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service, and AWS Fargate) with just a few clicks to take advantage of Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus\u2019s fast query response times and cost-effective monitoring capabilities. By using Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus\u2019s application programming interfaces (APIs), customers can also more easily and securely ingest operational metrics from existing customer-managed Kubernetes clusters running in the cloud or on premises. If a customer has an existing Prometheus deployment or needs to run Prometheus on premises for data residency, latency, regulatory, or compliance considerations, they can more easily integrate their Prometheus deployment with Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus through a single command line request. Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus also has built-in support for IAM to control access and permissions, and AWS CloudTrail to audit user access to help customers meet their corporate security and compliance requirements. Because Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus is fully managed by AWS, customers get access to cost-effective monitoring that is optimized for containerized applications without having to build, scale, and maintain Prometheus and its supporting infrastructure and tools. \u201cCustomers love Prometheus because it is purpose-built to handle the needs of containerized applications, but they find it difficult and time consuming to manage and run Prometheus at scale themselves,\u201d said Nandini Ramani, VP of Monitoring and Observability, AWS. \u201cWith Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus, customers have access to a scalable, secure, and highly available monitoring service that is optimized for containerized applications running on AWS and on premises. Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus eliminates the undifferentiated heavy lifting of running Prometheus, so customers can focus on building modern applications that help them deliver new, innovative experiences to their end users.\u201d Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus is available today in US East (Ohio), US East (N. Virginia), US West (Oregon), Asia Pacific (Singapore), Asia Pacific (Sydney), Asia Pacific (Tokyo), Europe (Frankfurt), Europe (Ireland), and Europe (Stockholm), with availability in additional AWS Regions coming soon. Fanatics, a global leader in licensed sports merchandise, uses AWS to facilitate fan connections across sports like soccer, football, and basketball. \u201cWe were re-evaluating monitoring solutions for our Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service workloads and wanted a scalable, highly available service that supported open standards,\u201d said German Rodriguez, Manager, Platforms Engineering, Fanatics. \u201cWe chose Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus because it offers the benefits of open-source Prometheus as a scalable, secure, and highly available service fully managed by AWS. Now our engineers can more easily monitor the performance of our containerized applications running across AWS and on premises to ensure the best experience for fans around the world.\u201d eTF1 is the over-the-top (OTT) video service of TF1, the largest broadcaster in France. \u201cInitially, we self-hosted Prometheus across multiple AWS accounts to monitor our Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service workloads, but it was hard maintaining a highly available and performant monitoring environment,\u201d said Ali Oubaziz, Head of Infrastructure, eTF1. \u201cAmazon Managed Service for Prometheus is now our primary metrics monitoring platform, allowing us to monitor all our containerized workloads at scale\u2014even during peak TV viewing times when monitoring demands are the highest. Designed specifically for the needs of senior living communities and healthcare facilities, Alexa Smart Properties simplifies deploying and managing Alexa-enabled devices at scale, helping properties offer customized Alexa experiences for residents and patients, and increase care team productivity and operational efficiency. \u201cWe believe the intuitive and accessible nature of voice and Alexa has the potential to help and delight customers in many scenarios, in and outside of the home,\u201d said Liron Torres, Head of Alexa Smart Properties, Amazon. \u201cWe\u2019re excited to extend the experiences customers already love to senior living communities and healthcare systems, and give providers new ways to save time and personalize care for their patients and residents.\u201d Empowering Connection in Senior Living Communities Alexa Smart Properties enables senior living residents to keep in touch with their loved ones, connect with their community, access community news, and more, using the Amazon Echo device in their room. Moore, Chairman and CEO of Atria Senior Living. \u201cTechnology has played a critical role in this effort. When you combine our resident and family app with the deployment of Alexa Smart Properties in our communities, seniors have an even greater ability to write the next chapter of their lives through easy-to-use technology that keeps them engaged and connected to their families at all times.\u201d Helping Hospitals Deliver Personalized Care With Alexa Smart Properties, patients can communicate with their care staff, control devices in their room, or stay informed and entertained with news and music, just by asking Alexa. Healthcare providers can communicate with patients quickly and easily with features like calling and Drop In\u2014without the need to enter patient rooms. And staff can see the context of requests and triage more efficiently. It opens up new opportunities for better care, from simple requests to daily announcements, resident check-ins, even helping to ease social isolation, CarePoint with Alexa will be a real advantage for our customers.\u201d Built with Privacy in Mind Alexa Smart Properties senior living and healthcare solutions were designed with privacy in mind. No personal information is shared with Alexa to use the device, and voice recordings are not saved. Every Amazon Echo device offers multiple layers of privacy protection, and residents and patients can disable Alexa\u2019s ability to respond to the wake word at any time by simply pressing the mute button on top of their Echo device. It\u2019ll be expensive for us in the short term, but it\u2019s the right prioritization for our customers and partners.\u201d Highlights Innovating for Our Retail Customers Amazon kicked off the holidays early this year, announcing Black Friday-worthy deals on October 4, including thousands of deals from independent sellers and handmade artisans and Amazon\u2019s biggest ever selection of gift guides. The post Where to Find the #1 Stock to Buy Because of the AWS Outage appeared first on InvestorPlace.", "source": "InvestorPlace"}, {"date": "20211208091000", "headline": "Amazon Launches Accelerator Program to Grow Opportunities for Real Estate Developers of Color and Increase Affordable Housing", "summary": "SEATTLE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Today Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN) announced it is committing more than $21 million to pilot a professional training, mentorship, and capital funding program to help promote real estate developers of color. This two-year, part-time professional development program, which is free for participants, aims to teach real estate developers of color how to advance their careers. It also aims to lower the barriers these developers can face when bidding for affordable housing developments. The goal of the program is to increase the number of professional real estate developers of color who are focused on affordable housing and inclusive community building. This initiative is part of the $2 billion Amazon Housing Equity Fund, a commitment to create and preserve 20,000 affordable homes for individuals and families earning moderate to low incomes in Washington state\u2019s Puget Sound region; the Arlington, Virginia region; and Nashville, Tennessee. \u201cWith this accelerator program, we are laser focused on lifting up emerging real estate developers of color. According to a 2019 report from the Urban Land Institute, a nonprofit research and education organization for real estate and land use experts, 5% of its U.S. members are Black and 82% are white, though Blacks represent more than 13% of the U.S. population. This disparity translates into a lack of diversity at the project development level that can subsequently exclude developers of color from working on meaningful and lucrative housing deals as cities expand. Amazon has partnered with local social impact and economic justice organizations in each region\u2014the Local Initiative Support Corporation (LISC) in the Puget Sound region, Capital Impact Partners in the Arlington region, and the Urban League of Middle Tennessee in Nashville\u2014to develop curriculums and networking opportunities that reflect the specific issues facing their communities. The accelerator program will initially support up to 30 total participants by providing: Virtual and in-person classroom instruction on real estate fundamentals, affordable housing trends, public policy, and financing best practices Small group mentoring Professional networking opportunities with industry leaders, researchers, and established real estate developers Access to capital for pre-development expenses, such as architectural and engineering costs; permitting, survey and site-planning fees; and market and feasibility studies \u201cDevelopers of color bring enormous opportunity for creative and inclusive solutions to community-focused real estate development, but systemic issues continue to create multiple barriers to their success,\u201d said Ellis Carr, president and CEO of Capital Impact Partners and CDC Small Business Finance. \u201cThrough this program, we are partnering with Amazon in helping open doors for people of color who can then pay their experience forward.\u201d \u201cWith Amazon\u2019s support, our hope is to bridge the knowledge gap and build a bench of developers of color who are trusted in their communities,\u201d said Brian Surratt, executive director of LISC Puget Sound. \u201cThese developers are then likely to hire contractors and other workers of color, some of whom may live in those same neighborhoods.\u201d Participants in the program will be selected by each partner organization and will be based on the following eligibility guidelines: Identify as a person of color Work experience as a developer at a real estate development firm or organization Real estate development activities focused in the Puget Sound region, Arlington region, or Nashville Concurrent to the accelerator program, Amazon is also partnering with Enterprise Community Loan Fund, Inc. to administer grants of up to $200,000 to qualified real estate developers of color. These grants are open to anyone who applies to the Amazon Housing Equity Fund and needs assistance with the capacity-building and pre-development expenses associated with the preservation and creation of affordable housing within Amazon\u2019s three focus regions. Since its January launch, the fund\u2019s commitments will preserve or create over 5,600 affordable housing units, with more investments to come. Learn more about the Amazon Housing Equity Fund as well as opportunities with this accelerator program in Washington state\u2019s Puget Sound region, Northern Virginia or Nashville, Tennessee. A AWS liberou um estudo de impacto econ\u00f4mico (Economic Impact Study, EIS) estimando que os gastos da empresa na constru\u00e7\u00e3o e opera\u00e7\u00e3o da nova regi\u00e3o \u00c1sia-Pac\u00edfico (Jakarta) da AWS criar\u00e1 24.700 empregos diretos e indiretos com uma estimativa de US$ 5 bilh\u00f5es (IDR$ 71 trilh\u00f5es) em investimento planejado na economia local.
