MIT DEN LOKALEN RECHENZENTREN VON AWS K\u00d6NNEN WIR UNSERE INNOVATIONEN SCHNELLER VORANTREIBEN UND GLEICHZEITIG DIE ANFORDERUNGEN AN DAS DATENHOSTING IM LAND ERF\u00dcLLEN.\u201c ALEF EDUCATION IST MIT KUNDEN IN DEN USA, DEN VAE UND INDONESIEN VOLL AUF AWS AUFGESETZT UND BETREUT MEHR ALS 4.000 SCHULEN, 690.000 SCH\u00dcLER UND 40.000 LEHRER. {"date": "2022-09-02 11:18:00", "headline": "AWS LAN\u00c7A REGI\u00c3O NOS EMIRADOS \u00c1RABES UNIDOS", "description": "SEATTLE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--A AMAZON WEB SERVICES, INC. (AWS), UMA EMPRESA DA AMAZON.COM, INC. (NASDAQ: AMZN), ANUNCIOU HOJE O LAN\u00c7AMENTO DE SUA SEGUNDA REGI\u00c3O NO ORIENTE M\u00c9DIO, A REGI\u00c3O AWS ORIENTE M\u00c9DIO (UAE). A PARTIR DE HOJE, DESENVOLVEDORES, STARTUPS, EMPREENDEDORES E EMPREENDIMENTOS, ASSIM COMO ORGANIZA\u00c7\u00d5ES GOVERNAMENTAIS, EDUCACIONAIS E SEM FINS LUCRATIVOS TER\u00c3O AINDA MAIS OP\u00c7\u00d5ES PARA EXECUTAR SEUS APLICATIVOS E ATENDER USU\u00c1RIOS FINAIS DE DATA CENTERS LOCALIZADOS NOS EMIRADOS \u00c1RABES UNIDOS (EAU), USANDO TECNOLOGIAS AVAN\u00c7ADAS DA AWS PARA IMPULSIONAR A INOVA\u00c7\u00c3O. A AWS ESTIMA QUE SEUS GASTOS PROJETADOS NA CONSTRU\u00c7\u00c3O E OPERA\u00c7\u00c3O DA NOVA REGI\u00c3O SUPORTAR\u00c3O UMA M\u00c9DIA DE QUASE 6.000 EMPREGOS EM PER\u00cdODO INTEGRAL ANUALMENTE EM FORNECEDORES EXTERNOS, COM UM INVESTIMENTO PLANEJADO DE US$ 5 BILH\u00d5ES (AED 20 BILH\u00d5ES) NA ECONOMIA LOCAL AT\u00c9 2036. A REGI\u00c3O DA AWS ORIENTE M\u00c9DIO (EAU) TAMB\u00c9M ADICIONAR\u00c1 CERCA DE US$ 11 BILH\u00d5ES (AED 41 BILH\u00d5ES) NOS PR\u00d3XIMOS 15 ANOS AO PRODUTO INTERNO BRUTO (PIB) DOS EAU. PARA MAIS INFORMA\u00c7\u00d5ES SOBRE A INFRAESTRUTURA GLOBAL DA AWS, ACESSE AWS.AMAZON.COM/ABOUT-AWS/GLOBAL-INFRASTRUCTURE/. \u201cA AWS EST\u00c1 COMPROMETIDA EM AJUDAR OS CLIENTES NOS EAU A IMPLANTAR AS TECNOLOGIAS DE NUVEM MAIS AVAN\u00c7ADAS E ALCAN\u00c7AR OS MAIS ALTOS N\u00cdVEIS DE SEGURAN\u00c7A, DISPONIBILIDADE E RESILI\u00caNCIA\u201d, DISSE PRASAD KALYANARAMAN, VICE-PRESIDENTE DE SERVI\u00c7OS DE INFRAESTRUTURA DA AWS. \u201cCOM O LAN\u00c7AMENTO DA REGI\u00c3O AWS ORIENTE M\u00c9DIO (EAU), ESTAMOS POSSIBILITANDO QUE AINDA MAIS CLIENTES APROVEITEM O PODER DA NUVEM PARA IMPULSIONAR A INOVA\u00c7\u00c3O NOS EAU, AL\u00c9M DE INVESTIR NA ECONOMIA LOCAL POR MEIO DA CRIA\u00c7\u00c3O DE EMPREGOS, TREINAMENTO PARA HABILIDADES TECNOL\u00d3GICAS ALTAMENTE PROCURADAS E RECURSOS EDUCACIONAIS PARA AVAN\u00c7AR AINDA MAIS NAS PRIORIDADES ESTRAT\u00c9GICAS DOS EAU.\u201d \u201cA ABERTURA DA REGI\u00c3O AWS ORIENTE M\u00c9DIO (EAU) \u00c9 UM MARCO SIGNIFICATIVO PARA ABU DHABI E OS EAU COMO UM TODO, REFLETINDO NOSSOS ESFOR\u00c7OS PARA GERAR OPORTUNIDADES PARA TODOS\u201d, DISSE SUA EXCEL\u00caNCIA MOHAMED ALI AL SHORAFA, PRESIDENTE DO DEPARTAMENTO DE ABU DHABI DE DESENVOLVIMENTO ECON\u00d4MICO. \u201cISSO FORTALECE O COMPROMISSO DE ABU DHABI DE SE POSICIONAR COMO UMA ECONOMIA DIGITAL L\u00cdDER, APROVEITANDO A TECNOLOGIA DE PONTA PARA APOIAR O CRESCIMENTO DOS NEG\u00d3CIOS. ESPERA-SE QUE OS RECURSOS APRIMORADOS DE NUVEM HABILITADOS PELA AWS GEREM VANTAGENS E EFICI\u00caNCIAS SIGNIFICATIVAS QUE PODEM IMPULSIONAR AS EMPRESAS AO SUCESSO E TRAZER GRANDES BENEF\u00cdCIOS ECON\u00d4MICOS PARA O PA\u00cdS.\u201d COM O LAN\u00c7AMENTO DA REGI\u00c3O EMIRADOS \u00c1RABES UNIDOS (EAU) DA AWS, A AWS POSSUI 87 ZONAS DE DISPONIBILIDADE EM 27 REGI\u00d5ES GEOGR\u00c1FICAS, COM PLANOS PARA LAN\u00c7AR MAIS 21 ZONAS DE DISPONIBILIDADE E MAIS SETE REGI\u00d5ES DA AWS NA AUSTR\u00c1LIA, CANAD\u00c1, \u00cdNDIA, ISRAEL, NOVA ZEL\u00c2NDIA, ESPANHA E SU\u00cd\u00c7A. AS REGI\u00d5ES DA AWS S\u00c3O COMPOSTAS POR ZONAS DE DISPONIBILIDADE QUE POSICIONAM A INFRAESTRUTURA EM LOCALIDADES GEOGR\u00c1FICAS SEPARADAS E DISTINTAS. A REGI\u00c3O AWS ORIENTE M\u00c9DIO (EAU) CONSISTE EM TR\u00caS ZONAS DE DISPONIBILIDADE E SE JUNTA \u00c0 REGI\u00c3O AWS ORIENTE M\u00c9DIO (BAHREIN), INAUGURADA EM JULHO DE 2019. AS ZONAS DE DISPONIBILIDADE EST\u00c3O LOCALIZADAS LONGE O SUFICIENTE UMAS DAS OUTRAS PARA DAR SUPORTE \u00c0 CONTINUIDADE DOS NEG\u00d3CIOS DOS CLIENTES, MAS PERTO O SUFICIENTE PARA FORNECER BAIXA LAT\u00caNCIA PARA APLICATIVOS DE ALTA DISPONIBILIDADE QUE USAM V\u00c1RIAS ZONAS DE DISPONIBILIDADE. CADA ZONA DE DISPONIBILIDADE POSSUI ENERGIA, RESFRIAMENTO, E SEGURAN\u00c7A F\u00cdSICA INDEPENDENTES E EST\u00c1 CONECTADA POR REDES REDUNDANTES DE LAT\u00caNCIA ULTRABAIXA. OS CLIENTES DA AWS FOCADOS EM ALTA DISPONIBILIDADE PODEM CRIAR SEUS APLICATIVOS PARA RODAREM EM M\u00daLTIPLAS ZONAS DE DISPONIBILIDADE PARA ALCAN\u00c7AR UMA TOLER\u00c2NCIA DE FALHA AINDA MAIOR. O LAN\u00c7AMENTO DA REGI\u00c3O DA AWS ORIENTE M\u00c9DIO (EAU) PERMITIR\u00c1 QUE CLIENTES LOCAIS COM REQUISITOS DE RESID\u00caNCIA DE DADOS ARMAZENEM SEUS DADOS DE FORMA SEGURA NOS EAU, ENQUANTO FORNECE A SEUS CLIENTES LAT\u00caNCIA AINDA MAIS BAIXA NO PA\u00cdS. A AWS EST\u00c1 PLANEJANDO INVESTIR UMA ESTIMATIVA DE US$ 5 BILH\u00d5ES (AED$ 20 BILH\u00d5ES) NOS EAU DURANTE OS PR\u00d3XIMOS 15 ANOS ATRAV\u00c9S DA NOVA REGI\u00c3O ORIENTE M\u00c9DIO (EAU) DA AWS, INCLUINDO DESPESAS DE CAPITAL NA CONSTRU\u00c7\u00c3O DE DATA CENTERS, DESPESAS OPERACIONAIS RELATIVAS A CUSTOS CONT\u00cdNUOS DE SERVI\u00c7OS P\u00daBLICOS E DE INSTALA\u00c7\u00c3O E COMPRAS DE BENS E SERVI\u00c7OS DE EMPRESAS REGIONAIS. O INVESTIMENTO \u00c9 TAMB\u00c9M ESTIMADO SUSTENTAR UMA M\u00c9DIA DE 6.000 EMPREGOS ANUALMENTE DURANTE ESSE TEMPO. ESSES EMPREGOS FAR\u00c3O PARTE DE UMA CADEIA DE SUPRIMENTOS DA AWS NOS EAU, INCLUINDO CONSTRU\u00c7\u00c3O, MANUTEN\u00c7\u00c3O DE INSTALA\u00c7\u00c3O, ENGENHARIA, TELECOMUNICA\u00c7\u00d5ES E EMPREGOS DENTRO DA ECONOMIA MAIS ABRANGENTE DO PA\u00cdS. ESTIMA-SE TAMB\u00c9M QUE A CONSTRU\u00c7\u00c3O E OPERA\u00c7\u00c3O DA INFRAESTRUTURA DA AWS NOS EAU ADICIONE CERCA DE US$ 11 BILH\u00d5ES (AED 41 BILH\u00d5ES) AO PIB DOS EAU NOS PR\u00d3XIMOS 15 ANOS. \u201cABU DHABI VISA PERMITIR UMA TECNOLOGIA TRANSFORMADORA QUE OFERE\u00c7A OPORTUNIDADES PARA EMPRESAS E MORADORES\u201d, DISSE O ENG. ABDULLA ABDUL AZIZ ALSHAMSI, DIRETOR-GERAL INTERINO DO ESCRIT\u00d3RIO DE INVESTIMENTOS DE ABU DHABI (ABU DHABI INVESTMENT OFFICE, ADIO). \u201cA INFRAESTRUTURA INTELIGENTE EST\u00c1 IMPULSIONANDO OS PR\u00d3SPEROS SETORES P\u00daBLICO E PRIVADO, ABRINDO NOVAS POSSIBILIDADES ECON\u00d4MICAS, PROMOVENDO O CRESCIMENTO INCLUSIVO E CRIANDO OPORTUNIDADES DE COLABORA\u00c7\u00c3O EM TODO O NOSSO ECOSSISTEMA DE INOVA\u00c7\u00c3O. NA ADIO, ESTAMOS CONTRIBUINDO PARA ISSO POR MEIO DE MUITAS PARCERIAS VALIOSAS QUE CAPACITAM O ECOSSISTEMA QUE APOIAM A POSI\u00c7\u00c3O DE ABU DHABI COMO L\u00cdDER NA REVOLU\u00c7\u00c3O DIGITAL DA REGI\u00c3O. A REGI\u00c3O AWS ORIENTE M\u00c9DIO (EAU) \u00c9 UMA ADI\u00c7\u00c3O BEM-VINDA AO ECOSSISTEMA DE INOVA\u00c7\u00c3O DO PA\u00cdS, AJUDANDO A CRIAR RECURSOS VITAIS PARA TODOS.\u201d CLIENTES E PARCEIROS AWS D\u00c3O AS BOAS-VINDAS \u00c0 REGI\u00c3O DA AWS ORIENTE M\u00c9DIO (EAU) AS ORGANIZA\u00c7\u00d5ES NOS EAU EST\u00c3O ENTRE OS MILH\u00d5ES DE CLIENTES ATIVOS QUE USAM A AWS TODOS OS MESES EM MAIS DE 190 PA\u00cdSES AO REDOR DO MUNDO, INCLUINDO DEZENAS DE MILHARES DE CLIENTES NO ORIENTE M\u00c9DIO E NORTE DA \u00c1FRICA (MIDDLE EAST AND NORTH AFRICA, MENA). ESSES CLIENTES APROVEITAM A AWS PARA ACELERAR A INOVA\u00c7\u00c3O, AUMENTAR A AGILIDADE E GERAR ECONOMIA DE CUSTOS. AS EMPRESAS QUE ESCOLHERAM A AWS PARA SE TORNAREM MAIS \u00c1GEIS E INOVADORAS INCLUEM AL GHURAIR INVESTMENTS, AL TAYER GROUP, ARAMEX, AXIOM TELECOM, FLYDUBAI, GIG GULF (ANTERIORMENTE AXA GULF), GULF NEWS, OSN, SHAHID, SEERA GROUP, VIRGIN MIDDLE EAST E MUITO MAIS. ORGANIZA\u00c7\u00d5ES DO SETOR P\u00daBLICO MENA EST\u00c3O UTILIZANDO A AWS PARA GERAR ECONOMIAS, ACELERAR A INOVA\u00c7\u00c3O E MELHOR ATENDER OS CIDAD\u00c3OS DA REGI\u00c3O. EXEMPLOS DESSAS ORGANIZA\u00c7\u00d5ES INCLUEM DUBAI EXPO 2020, MINIST\u00c9RIO DAS COMUNICA\u00c7\u00d5ES E TECNOLOGIA DA INFORMA\u00c7\u00c3O DO EGITO, MINIST\u00c9RIOS DO GOVERNO DO BAHREIN, HAMDAN BIN MOHAMMED SMART UNIVERSITY E A UNIVERSIDADE DO BAHREIN. STARTUPS DA MENA CONSTRUINDO SEUS NEG\u00d3CIOS COM BASE NA AWS PARA ESCALAR RAPIDAMENTE E EXPANDIR AO REDOR DO MUNDO INCLUEM A ALEF EDUCATION, ANGHAMI, CAREEM, DUBIZZLE, EKAR, FETCHR, HARAJ, MAESTRO PIZZA, MAWDOO3.COM, PROPERTY FINDER, SARWA, SOUQALMAL, STARZPLAY, E A YALLACOMPARE. O DUBAI ISLAMIC BANK (DIB) \u00c9 O MAIOR BANCO ISL\u00c2MICO DOS EAU E O SEGUNDO MAIOR BANCO ISL\u00c2MICO DO MUNDO. \u201cO DUBAI ISLAMIC BANK H\u00c1 MUITOS ANOS DEFENDE O USO DA TECNOLOGIA COMO MEIO DE CAPACITAR OS CLIENTES E SIMPLIFICAR A EXPERI\u00caNCIA BANC\u00c1RIA GERAL\u201d, DISSE OBAID AL SHAMSI, DIRETOR DE OPERA\u00c7\u00d5ES DO DIB. \u201cORGULHAMO-NOS DE SER UM BANCO VERDADEIRAMENTE DIGITALMENTE INTELIGENTE QUE EST\u00c1 NA VANGUARDA DA INOVA\u00c7\u00c3O E TRANSFORMA\u00c7\u00c3O, APOIANDO A LIDERAN\u00c7A DO PA\u00cdS NA REALIZA\u00c7\u00c3O DE SUA VIS\u00c3O PARA A ECONOMIA DIGITAL DOS EAU E ESTABELECENDO DUBAI COMO UM CENTRO PR\u00d3SPERO DA ECONOMIA ISL\u00c2MICA GLOBAL. NOSSA ESTRAT\u00c9GIA DE TRANSFORMA\u00c7\u00c3O DIGITAL \u00c9 FORMULADA COM UM FOCO CLARO EM DISSECAR CADA ETAPA DA JORNADA DO CLIENTE E REMOVER QUAISQUER PONTOS PROBLEM\u00c1TICOS PARA O CLIENTE. CONSEGUIMOS ISSO ADOTANDO UMA ABORDAGEM CENTRADA NO CLIENTE E FORNECENDO SERVI\u00c7OS BANC\u00c1RIOS CONVENIENTES, R\u00c1PIDOS E AGRAD\u00c1VEIS \u200b\u200bEM MINUTOS, EM VEZ DE DIAS. ALINHADO A ISSO, SAUDAMOS O LAN\u00c7AMENTO DA REGI\u00c3O DA AWS NOS EAU, QUE ESPERAMOS AUMENTAR NOSSA AGILIDADE E AJUDAR A ACELERAR A TAXA DE INOVA\u00c7\u00c3O E EXPERIMENTA\u00c7\u00c3O COM AS MAIS RECENTES TECNOLOGIAS, COMO INTELIG\u00caNCIA ARTIFICIAL (IA) E APRENDIZADO DE M\u00c1QUINA.\u201d O MINIST\u00c9RIO DA SA\u00daDE E PREVEN\u00c7\u00c3O DOS EMIRADOS \u00c1RABES UNIDOS (UNITED ARAB EMIRATES MINISTRY OF HEALTH AND PREVENTION, MOHAP) \u00c9 RESPONS\u00c1VEL PELA IMPLEMENTA\u00c7\u00c3O DA POL\u00cdTICA DE ATEN\u00c7\u00c3O \u00c0 SA\u00daDE EM TODAS AS \u00c1REAS T\u00c9CNICAS, MATERIAIS E DE COORDENA\u00c7\u00c3O COM OS MINIST\u00c9RIOS DE ESTADO, E COOPERA\u00c7\u00c3O COM O SETOR PRIVADO EM SA\u00daDE LOCAL E INTERNACIONALMENTE. NO IN\u00cdCIO DESTE ANO, A AWS ASSINOU UM MEMORANDO DE ENTENDIMENTO ESTRAT\u00c9GICO (MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING, MOU) COM O MOHAP. \u201cCONGRATULAMO-NOS COM O LAN\u00c7AMENTO DE UMA REGI\u00c3O DA AWS NOS EAU E ESPERAMOS A IMPLEMENTA\u00c7\u00c3O DE NOSSO ACORDO COM A AWS PARA AUXILIAR O MOHAP NA MODERNIZA\u00c7\u00c3O DA EXPERI\u00caNCIA DO PACIENTE\u201d, DISSE ALI JUMA ALAJME, DIRETOR DO DEPARTAMENTO DE SA\u00daDE DIGITAL DO MOHAP. \u201cTER A REGI\u00c3O DA AWS NOS EAU NOS PERMITIR\u00c1 ACELERAR NOSSO PROGRAMA DE TRANSFORMA\u00c7\u00c3O DIGITAL E DESENVOLVER HABILIDADES E CAPACIDADES, IMPULSIONANDO A INOVA\u00c7\u00c3O CL\u00cdNICA E TECNOL\u00d3GICA E FORTALECENDO AINDA MAIS A POSI\u00c7\u00c3O DO PA\u00cdS COMO L\u00cdDER GLOBAL EM SA\u00daDE. NOSSA COLABORA\u00c7\u00c3O COM A AWS NOS PERMITE CONECTAR 100% DOS PROVEDORES DE ASSIST\u00caNCIA \u2014 P\u00daBLICOS E PRIVADOS \u2014 PARA APRIMORAR AINDA MAIS NOSSA ESTRAT\u00c9GIA DE DADOS EM SUPORTE A PROGRAMAS DE SA\u00daDE PREDITIVOS E POPULACIONAIS. ESTAMOS TRABALHANDO PARA IDENTIFICAR FONTES DE DADOS ATUAIS, FLUXOS E RESULTADOS DIRECIONADOS A PARTIR DE UMA ABORDAGEM ORIENTADA POR DADOS PARA A TOMADA DE DECIS\u00d5ES.\u201d A AL GHURAIR INVESTMENT (AGI) \u00c9 UM DOS MAIORES GRUPOS EMPRESARIAIS FAMILIARES DIVERSIFICADOS DO ORIENTE M\u00c9DIO, COM SEIS UNIDADES DE NEG\u00d3CIOS PRINCIPAIS, INCLUINDO ALIMENTOS E RECURSOS, PROPRIEDADES, CONSTRU\u00c7\u00c3O E SERVI\u00c7OS, ENERGIA, TRANSPORTE E EMPREENDIMENTOS. EM 2020, A AGI INICIOU UMA JORNADA DE TRANSFORMA\u00c7\u00c3O EM TODO O GRUPO, APROVEITANDO SEU LEGADO DE MAIS DE 60 ANOS PARA REFORMULAR O FUTURO. UMA PARTE FUNDAMENTAL DESSA TRANSFORMA\u00c7\u00c3O ORIENTADA PARA OS NEG\u00d3CIOS FOI FORTALECER O ECOSSISTEMA DIGITAL DA EMPRESA, APROVEITANDO O PODER DA AWS PARA IMPULSIONAR A TRANSFORMA\u00c7\u00c3O DA TECNOLOGIA DA INFORMA\u00c7\u00c3O (TI) E A MODERNIZA\u00c7\u00c3O DA INFRAESTRUTURA. \u201cA AWS \u00c9 UM PARCEIRO ESTRAT\u00c9GICO EM NOSSA JORNADA DE TRANSFORMA\u00c7\u00c3O DE TI COMO NOSSO PROVEDOR DE SERVI\u00c7OS DE NUVEM PREFERIDO PARA TODA A PILHA DE TECNOLOGIA DIGITAL AVAN\u00c7ADA\u201d, DISSE MARINDA SHEAHAN, VICE-PRESIDENTE GLOBAL DE TI DA AGI. \u201cESCOLHEMOS A AWS POR SEUS RECURSOS AVAN\u00c7ADOS DE DADOS E AN\u00c1LISE, E AGORA NOSSA JORNADA PARA NOS TORNARMOS UMA ORGANIZA\u00c7\u00c3O ORIENTADA POR DADOS EST\u00c1 BEM ENCAMINHADA. ISSO RESULTAR\u00c1 EM UMA ECONOMIA DE CUSTOS DE AT\u00c9 25% EM UM PER\u00cdODO DE TR\u00caS ANOS. A NOVA REGI\u00c3O DA AWS NOS EAU ACELERAR\u00c1 NOSSOS PR\u00d3PRIOS OBJETIVOS PARA NOS TORNARMOS UMA ORGANIZA\u00c7\u00c3O DE TI \u00c1GIL, INOVADORA E FLEX\u00cdVEL, EM ALINHAMENTO COM O PROP\u00d3SITO DO NOSSO GRUPO DE \u2018MELHORAR A QUALIDADE DE VIDA\u2019.\u201d A GEMS EDUCATION \u00c9 UMA DAS MAIORES OPERADORAS PRIVADAS DE ENSINO FUNDAMENTAL E M\u00c9DIO DO MUNDO, COM MAIS DE 60 ANOS DE EXPERI\u00caNCIA. A PLATAFORMA USA UMA S\u00c9RIE DE TECNOLOGIAS AVAN\u00c7ADAS DE NUVEM DA AWS, COMO INTELIG\u00caNCIA ARTIFICIAL (IA) E APRENDIZADO DE M\u00c1QUINA, PARA DAR SUPORTE AOS PROFESSORES E CRIAR EXPERI\u00caNCIAS DE APRENDIZADO PERSONALIZADAS. TAMB\u00c9M DESENVOLVEMOS UMA PLATAFORMA AUTOMATIZADA DE GERA\u00c7\u00c3O E AVALIA\u00c7\u00c3O DE QUESTION\u00c1RIOS USANDO O AMAZON EC2 E O AMAZON SAGEMAKER. This includes the company\u2019s first renewable energy project in South America\u2014a solar farm in Brazil\u2014and its first solar farms in India and Poland. Once fully operational, Amazon\u2019s global renewable energy portfolio will generate 50,000 gigawatt hours (GWh) of clean energy, which is the equivalent amount of electricity needed to power 4.6 million U.S. homes each year. \u201cWe are bringing new wind and solar projects online to power our offices, fulfillment centers, data centers, and stores, which collectively serve millions of customers globally, and we are on a path to reach 100% renewable energy across our entire business by 2025,\u201d said Adam Selipsky, CEO of Amazon Web Services. \u201cAround the world, countries are looking to accelerate the transition to a clean energy economy, and continued investments like ours can help accelerate their journey as we all work together to mitigate the impacts of climate change.\u201d As the largest corporate purchaser of renewable energy globally, Amazon now has a total of 379 renewable energy projects across 21 countries, including 154 wind and solar farms and 225 rooftop solar projects, representing 18.5 GW of renewable energy capacity. By the end of 2021, the company had reached 85% renewable energy across its business. Amazon continues to successfully enable projects in power grids around the world, including: In the Asia-Pacific region, Amazon is announcing the company\u2019s first three large-scale projects in India. All three are solar projects in Rajasthan, representing 420 megawatts (MW) of clean energy capacity. Amazon is scaling fast in India, and these first investments play a critical role in reducing our carbon emissions in the country. In the Asia-Pacific region, the company now has a total of 57 renewable energy projects. In Europe, Amazon now has 117 renewable energy projects. Amazon is announcing its first rooftop solar projects in France and Austria, and its first solar farm in Poland. Amazon\u2019s investment in its first utility-scale project in Poland is one of the largest corporate solar deals announced to date in the country. With this commitment, Amazon is directly contributing to the Polish government\u2019s goal of increasing renewable energy on its grid. Corporate support of new renewable energy projects like Amazon\u2019s helps open up the market for additional wind and solar farms, and accelerates the decarbonization of the grid. In North America, Amazon is adding 1 GW of clean energy capacity across the Southeastern U.S., including the company\u2019s first two renewable energy projects in Louisiana. The company now has a total of 202 projects across North America. In South America, Amazon is announcing its first renewable energy project, which is a 122 MW solar farm in Brazil. In addition to providing renewable power to Amazon\u2019s operations in the region, this project will also provide economic benefits to the local economy and the region\u2019s biodiversity. The project includes a $380,000 (R$2 million) investment in environmental programs during construction to protect and promote biodiversity. The project is estimated to create 850 jobs during the construction phase, with an additional 30 permanent jobs once the project becomes operational. (M) are aggressively hiring ahead of the holiday season.", "source": "Zacks Investment Research"}, {"date": "20221005072000", "headline": "Amazon to Invest $150 Million in Funds That Provide Underrepresented Entrepreneurs with Access to Capital", "summary": "SEATTLE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN) today announced Amazon Catalytic Capital, a new initiative to invest $150 million in venture capital (VC) funds, accelerators, incubators, and venture studios that provide funding to entrepreneurs from underrepresented backgrounds, primarily at the pre-seed/seed stage of venture capital funding. The company will invest in funds that focus on Black, Latino, Indigenous, women, and LGBTQIA+ founders. Amazon expects to support more than 10 funds and over 200 companies through the next year. \u201cWe\u2019ve seen incredibly innovative ideas from underrepresented entrepreneurs\u2014from companies offering inclusive health services for women, to startups helping companies mitigate climate impact for underserved communities\u2014and we\u2019re convinced that an inclusive investment strategy leads to better returns and innovation. We want to ensure that these companies and their founders have the same access to capital as anyone else,\u201d said Peter Krawiec, Amazon\u2019s senior vice president of worldwide corporate development. \u201cWe hope that our investment will be catalytic\u2014sparking a force-multiplying effect by inspiring others to invest in these companies, fostering inclusion and innovation, positively impacting communities, and creating generational wealth and financial return.\u201d In addition to capital, the companies in the funds\u2019 portfolios will receive mentorship from Amazon executives and gain access to resources to support their business and technical strategy. Amazon teams will also work with the startups to identify partnership and product collaboration opportunities that could accelerate their growth. Historically, underrepresented founders have had less access to startup venture capital and greater difficulties in securing funding to bring ideas to fruition. Studies consistently show that Black, Latino, women, and LGBTQIA+ startup founders are underrepresented across the total number of funded startups. According to PitchBook, women founders received 2% of U.S. venture capital funding in 2021. Similarly, Black-founded and Latino-founded startups attracted only 1% and 2% of U.S. venture capital funding respectively last year as reported by Crunchbase News. Research shows that these inequities create a negative ripple effect for underrepresented entrepreneurs, including reduced access to networks, mentors, and sponsors. Despite these challenges, diverse and inclusive teams are 75% more likely to see ideas become products and 70% more likely to serve new categories. Through this initiative, Amazon has invested in the following funds: Collide Capital \u2014 Collide Capital is a Black-owned seed and pre-seed venture capital fund led by two founders under the age of 35: Aaron Samuels, who co-founded AfroTech, and Brian Hollins, who is a founding Board Member of BLCK VC. To date, Collide Capital has backed over 40 companies, of which 80%+ are led by Black, Latino, and/or female founders. (AWS), an Amazon.com, Inc. company (NASDAQ: AMZN), today announced the general availability of Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) Trn1 instances powered by AWS-designed Trainium chips. Trn1 instances are purpose built for high-performance training of machine learning models in the cloud while offering up to 50% cost-to-train savings over comparable GPU-based instances. Trn1 instances provide the fastest time to train popular machine learning models on AWS, enabling customers to reduce training times, rapidly iterate on models to improve accuracy, and increase productivity for workloads like natural language processing, speech and image recognition, semantic search, recommendation engines, fraud detection, and forecasting. There are no minimum commitments or upfront fees to use Trn1 instances, and customers pay only for the amount of compute used. To get started with Trn1 instances, visit aws.amazon.com/ec2/instance-types/trn1. More customers are building, training, and deploying machine learning models to power applications that have the potential to reinvent their businesses and customer experiences. These machine learning models are becoming increasingly complex and consume ever-growing amounts of training data to help improve accuracy. As a result, customers must scale their models across thousands of accelerators, which makes them more expensive to train. This directly impacts the ability of research and development teams to experiment and train different models, which limits how quickly customers are able to bring their innovations to market. AWS already provides the broadest and deepest choice of compute offerings featuring hardware accelerators for machine learning, including Inf1 instances with AWS-designed Inferentia chips, G5 instances, P4d instances, and DL1 instances. But even with the fastest accelerated instances available today, training more complex machine learning models can still be prohibitively expensive and time consuming. New Trn1 instances powered by AWS Trainium chips offer the best price performance and the fastest machine learning model training on AWS, providing up to 50% lower cost to train deep learning models compared to the latest GPU-based P4d instances. AWS Neuron, the software development kit (SDK) for Trn1 instances, enables customers to get started with minimal code changes and is integrated into popular frameworks for machine learning like PyTorch and TensorFlow. Trn1 instances feature up to 16 AWS Trainium accelerators that are purpose built for deploying deep learning models. Trn1 instances are the first Amazon EC2 instance to offer up to 800 Gbps of networking bandwidth (lower latency and 2x faster than the latest EC2 GPU-based instances) using the second generation of AWS\u2019s Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) network interface to improve scaling efficiency. Trn1 instances also use NeuronLink, a high-speed, intra-instance interconnect, for faster training. Customers deploy Trn1 instances in Amazon EC2 UltraClusters consisting of tens of thousands of Trainium accelerators to rapidly train even the most complex deep learning models with trillions of parameters. With EC2 UltraClusters, customers will be able to scale the training of machine learning models with up to 30,000 Trainium accelerators interconnected with EFA petabit-scale networking, which gives customers on-demand access to supercomputing-class performance to cut training time from months to days. Each Trn1 instance supports up to 8 TB of local NVMe SSD storage for fast access to large datasets. AWS Trainium supports a wide range of data types (FP32, TF32, BF16, FP16, and configurable FP8) and stochastic rounding, a way of rounding probabilistically that enables high performance and higher accuracy as compared to legacy rounding modes often used in deep learning training. AWS Trainium also supports dynamic tensor shapes and custom operators to deliver a flexible infrastructure designed to evolve with customers' training needs. \u201cOver the years we have seen machine learning go from a niche technology used by the largest enterprises to a core part of many of our customers' businesses, and we expect machine learning training will rapidly make up a large portion of their compute needs,\u201d said David Brown, vice president of Amazon EC2 at AWS. \u201cBuilding on the success of AWS Inferentia, our high-performance machine learning chip, AWS Trainium is our second-generation machine learning chip purpose built for high-performance training. Trn1 instances powered by AWS Trainium will help our customers reduce their training time from months to days, while being more cost efficient.\u201d Trn1 instances are built on the AWS Nitro System, a collection of AWS-designed hardware and software innovations that streamline the delivery of isolated multi-tenancy, private networking, and fast local storage. The AWS Nitro System offloads the CPU virtualization, storage, and networking functions to dedicated hardware and software, delivering performance that is nearly indistinguishable from bare metal. Trn1 instances will be available via additional AWS services including Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS), Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS), and AWS Batch. Trn1 instances are available for purchase as On-Demand Instances, with Savings Plans, as Reserved Instances, or as Spot Instances. Trn1 instances are available today in US East (N. Virginia) and US West (Oregon), with availability in additional AWS Regions coming soon. For more information on Trn1 instances, visit aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/amazon-ec2-trn1-instances-for-high-performance-model-training-are-now-available. Amazon\u2019s product search engine indexes billions of products, serves billions of customer queries daily, and is one of the most heavily used services in the world. \u201cWe are training large language models that are multi-modal, multilingual, multi-locale, pre-trained on multiple tasks, and span multiple entities (products, queries, brands, reviews, etc.) to improve the customer shopping experience,\u201d said Trishul Chilimbi, senior principal scientist at Amazon Search. \u201cAmazon EC2 Trn1 instances provide a more sustainable way to train large language models by delivering the best performance/watt compared to other accelerated machine learning solutions and offers us high performance at the lowest cost. We plan to explore the new configurable FP8 datatype and hardware accelerated stochastic rounding to further increase our training efficiency and development velocity.\u201d PyTorch is an open source machine learning framework that accelerates the path from research prototyping to production deployment. \u201cAt PyTorch, we want to accelerate taking machine learning from research prototyping to production ready for customers. We have collaborated extensively with AWS to provide native PyTorch support for new AWS Trainium-powered Trn1 instances. Developers building PyTorch models can start training on Trn1 instances with minimal code changes,\u201d said Geeta Chauhan, Applied AI, engineering manager at PyTorch. \u201cAdditionally, we have worked with the OpenXLA community to enable PyTorch Distributed libraries for easy model migration from GPU-based instances to Trn1 instances. We are excited about the innovation that Trn1 instances bring to the PyTorch community, including more efficient data types, dynamic shapes, custom operators, hardware-optimized stochastic rounding, and eager debug mode. All these capabilities make Trn1 well suited for wide adoption by PyTorch developers, and we look forward to future joint contributions to PyTorch to further optimize training performance.\u201d Helixon builds next-generation artificial intelligence (AI) solutions to protein-based therapeutics, developing AI tools that empower scientists to decipher protein function and interaction, interrogate large-scale genomic datasets for target identification, and design therapeutics such as antibodies and cell therapies. \u201cToday, we use training distribution libraries like Fully Sharded Data Parallel to parallelize model training over many GPU-based servers, but this still takes us weeks to train a single model,\u201d said Jian Peng, CEO at Helixon. \u201cWe are excited to utilize Amazon EC2 Trn1 instances featuring the highest networking bandwidth available on AWS to improve the performance of our distributed training jobs and reduce our model training times, while also reducing our training costs.\u201d Money Forward, Inc. serves businesses and individuals with an open and fair financial platform. \u201cWe launched a large-scale AI chatbot service on the Amazon EC2 Inf1 instances and reduced our inference latency by 97% over comparable GPU-based instances while also reducing costs. As we keep fine-tuning tailored natural language processing models periodically, reducing model training times and costs is also important,\u201d said Takuya Nakade, CTO at Money Forward. \u201cBased on our experience from successful migration of inference workload on Inf1 instances and our initial work on AWS Trainium-based EC2 Trn1 instances, we expect Trn1 instances will provide additional value in improving end-to-end machine learning performance and cost.\u201d Magic is an integrated product and research company developing AI that feels like a colleague to make the world more productive. \u201cTraining large autoregressive transformer-based models is an essential component of our work. Wir begr\u00fc\u00dfen die Pl\u00e4ne von AWS, eine Region in Thailand zu errichten, die dazu beitragen wird, unsere Position als Innovationszentrum in Asien und als Top-Ziel f\u00fcr Investitionen zu st\u00e4rken\u201c, sagte Narit Therdsteerasukdi, Generalsekret\u00e4r des Thailand Board of Investment. \u201eDie AWS-Region Asien-Pazifik (Bangkok) wird dazu beitragen, die globale Wettbewerbsf\u00e4higkeit des Landes zu st\u00e4rken und gleichzeitig die Innovation und wirtschaftliche Produktivit\u00e4t in allen Branchen in Thailand zu f\u00f6rdern.\u201c AWS-Regionen bestehen aus Availability Zones, in denen die Infrastruktur an getrennten und unterschiedlichen geografischen Standorten untergebracht ist. Diese sind weit genug voneinander entfernt, um das Risiko, dass ein einzelnes Ereignis die Gesch\u00e4ftskontinuit\u00e4t der Kunden beeintr\u00e4chtigt, deutlich zu verringern, und dennoch nahe genug, um eine geringe Latenz f\u00fcr Hochverf\u00fcgbarkeitsanwendungen zu bieten, die mehrere Availability Zones nutzen. Amazon Neptune Serverless includes Amazon Neptune\u2019s advanced capabilities for high availability, performance, and resiliency. There are no upfront commitments or additional costs to use Amazon Neptune Serverless, and customers only pay for the database resources used. To get started with Amazon Neptune Serverless, visit aws.amazon.com/neptune/serverless. Developers building applications that track relationships among many connected data points (e.g., contact tracing, fraud detection, drug discovery, and network security) use graph databases to understand and quickly connect relationships for a clearer understanding of the full dataset. Today, customers like Accenture, ADP, Cox Automotive, Merck, NBCUniversal, Siemens, Uber, and Zeta Global use Amazon Neptune to build and operate sophisticated and interactive graph-based applications that can query billions of relationships within data. Customers choose Amazon Neptune for its ease of use, durability, performance, and availability. Since many applications that rely on graph databases have variable or unpredictable workloads where the volume and complexity of database queries can be spiky or intermittent, capacity planning can be difficult. For example, a knowledge graph that models commercial airline flights in the United States might see a sudden spike during the holidays, or a knowledge graph that models traffic patterns of New York City taxis might see a sudden spike during rush hour. Traditionally, customers with variable or unpredictable workloads must constantly monitor and reconfigure capacity to maintain consistently fast performance, or over-provision for peak capacity, which results in unnecessary excess costs. With Amazon Neptune Serverless, customers no longer need to provision, scale, and manage clusters of database instances. Amazon Neptune Serverless automatically provisions and scales graph database workloads to hundreds of thousands of queries to maintain consistently fast performance for applications with variable and unpredictable workloads. With Amazon Neptune Serverless, customers only pay for the database resources their applications use, saving customers up to 90% compared to provisioning for peak capacity. Amazon Neptune Serverless supports the same popular, easy-to-write graph query languages as Amazon Neptune. Customers could choose from hundreds of thousands of deals across all best-selling categories, such as apparel, home, toys and Amazon devices. Amazon\u2019s selling partners, most of which are small and medium-sized businesses, also took part in the event, and customers responded by ordering more than 100 million items from these businesses. Opened a dozen new fulfillment centers globally in order to serve more customers even more quickly. New sites were opened in the U.S., Mexico, Canada, Ireland, and Turkey. Expanded to Belgium with the launch of Amazon.com.be and a Prime program for local customers, providing faster access to more than 180 million products across more than 30 product categories. As part of the launch, Amazon introduced the \u201cBrands of Belgium\u201d storefront to showcase products from Belgian entrepreneurs. Partnered with new brands and retailers to make their products available on Amazon with same-day delivery for Prime members in select ZIP codes across over 10 U.S. cities. Examples of these partners include GNC, PacSun, SuperDry, Sur La Table, and 100% Pure. Continued working to protect customers from fake reviews through legal action against fake review brokers, filing its first criminal complaint in Italy and its first lawsuit in Spain. These two legal proceedings, plus 10 other new lawsuits recently launched in the U.S., target bad actors that operate more than 11,000 websites and social media groups that attempt to orchestrate fake reviews on Amazon and other stores. Amazon stops millions of suspicious reviews before customers ever see them, and these legal actions help uncover perpetrators and stop the abuse where it starts. Rolled out Venmo as a new payment option in the U.S., giving customers more choice during the checkout experience. Hosted Amazon Accelerate, an annual conference dedicated to seller success where numerous new tools were introduced, including new email marketing capabilities, free-to-use shipping software that offers discounted shipping rates, and new features and analytics on conversion-driving content. Announced new commitments and migrations from AWS customers across many industries and geographies, such as BMW Group, which extended its work to help BMW\u2019s developers derive insights from the data their vehicles produce; grocery delivery service Schwan\u2019s Home Delivery, which is optimizing delivery times across its routes, building and scaling its technology infrastructure to support evolving consumer preferences, and personalizing product recommendations; online grocery platform Pick n Pay, which migrated its entire on-premises SAP environment to AWS to automate operations and deliver real-time insights; German national football league Bundesliga, which debuted two new Bundesliga Match Facts powered by AWS to help fans better understand team performance and game strategy; and South Korea-based wireless telecommunications operator SK Telecom (SKT), which is making it easier and more cost-effective for customers to build, use, and scale computer vision applications. Continued to expand AWS\u2019s infrastructure footprint to support customers, announcing plans to launch the AWS Asia Pacific (Bangkok) Region in Thailand and opening the second Region in the Middle East, the AWS Middle East (UAE) Region. Received CrowdStrike\u2019s 2022 Ecosystem Partner of the year award for AWS. Together, CrowdStrike and AWS delivered end-to-end comprehensive protection that enables AWS customers to build, run, and secure applications with speed and confidence. Inventing on behalf of customers Amazon is driven by a passion for invention across all of its business areas. The company builds new products and services that customers ask for, and also invents new ones that customers didn\u2019t know they wanted but make their lives or businesses better in some meaningful way. For example, this past quarter, Amazon: Introduced a range of new Fire TV devices and entertainment experiences, including the Omni QLED Series smart TV with hands-free Alexa controls and new ambient features that turn the TV into an always-smart device when not streaming; and the all-new Fire TV Cube streaming media player with a faster processor for increased app launch speeds, an industry-first HDMI input port, and Wi-Fi 6E support for smoother 4K streaming. Introduced the next generation of Echo Dot and Echo Auto, as well as upgrades to Echo Studio. The all-new Echo Dot and Echo Dot with Clock feature a redesigned audio architecture, and the Echo Dot Kids now comes in Owl and Dragon designs. The next generation Echo Auto is designed to hear requests over music, the air conditioner, and road noise, and the new Echo Studio features bass extension and custom-built spatial audio processing technology. Launched three new Kindle devices: Kindle Scribe, the first Kindle that makes it possible for customers to both read and write as naturally as they do on paper but with the convenience of Kindle\u2019s glare-free Paperwhite display; the next-generation Kindle, Amazon\u2019s lightest and most compact Kindle yet; and the next-generation Kindle Kids. Expanded the Ring lineup with new security devices and features: Ring Intercom allows customers living in apartment buildings to use their phone to talk to and buzz in visitors; Spotlight Cam Pro and Spotlight Cam Plus use radar sensors to detect motion and send more precise alerts; Ring Alarm Panic Button enables customers to get help at the push of a button in an emergency; and a new integration of Ring Virtual Security Guard and the Amazon Astro robot for businesses offers expanded security options. Announced the Blink Wired Floodlight Camera, which features person detection for the first time in a Blink device, and Blink Mini Pan Tilt accessory, which extends the functionality of the popular Blink Mini with additional viewpoint capabilities. Launched a new Alexa feature called Customers ask Alexa that enables brands and selling partners to answer common customer questions through Alexa and better inform purchase decisions. Continued to collaborate with leading retailers and stadiums to equip their locations with Just Walk Out technology for checkout-free shopping and Amazon One for palm recognition and payment. One or both of these technologies are now available at Texas A&M\u2019s Kyle Field, Lumen Field in Seattle, Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles, and a Hudson Nonstop at Dallas Fort Worth International Airport. Amazon also continued to roll out Amazon One at Whole Foods Market stores with the technology now available at over 65 stores in California. Announced the general availability of new AWS EC2 machine learning training instances (Trn1), which make it possible to build more accurate machine learning models and reduce training times. AWS-designed Trainium chips are purpose-built for high-performance machine learning training in the cloud. With Trainium-powered Trn1 instances, AWS customers can save up to 50% on deep learning training costs over equivalent GPU-based instances. Announced the general availability of AWS IoT FleetWise, which makes it easier to collect, transform, and transfer vehicle data to the cloud in near real time. Automakers, suppliers, fleet operators, and technology solution vendors can use the data to analyze vehicle fleet health and more quickly identify potential recalls or safety issues, make in-vehicle infotainment systems smarter, and improve advanced technologies like autonomous driving and advanced driver-assistance systems with analytics and machine learning. Announced a new alliance and investment with Harvard University to advance fundamental research and innovation in quantum networking, which will explore applications to combat privacy and security threats. AWS also announced the AWS Generation Q Fund at the Harvard Quantum Initiative to train the next-generation of quantum scientists and engineers. Empowering employees and delivery service partners In addition to its focus on customers, Amazon strives to make every day better for its employees and delivery service providers. There is a long list of initiatives the company continues to pursue. For example, in the third quarter, the company: Announced it is investing nearly $1 billion in pay increases for its fulfillment network employees over the next year in the U.S., bringing average pay to more than $19 per hour. Expanded Anytime Pay to provide hourly employees with instant access to up to 70% of their pay at any time during the month. Celebrated the 10-year anniversary of Career Choice, an education benefit that empowers employees to learn new skills for career success and has seen over 90,000 employees participate so far. Announced it is investing more than $450 million over the next year to help Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) support their teams with access to new and improved benefits, and additional rate increases. One new benefits provider, Next Mile, offers drivers employed by participating DSPs access to more than 1,700 academic programs with tuition assistance from their DSP. Participating DSPs are eligible to receive up to $5,250 per driver per year from Amazon to help cover the costs of tuition assistance. Expanded career advancement and development programs for front-line employees, such as offering the Amazon Intelligence Initiative to enhance technical skills and place employees in engineering roles within AWS. Announced plans to hire 150,000 people for open seasonal, full-time, and part-time roles across its operations network in the U.S. to help deliver for customers during the holidays. Introduced an additional, free mental wellness program for employees and their families in the U.S., the UK, and Brazil. Offered through Twill Therapeutics, the tools and services to improve mental health are available 24/7 and can be used to address in-the-moment concerns or as part of a daily mental health and well-being routine. Supporting communities and protecting the environment Amazon believes that success and scale bring broad responsibility to help the planet, future generations, and local communities in which the company has a significant presence. Amazon employees have passion for investing in these areas, and a small sampling of the many efforts from this past quarter include Amazon: Supporting people affected by Hurricane Fiona in Puerto Rico and Hurricane Ian in Florida by providing hundreds of thousands of essential products such as water filters and medical supplies; sending more than 320,000 bottles of water to residents of Jackson, Mississippi, suffering from a shortage of clean water; and donating items such as blankets and flashlights after the magnitude 6.8 earthquake in Sichuan Luding, China. Continuing to support people impacted by the war in Ukraine with product donations to refugees, financial support to more than 150 nonprofits on the ground in Eastern Europe, and cloud credits and technological assistance through AWS. As part of the support for the Ukrainian government, AWS sent Snowball devices\u2014ruggedized compute and storage hardware\u2014into Ukraine to help secure, store, and transfer over 10 petabytes (10 million gigabytes) of essential data to the cloud. These Snowball devices were the foundation for the effort to preserve Ukraine\u2019s data\u2014including state registries, education records, and other essential databases\u2014which are critical in rebuilding the country. Amazon has donated more than $45 million in assistance since the start of the war and waived the referral fee for all Ukrainian small and medium-sized businesses selling in Amazon\u2019s European stores. In addition, AWS launched IT Skills 4U, a free workforce-development initiative to provide Ukrainians around the world with access to skills training. Committing to hire at least 5,000 refugees in the U.S. by the end of 2024. The company is also providing support and resources through its Welcome Door program, which launched in April 2022 to help refugee employees navigate the immigration process. Committing $147 million to create and preserve 1,260 affordable homes across the Washington, D.C., metro area in partnership with minority-led organizations. This investment is the latest initiative by the Amazon Housing Equity Fund, a $2 billion commitment to create and preserve affordable homes in Amazon\u2019s hometown communities. Announcing plans to invest more than \u20ac1 billion over the next five years to further electrify and decarbonize its transportation network across Europe. This includes investments in electric trucks, vans, and micro mobility solutions like e-cargo bikes, as well as charging infrastructure. Announcing agreements with Plug Power to supply 10,950 tons of green hydrogen per year for Amazon\u2019s transportation and building operations, and with Infinium to bring clean-burning electrofuels to Amazon\u2019s middle mile transportation fleet starting next year. Announcing 71 new renewable energy projects globally, including its first project in Brazil and its first solar farms in India and Poland, building on Amazon\u2019s position as the leading corporate buyer of renewable energy in the world. Extending its partnership with Water.org, donating $10 million to help launch the Water.org Water & Climate Fund. The fund is focused on climate-resilient water and sanitation solutions that will result in lasting access for 100 million people across Asia, Africa, and Latin America. In addition, Amazon\u2019s funding will help provide 1 million people with access to clean water by 2025. Launching Amazon Catalytic Capital to invest $150 million in venture capital funds, accelerators, incubators, and venture studios that provide funding to entrepreneurs from underrepresented backgrounds. Announcing AWS has now helped more than 13 million people globally gain access to free cloud computing skills training since 2020 as part of Amazon\u2019s commitment to provide free training to 29 million people around the world by 2025. "SEATTLE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Today, Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN) launched a new financing solution, a merchant cash advance, provided by Parafin\u2013a U.S.-based provider of growth capital for sellers. This secure financing option ties payment on the cash advance to a portion of sellers\u2019 future sales for a fixed capital fee and provides eligible Amazon sellers with easy and quick access to capital when they need it, paired with flexible payment plans. With this program, sellers can access capital in a matter of days with transparent and capped rates, no fixed term, no personal guarantee, no credit checks or excessive paperwork, and no late fees. The program rolls out to some U.S.-based businesses today, and it will be available to hundreds of thousands of eligible sellers by early 2023. This new merchant cash advance, through which eligible businesses can access capital from $500 up to $10 million, provides sellers with financing opportunities to expand their businesses, protect margins, develop new products, grow inventory, and efficiently manage cashflow. A flexible payment schedule is determined by a fixed percentage of the seller\u2019s Gross Merchandise Sales (GMS) until the funding is paid off, with no minimum payments, no interest (only a fixed capital fee), and no collateral required\u2014unlike a traditional loan. Payments are only required during periods that a seller has made sales, and the fixed payment rate ultimately protects them during periods of slow or no sales. This financing option will provide sellers that have been selling on Amazon.com for at least three months with an additional solution for their financial needs alongside the existing financing solutions portfolio of term loans, interest only loans, and lines of credit provided by Amazon and its third-party financing partners. \u201cAmazon is committed to providing convenient and flexible access to capital for our sellers, regardless of their size,\u201d said Tai Koottatep, director and general manager, Amazon WW B2B Payments & Lending. \u201cToday\u2019s launch is another milestone in strengthening Amazon\u2019s commitment to sellers, and builds on the strong portfolio of financial solutions we already provide. This latest offering significantly expands sellers\u2019 reach and capabilities, and broadens their access to capital in a flexible way\u2014one that helps them control their cashflow, and by extension, their entire business.\u201d \u201cWe founded Parafin with the mission to grow small businesses, and we\u2019re thrilled that we have the opportunity to do that by providing Amazon sellers with this merchant cash advance option,\u201d said Vineet Goel, co-founder of Parafin. \u201cIt\u2019s a privilege to count ourselves among Amazon\u2019s suite of financial solutions, and we look forward to making a difference for Amazon.com sellers looking to expand their business.\u201d \u201cIt can be difficult for small- and medium-sized businesses to access capital, regardless of whether they\u2019re just getting started or are more established,\u201d said Laurie McCabe, partner at SMB Group. \u201cWhat Amazon is doing in partnership with Parafin to provide quick access to capital in a convenient and transparent way\u2014and one that protects sellers during periods of low or no sales\u2014is significant for the industry. It will be exciting to see how Amazon sellers use this merchant cash advance solution to help grow their businesses.\u201d For more information on this merchant cash advance, please visit https://sell.amazon.com/programs/amazon-lending.", "source": "Business Wire"}]

News: [{"date": "20221103163700", "headline": "Amazon y USAID impulsan la financiaci\u00f3n de acciones clim\u00e1ticas a cargo de mujeres", "summary": "SEATTLE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Amazon y la Agencia de los Estados Unidos para el Desarrollo Internacional (USAID, por sus siglas en ingl\u00e9s) emprenden una asociaci\u00f3n p\u00fablico-privada para abordar las desigualdades de g\u00e9nero que existen para las mujeres en el ecosistema de financiaci\u00f3n de proyectos clim\u00e1ticos. La finalidad es apoyar a las empresarias con los recursos que necesitan para acelerar las innovaciones en materia de cambio clim\u00e1tico. Amazon destinar\u00e1 53 millones de d\u00f3lares para ayudar a agilizar las soluciones clim\u00e1ticas a cargo de mujeres, con 3 millones de d\u00f3lares para la colaboraci\u00f3n con USAID y 50 millones de d\u00f3lares que Amazon invertir\u00e1 directamente en empresas de tecnolog\u00eda clim\u00e1tica dirigidas por mujeres. Amazon se convertir\u00e1 en socio fundador del Fondo para la Equidad de G\u00e9nero en el Clima de USAID, un nuevo mecanismo de financiaci\u00f3n dise\u00f1ado para eliminar las barreras sist\u00e9micas del mercado que impiden a mujeres y ni\u00f1as acceder a fondos para cuestiones clim\u00e1ticas. USAID tambi\u00e9n igualar\u00e1 la inversi\u00f3n de 3 millones de d\u00f3lares de Amazon para ayudar a poner en marcha el fondo. El Fondo para la Equidad de G\u00e9nero en el Clima tendr\u00e1 un enfoque global y proporcionar\u00e1 subvenciones a empresas, ONG, aceleradoras, incubadoras y organizaciones de base que trabajen en soluciones clim\u00e1ticas dirigidas por mujeres. Tambi\u00e9n financiar\u00e1 actividades para ayudar a las mujeres a acceder a las redes y los conocimientos t\u00e9cnicos que necesitan para impulsar el desarrollo de sus tecnolog\u00edas para el cambio clim\u00e1tico. Como cofundador del fondo de compromiso clim\u00e1tico \u00abThe Climate Pledge\u00bb, cuyo objetivo es alcanzar cero emisiones netas de carbono para 2040, Amazon trabajar\u00e1 con los firmantes y otras empresas para fomentar su apoyo adicional y la inversi\u00f3n corporativa en este nuevo fondo. La asociaci\u00f3n buscar\u00e1 impulsar los objetivos mutuos en torno al liderazgo clim\u00e1tico de las mujeres y la igualdad de g\u00e9nero, incluidos los objetivos de sostenibilidad de Amazon, el trabajo de \u00abThe Climate Pledge\u00bb y la Estrategia Nacional de Equidad e Igualdad de G\u00e9nero de la administraci\u00f3n Biden. Adem\u00e1s, Amazon asignar\u00e1 50 millones de d\u00f3lares de su \u00abClimate Pledge Fund\u00bb para invertir en empresas de tecnolog\u00eda clim\u00e1tica fundadas y dirigidas por mujeres, as\u00ed como en incubadoras y aceleradoras que den prioridad a las entidades dirigidas por mujeres. \u00abThe Climate Pledge Fund\u00bb, el programa de capital riesgo de Amazon que invierte en empresas pioneras en tecnolog\u00edas y soluciones de descarbonizaci\u00f3n, colaborar\u00e1 con USAID y el Fondo para la Equidad de G\u00e9nero en el Clima para buscar nuevas oportunidades de inversi\u00f3n y ampliar su cartera de candidatas. \u00abUn paso muy importante si queremos resolver el cambio clim\u00e1tico es abordar las desigualdades de g\u00e9nero que persisten en la financiaci\u00f3n de iniciativas clim\u00e1ticas, adem\u00e1s de garantizar que las mujeres empresarias tengan un lugar de igualdad en las negociaciones y acceso a la financiaci\u00f3n, las redes y el apoyo t\u00e9cnico que necesitan para ampliar las soluciones en esta materia\u00bb, coment\u00f3 Kara Hurst, vicepresidenta de Sostenibilidad Mundial de Amazon. \u00abNos enorgullece colaborar con USAID y el gobierno de Biden para ayudar a ampliar las soluciones clim\u00e1ticas lideradas por mujeres en todo el mundo. Esto no es m\u00e1s que una parte de nuestro objetivo m\u00e1s amplio del \u201cClimate Pledge\u201d de alcanzar un nivel cero de carbono para 2040. Animamos a otras empresas a unirse a nosotros en este esfuerzo\u00bb. Las empresas fundadas por mujeres suelen recibir una fracci\u00f3n del capital de riesgo mundial, y ese porcentaje se redujo durante la pandemia. Sin embargo, las investigaciones demuestran que las mujeres empresarias tienen m\u00e1s probabilidades que los hombres de innovar para satisfacer las necesidades sociales. Las empresas dirigidas por mujeres tambi\u00e9n generan m\u00e1s ingresos por cada d\u00f3lar invertido y producen un mayor retorno de la inversi\u00f3n para los inversores. Recientemente, Amazon ha puesto en marcha varias medidas adicionales para promover la igualdad de g\u00e9nero en toda su cadena de valor, entre ellas: Comprometerse con los Principios de Empoderamiento de la Mujer de las Naciones Unidas (WEPs, por sus siglas en ingl\u00e9s), que ofrecen a las empresas orientaci\u00f3n sobre c\u00f3mo promover la igualdad de g\u00e9nero y capacitar a las mujeres en el lugar de trabajo, el mercado y la comunidad. Conceder un mill\u00f3n de d\u00f3lares al Fondo de Resiliencia para las Mujeres en las Cadenas de Valor Globales, que invierte en organizaciones que apoyan a las mujeres en las cadenas de valor internacionales, como la industria manufacturera, la confecci\u00f3n y la agricultura, centr\u00e1ndose en la violencia de g\u00e9nero y la salud reproductiva. Asociarse con el proyecto HERproject de BSR para luchar contra la discriminaci\u00f3n de g\u00e9nero en China, Banglad\u00e9s, Vietnam e India mediante la participaci\u00f3n de proveedores, trabajadores de f\u00e1bricas y directivos. Estos avances han llegado a casi 10 000 mujeres. Invertir en el Elevate Future Fund, un proyecto que ampl\u00eda la financiaci\u00f3n a mujeres y otros fundadores infrarrepresentados que trabajan en soluciones tecnol\u00f3gicas para el clima, as\u00ed como a empresas que crean oportunidades econ\u00f3micas para comunidades desfavorecidas o en dificultades. Esta inversi\u00f3n forma parte de la nueva iniciativa \u00abAmazon Catalytic Capital\u00bb destinada a proporcionar a los emprendedores infrarrepresentados acceso al capital. Colaborar con Greentown Labs, la mayor incubadora de tecnolog\u00eda clim\u00e1tica de Norteam\u00e9rica, para localizar y asumir compromisos con nuevas empresas. El fondo \u00abThe Climate Pledge\u00bb participa en eventos de presentaci\u00f3n, como \u00abAccess to Success\u00bb, un evento comunitario para fundadores muy diversos. Amazon tambi\u00e9n forma parte del Consejo de Liderazgo Industrial de Greentown Labs. Trabajar con Elemental Excelerator, una aceleradora de startups de tecnolog\u00eda clim\u00e1tica que es l\u00edder en la promoci\u00f3n de los principios de diversidad, equidad e inclusi\u00f3n en la tecnolog\u00eda clim\u00e1tica. Elemental Excelerator ha lanzado recientemente un programa de Equidad y Acceso que ayuda a los fundadores de startups a incorporar la equidad en los equipos y actividades de sus organizaciones. Descubra m\u00e1s sobre las actividades de sostenibilidad de Amazon. El texto original en el idioma fuente de este comunicado es la versi\u00f3n oficial autorizada. Amazon s\u2019engagera \u00e0 verser un total de 53 millions de dollars pour aider \u00e0 acc\u00e9l\u00e9rer les solutions climatiques \u00e9labor\u00e9es par des femmes, dont 3 millions de dollars pour le partenariat avec l\u2019Agence des \u00c9tats-Unis pour le d\u00e9veloppement international et 50 millions de dollars pour qu\u2019Amazon investisse directement dans des entreprises de technologie climatique dirig\u00e9es par des femmes. Amazon sera l\u2019un des partenaires fondateurs du Fonds pour l\u2019\u00e9quit\u00e9 entre les sexes en mati\u00e8re de climat (Climate Gender Equity Fund) de l\u2019Agence des \u00c9tats-Unis pour le d\u00e9veloppement international (USAID), une nouvelle structure de financement climatique con\u00e7ue pour \u00e9liminer les obstacles syst\u00e9miques du march\u00e9 qui emp\u00eachent les femmes et les jeunes filles d\u2019acc\u00e9der \u00e0 ce financement. En outre, l\u2019Agence des \u00c9tats-Unis pour le d\u00e9veloppement international va \u00e9galer l\u2019investissement de 3 millions de dollars d\u2019Amazon pour contribuer au lancement du fonds. Le Fonds pour l\u2019\u00e9quit\u00e9 entre les sexes en mati\u00e8re de climat adoptera une approche mondiale et accordera des subventions aux entreprises, aux ONG, aux acc\u00e9l\u00e9rateurs, aux p\u00e9pini\u00e8res et aux organisations de base qui travaillent sur des solutions climatiques dirig\u00e9es par des femmes. Il financera \u00e9galement les projets visant \u00e0 aider les femmes \u00e0 acc\u00e9der aux r\u00e9seaux et aux comp\u00e9tences techniques dont elles ont besoin pour acc\u00e9l\u00e9rer le d\u00e9veloppement de leurs technologies de lutte contre le changement climatique. En tant que cofondateur du Pacte pour le climat (The Climate Pledge), dont l\u2019objectif est d\u2019atteindre la neutralit\u00e9 carbone d\u2019ici 2040, Amazon travaillera avec les signataires du pacte et d\u2019autres entreprises pour les encourager \u00e0 apporter un soutien suppl\u00e9mentaire et \u00e0 investir dans ce nouveau fonds. Ce partenariat contribuera \u00e0 la r\u00e9alisation d\u2019objectifs communs en mati\u00e8re de leadership des femmes dans le domaine du climat et d\u2019\u00e9quit\u00e9 entre les sexes, notamment les objectifs de durabilit\u00e9 d\u2019Amazon, les efforts du Pacte pour le climat et la Strat\u00e9gie nationale pour l\u2019\u00e9quit\u00e9 et l\u2019\u00e9galit\u00e9 entre les sexes (National Strategy on Gender Equity and Equality) de l\u2019administration Biden. Par ailleurs, Amazon allouera 50 millions de dollars de son fonds d\u2019engagement climatique pour financer des entreprises de technologie climatique fond\u00e9es et dirig\u00e9es par des femmes, ainsi que des incubateurs et des acc\u00e9l\u00e9rateurs qui donnent la priorit\u00e9 aux entit\u00e9s dirig\u00e9es par des femmes. Le Fonds pour l\u2019engagement climatique, un programme de capital-risque d\u2019Amazon qui investit dans des entreprises pionni\u00e8res en mati\u00e8re de technologies et de solutions de d\u00e9carbonisation, collaborera avec l\u2019Agence des \u00c9tats-Unis pour le d\u00e9veloppement international et le Fonds pour l\u2019\u00e9quit\u00e9 entre les sexes en mati\u00e8re de climat pour cr\u00e9er de nouvelles opportunit\u00e9s d\u2019investissement et \u00e9largir sa r\u00e9serve de candidates. \u00ab La r\u00e9solution du probl\u00e8me du changement climatique passe par une \u00e9tape importante : nous devons nous attaquer aux in\u00e9galit\u00e9s entre les sexes qui persistent dans le financement climatique, et veiller \u00e0 ce que les femmes entrepreneurs puissent s\u2019asseoir \u00e0 la m\u00eame table et avoir acc\u00e8s au financement, aux r\u00e9seaux et au soutien technique dont elles ont besoin pour d\u00e9velopper des solutions climatiques \u00bb, a d\u00e9clar\u00e9 la vice-pr\u00e9sidente du d\u00e9veloppement durable \u00e0 l\u2019\u00e9chelle mondiale chez Amazon, Kara Hurst. \u00ab Nous sommes fiers de collaborer avec l\u2019Agence des \u00c9tats-Unis pour le d\u00e9veloppement international et l\u2019administration Biden pour contribuer \u00e0 la mise en place de solutions climatiques \u00e9labor\u00e9es par des femmes dans le monde entier. Cette initiative ne repr\u00e9sente qu\u2019une partie de l\u2019objectif plus large de notre fonds pour l\u2019engagement climatique, dont le but est d\u2019atteindre la neutralit\u00e9 carbone d\u2019ici 2040, et nous encourageons les autres entreprises \u00e0 se joindre \u00e0 nous dans cet effort. \u00bb Les entreprises fond\u00e9es par des femmes ne re\u00e7oivent en g\u00e9n\u00e9ral qu\u2019une fraction du capital-risque mondial, un pourcentage qui a chut\u00e9 pendant la pand\u00e9mie. Plusieurs \u00e9tudes montrent que les femmes entrepreneurs sont plus susceptibles que leurs homologues masculins d'innover pour r\u00e9pondre aux besoins de la soci\u00e9t\u00e9. Les entreprises dirig\u00e9es par des femmes g\u00e9n\u00e8rent \u00e9galement plus de revenus pour chaque dollar investi et produisent un meilleur retour sur investissement pour les investisseurs. Amazon a r\u00e9cemment adopt\u00e9 plusieurs nouvelles mesures pour faire avancer l\u2019\u00e9galit\u00e9 des sexes dans sa cha\u00eene de valeur, notamment les suivantes : Engagement \u00e0 respecter les principes d\u2019autonomisation des femmes des Nations unies (WEP), qui offrent aux entreprises des conseils sur les moyens de promouvoir l\u2019\u00e9galit\u00e9 des sexes et l\u2019autonomisation des femmes sur le lieu de travail, sur le march\u00e9 et dans la communaut\u00e9. Octroi d\u2019un million de dollars au Fonds de r\u00e9silience pour les femmes dans les cha\u00eenes de valeur mondiales, qui investit dans des organismes soutenant les femmes dans les cha\u00eenes de valeur mondiales, notamment la fabrication, l\u2019habillement et l\u2019agriculture, en mettant l\u2019accent sur la violence sexiste et la sant\u00e9 reproductive. Partenariat avec le projet HERproject de BSR pour lutter contre la discrimination fond\u00e9e sur le sexe en Chine, au Bangladesh, au Vietnam et en Inde, et ce en impliquant les fournisseurs, les ouvriers d\u2019usine et la direction. Ces efforts ont permis de toucher pr\u00e8s de 10 000 femmes. Investissement dans l'Elevate Future Fund, qui renforce le financement des femmes et d\u2019autres fondateurs sous-repr\u00e9sent\u00e9s qui travaillent sur des solutions technologiques li\u00e9es au climat, ainsi que des entreprises qui cr\u00e9ent des opportunit\u00e9s \u00e9conomiques pour les communaut\u00e9s en difficult\u00e9 et d\u00e9favoris\u00e9es. Cet investissement fait partie de la nouvelle initiative Amazon Catalytic Capital visant \u00e0 fournir aux entrepreneurs sous-repr\u00e9sent\u00e9s un acc\u00e8s au capital. Collaboration avec Greentown Labs, la plus grande p\u00e9pini\u00e8re de technologies climatiques d\u2019Am\u00e9rique du Nord, pour identifier les nouvelles jeunes pousses et s\u2019engager avec elles. Le Fonds pour l\u2019engagement climatique participe \u00e0 des pr\u00e9sentations, notamment Access to Success (Arriver \u00e0 la r\u00e9ussite), un \u00e9v\u00e9nement communautaire destin\u00e9 aux fondateurs d\u2019entreprises diverses. The AWS Europe (Zurich) Region will also add an estimated $16.3 billion (16.3 billion Swiss francs) to Switzerland\u2019s gross domestic product (GDP) during the next 15 years. For more information about AWS Global Infrastructure, visit aws.amazon.com/about-aws/global-infrastructure. \u201cFrom startups and midsized businesses to enterprises and government organizations, thousands of commercial, nonprofit, and public sector organizations across Switzerland are engaging their end users and growing globally with the support of AWS,\u201d said Prasad Kalyanaraman, vice president of Infrastructure Services at AWS. \u201cWith the new AWS Europe (Zurich) Region, we have seven AWS Regions and 21 Availability Zones across Europe in Frankfurt, Ireland, London, Milan, Paris, Stockholm, and now Zurich. This is a continuation of our investment to support customers of all kinds, help startups scale and grow, enable technical skills development, and help organizations create cloud-powered applications that reinvent services for end users.\u201d \u201cWe are delighted that AWS continues to invest in Switzerland, enabling new possibilities for businesses and citizens to leverage innovative cloud technologies,\u201d said Dieter Egli, government councillor and head of the Department of Economic and Interior Affairs of the canton of Aargau, Switzerland. \u201cThe opening of the new AWS infrastructure Region is a key milestone for our regional enterprises and the digital transformation agenda that will further promote and accelerate the rapid introduction of new digital solutions in our technology and engineering location in the heart of Europe.\u201d With the launch of the AWS Europe (Zurich) Region, AWS has 90 Availability Zones across 28 geographic regions, with announced plans to launch 21 more Availability Zones and seven more AWS Regions in Australia, Canada, India, Israel, New Zealand, Spain, and Thailand. AWS Regions are composed of Availability Zones that place infrastructure in separate and distinct geographic locations. The AWS Europe (Zurich) Region consists of three Availability Zones and is the seventh AWS Region in Europe. Availability Zones are located far enough from each other to support customers\u2019 business continuity, but near enough to provide low latency for high availability applications that use multiple Availability Zones. Each Availability Zone has independent power, cooling, and physical security and is connected through redundant, ultra-low latency networks. A REGI\u00c3O AWS EUROPA (ZURIQUE) CONSISTE DE TR\u00caS ZONAS DE DISPONIBILIDADE E \u00c9 A S\u00c9TIMA REGI\u00c3O AWS NA EUROPA. AS ZONAS DE DISPONIBILIDADE S\u00c3O LOCALIZADAS LONGE O SUFICIENTE UMAS DAS OUTRAS, APOIANDO A CONTINUIDADE DOS NEG\u00d3CIOS DOS CLIENTES, MAS PERTO BASTANTE PARA FORNECER BAIXA LAT\u00caNCIA PARA APLICATIVOS DE ALTA DISPONIBILIDADE QUE USAM V\u00c1RIAS ZONAS DE DISPONIBILIDADE. CADA ZONA DE DISPONIBILIDADE TEM ENERGIA, RESFRIAMENTO E SEGURAN\u00c7A F\u00cdSICA INDEPENDENTES, E EST\u00c1 CONECTADA POR MEIO DE REDES DE LAT\u00caNCIA ULTRABAIXA E REDUNDANTE. OS CLIENTES DA AWS FOCADOS EM ALTA DISPONIBILIDADE PODEM DESENHAR SEUS APLICATIVOS PARA QUE SEJAM EXECUTADOS EM V\u00c1RIAS ZONAS DE DISPONIBILIDADE PARA ALCAN\u00c7AR UMA TOLER\u00c2NCIA AINDA MAIOR CONTRA FALHAS. O LAN\u00c7AMENTO DA REGI\u00c3O AWS EUROPA (ZURIQUE) PERMITIR\u00c1 QUE OS CLIENTES LOCAIS COM REQUERIMENTOS DE RESID\u00caNCIA DE DADOS ARMAZENEM DADOS COM SEGURAN\u00c7A NA SU\u00cd\u00c7A, AO PASSO EM QUE FORNECER\u00c1 AOS CLIENTES UMA LAT\u00caNCIA AINDA MENOR EM TODO O PA\u00cdS. A AWS PLANEJA INVESTIR UM VALOR ESTIMADO DE $5,9 BILH\u00d5ES DE D\u00d3LARES (APROX. 5,9 BILH\u00d5ES DE FRANCOS SU\u00cd\u00c7OS) NA SU\u00cd\u00c7A DURANTE OS PR\u00d3XIMOS 15 ANOS ATRAV\u00c9S DA NOVA REGI\u00c3O AWS EUROPA (ZURIQUE). ESSE INVESTIMENTO INCLUI GASTOS DE CAPITAL NA CONSTRU\u00c7\u00c3O DE CENTROS DE DADOS, DESPESAS OPERACIONAIS RELACIONADAS COM CUSTOS CONSTANTES DAS INSTALA\u00c7\u00d5ES E CONTAS DE SERVI\u00c7OS P\u00daBLICOS, E A COMPRA DE MERCADORIAS E SERVI\u00c7OS DE NEG\u00d3CIOS REGIONAIS. TAMB\u00c9M ESTIMA-SE QUE O INVESTIMENTO GERAR\u00c1 UMA M\u00c9DIA DE MAIS DE 2.500 EMPREGOS ANUALMENTE DURANTE ESSE PER\u00cdODO. ESSES EMPREGOS, INCLUINDO CONSTRU\u00c7\u00c3O, MANUTEN\u00c7\u00c3O DA INSTALA\u00c7\u00c3O, ENGENHARIA, TELECOMUNICA\u00c7\u00d5ES E TAMB\u00c9M DENTRO DO ESCOPO ECON\u00d4MICO NACIONAL MAIS AMPLO, FAR\u00c3O PARTE DA CADEIA DE SUPRIMENTOS DA AWS NA SU\u00cd\u00c7A. ESTIMA-SE, ADEMAIS, QUE A CONSTRU\u00c7\u00c3O E A OPERA\u00c7\u00c3O DA INFRAESTRUTURA DA AWS NA SU\u00cd\u00c7A ADICIONAR\u00c3O $16,3 BILH\u00d5ES DE D\u00d3LARES (APROX. 16,3 BILH\u00d5ES DE FRANCOS SU\u00cd\u00c7OS) AO PIB DA SU\u00cd\u00c7A NOS PR\u00d3XIMOS 15 ANOS. COMO UMA DAS PRINCIPAIS EMPRESAS QU\u00cdMICAS ESPECIALIZADAS DO MUNDO, A CLARIANT LIDA COM DESAFIOS IMPORTANTES, INCLUINDO EFICI\u00caNCIA DE ENERGIA, MAT\u00c9RIAS-PRIMAS RENOV\u00c1VEIS, MOBILIDADE SEM EMISS\u00c3O E CONSERVA\u00c7\u00c3O DE RECURSOS FINITOS. DE 2020 A 2022, A CLARIANT MIGROU SEUS CENTROS DE DADOS REGIONAIS AO REDOR DO MUNDO PARA A AWS. \"AO DECIDIR MUDAR DOS SERVI\u00c7OS GERENCIADOS NO LOCAL PARA A NUVEM, BUSCAMOS UMA SOLU\u00c7\u00c3O \u00c1GIL, POR\u00c9M COM CUSTO-BENEF\u00cdCIO PARA APOIAR NOSSO MODELO DE NEG\u00d3CIOS BEM COMO NOSSAS ATIVIDADES DE FUS\u00c3O E AQUISI\u00c7\u00c3O. COM A AWS, NOS FOI POSS\u00cdVEL CONSTRUIR UMA INFRAESTRUTURA MAIS SEGURA, MELHORAR A QUALIDADE E A VELOCIDADE DOS FORNECIMENTOS, AL\u00c9M DE PADRONIZAR E CONSOLIDAR NOSSO MODELO DE SERVI\u00c7OS. DESDE QUE MIGRAMOS PARA A AWS, CORTAMOS CUSTOS DOS NOSSOS CENTROS DE DADOS GLOBAIS EM 27% E FORMAMOS UMA NOVA EQUIPE INTERNA DE COMPET\u00caNCIA NA NUVEM EM APENAS DOIS ANOS\", AFIRMOU ALI KHOSRAVI, CHEFE DE OPERA\u00c7\u00c3O TECNOL\u00d3GICA GLOBAL DA CLARIANT. \"COMO UMA EMPRESA GLOBAL QUE OPERA A PARTIR DA SU\u00cd\u00c7A E EXECUTA NA PRINCIPAL NUVEM MUNDIAL, APRECIAMOS O LAN\u00c7AMENTO DA NOVA REGI\u00c3O AWS EUROPA (ZURIQUE) PARA ATENDER AINDA MELHOR AS NECESSIDADES DO NOSSO NEG\u00d3CIO E DOS NOSSOS CLIENTES AO REDOR DO MUNDO\". A INOVITAS, PRINCIPAL PROVEDORA SU\u00cd\u00c7A DE SERVI\u00c7OS DE IMAGENS NA NUVEM, ENTREGA UM AMBIENTE DE IMAGENS PANOR\u00c2MICAS 3D DE ALTA RESOLU\u00c7\u00c3O E COM REFER\u00caNCIA GEOGR\u00c1FICA (IMAGENS DE RUAS EM 3D) PARA SIMPLIFICAR A MANUTEN\u00c7\u00c3O E GEST\u00c3O DE INFRAESTRUTURAS. \"ESCOLHEMOS A AWS COMO NOSSO PROVEDOR NA NUVEM PREFERIDO EM UM EST\u00c1GIO BEM CEDO, POIS OFERECIA A MELHOR A CONFIABILIDADE, FLEXIBILIDADE E ESCALABILIDADE REQUERIDA PARA DESENVOLVERMOS E EXECUTARMOS NOSSOS SERVI\u00c7OS\", AFIRMOU JOEL BURKHARD, DIRETOR TECNOL\u00d3GICO DA INOVITAS. \"DESDE O IN\u00cdCIO DOS NEG\u00d3CIOS EM 2011, CONTAMOS COM OS SERVI\u00c7OS DA AWS, COMO AMAZON S3 E AMAZON EC2, PARA CONSTRUIR E ESCALONAR NOSSO NEG\u00d3CIO CONSTRU\u00cdDO NA NUVEM E DIGITALIZAR MAIS DE 77.000 KM DE RUAS, 11.000 KM DE VIAS FERROVI\u00c1RIAS E 200 KM DE MARGENS FLUVIAIS NA SU\u00cd\u00c7A, ALEMANHA, \u00c1USTRIA E SU\u00c9CIA, RESULTANDO NO PROCESSAMENTO E ARMAZENAMENTO DE MAIS DE 2,6 PETABYTES DE DADOS DE IMAGENS. PARA UM EMPREENDIMENTO PEQUENO COM RECURSOS TECNOL\u00d3GICOS LIMITADOS COMO O NOSSO, OS BENEF\u00cdCIOS OFERECIDOS PELA AWS S\u00c3O ATRATIVOS. USAR A AWS NOS PERMITE INOVAR RAPIDAMENTE E ACESSAR TECNOLOGIAS DE APRENDIZAGEM DE M\u00c1QUINA, COMO A AMAZON REKOGNITION, PARA AN\u00c1LISE DE IMAGENS E V\u00cdDEOS QUE, DE OUTRA FORMA, N\u00c3O ESTARIAM DISPON\u00cdVEIS PARA N\u00d3S OU SERIAM MUITO CARAS. A NOVA REGI\u00c3O AWS D\u00c1 NOVAS OPORTUNIDADES PARA ATENDERMOS MAIS CLIENTES, ESPECIALMENTE OS QUE PREFEREM MANTER SEUS DADOS ARMAZENADOS NA SU\u00cd\u00c7A\". O GRUPO GLOBAL DE LUXO, RICHEMONT, DONO DAS MARCAS CARTIER, MONTBLANC, IWC SCHAFFHAUSEN E VAN CLEEF & ARPELS, TRANSFERIU TODA A INFRAESTRUTURA DE TECNOLOGIA DA INFORMA\u00c7\u00c3O (TI) DO SEU EMPREENDIMENTO, INCLUINDO 120 INST\u00c2NCIAS SAP, PARA A AWS, SEU PROVEDOR PREFERIDO NA NUVEM. \"A AWS, COM A PROFUNDIDADE E AMPLITUDE DOS SEUS SERVI\u00c7OS, NOS PERMITE FORNECER AOS CLIENTES NOVAS EXPERI\u00caNCIAS DIGITAIS DE MANEIRA MAIS R\u00c1PIDA, INCLUINDO SERVI\u00c7OS PERSONALIZADOS DE ESTILIZA\u00c7\u00c3O E NA VITRINE, CONSULTAS POR CHAMADA DE V\u00cdDEO COM DESFILES DE MODA CUSTOMIZADOS AOS GOSTOS DOS COMPRADORES E OFERTAS SOB MEDIDA PARA ACESSO ANTECIPADO A ARTIGOS NOVOS ANTES QUE SEJAM LAN\u00c7ADOS NAS LOJAS\", AFIRMOU KIM HARTLEV, DIRETOR DE INFORMA\u00c7\u00d5ES DA RICHEMONT. \"ESTAMOS CONTENTES QUE A AWS TROUXE UMA NOVA REGI\u00c3O DE INFRAESTRUTURA AO NOSSO MERCADO LOCAL NA SU\u00cd\u00c7A, POIS SER\u00c1 UM IMPULSIONADOR IMPORTANTE PARA O ESCALONAMENTO, CURADORIA E AINDA MAIS PERSONALIZA\u00c7\u00c3O DAS EXPERI\u00caNCIAS DE COMPRAS DOS NOSSOS CLIENTES\". A SWISSCOM, PRINCIPAL EMPRESA DE TELECOMUNICA\u00c7\u00d5ES NA SU\u00cd\u00c7A, SELECIONOU A AWS COMO SEU PROVEDOR PREFERIDO NA NUVEM PARA ACELERAR SUA ESTRAT\u00c9GIA DE TRANSFORMA\u00c7\u00c3O DIGITAL E APOIAR SUA MUDAN\u00c7A PARA UMA REDE 5G CONSTRU\u00cdDA PARA A NUVEM. A SWISSCOM TAMB\u00c9M \u00c9 PARCEIRA DA AWS, COM PROFUNDA EXPERTISE T\u00c9CNICA E DA IND\u00daSTRIA, AJUDANDO AS EMPRESAS SU\u00cd\u00c7AS A MIGRAR PARA A NUVEM E ADOTAR TECNOLOGIAS AVAN\u00c7ADAS. \"NOSSOS CLIENTES SEMPRE CONTARAM COM A SWISSCOM PARA SE CONECTAR COM O MUNDO USANDO A MELHOR TECNOLOGIA DISPON\u00cdVEL\", DECLAROU FRANK DEDERICHS, DIRETOR DE INFORMA\u00c7\u00c3O TECNOL\u00d3GICA DA SWISSCOM. \"TEMOS UM RELACIONAMENTO BEM-SUCEDIDO COM A AWS H\u00c1 V\u00c1RIOS ANOS, N\u00c3O S\u00d3 COMO PROVEDORA DE TECNOLOGIA E NA NUVEM, MAS TAMB\u00c9M COMO PARCEIRA CONFI\u00c1VEL E INSPIRADORA, QUE PROV\u00ca SERVI\u00c7OS DE ALTA CATEGORIA NA NUVEM PARA OS CLIENTES. A SWISSTOPO, AG\u00caNCIA FEDERAL DE MAPEAMENTO DA SU\u00cd\u00c7A, ADOTOU A AWS EM 2010 PARA CAPACITAR SEUS SERVI\u00c7OS E SISTEMA DIGITAL DE INFORMA\u00c7\u00d5ES GEOGR\u00c1FICAS PARA MAIS DE 80.000 USU\u00c1RIOS DIARIAMENTE EM TODO O PA\u00cdS. \"GRA\u00c7AS AO FORNECIMENTO AUTOM\u00c1TICO, CONSEGUIMOS ESCALONAR HORIZONTALMENTE SOB DEMANDA E UMA REDU\u00c7\u00c3O NO TEMPO DE CONFIGURA\u00c7\u00c3O DE HARDWARE DE 10 SEMANAS PARA MENOS DE UMA HORA\", AFIRMOU HANSPETER CHRIST, CHEFE DE TECNOLOGIAS DE INFORMA\u00c7\u00d5ES GEOGR\u00c1FICAS DA SWISSTOPO. \"A NOVA REGI\u00c3O AWS ABRIR\u00c1 NOVAS POSSIBILIDADES PARA OFERECERMOS AOS USU\u00c1RIOS ACESSO AINDA MAIS R\u00c1PIDO AOS NOSSOS SERVI\u00c7OS E AS MELHORES EXPERI\u00caNCIAS DO SETOR, COM A OP\u00c7\u00c3O ADICIONAL DE ARMAZENAR DADOS NA SU\u00cd\u00c7A\". Os centros de dados s\u00e3o um elemento importante do ecossistema digital. O investimento da AWS na expans\u00e3o de seus centros de dados na \u00cdndia \u00e9 um desenvolvimento bem-vindo que ajudaria a catalisar a economia digital da \u00cdndia\", disse Shri Rajeev Chandrashekhar, ministro do estado para Eletr\u00f4nica e Tecnologia da Informa\u00e7\u00e3o e para o Desenvolvimento de Habilidades e Empreendedorismo. \"A pr\u00f3xima Pol\u00edtica Nacional de Nuvem e Data Center do governo da \u00cdndia prev\u00ea um aumento significativo na capacidade de computa\u00e7\u00e3o em nuvem da \u00cdndia dos atuais 565 MW para mais de 2565 MW em um futuro pr\u00f3ximo. T. Rama Rao, ministro de Tecnologia da Informa\u00e7\u00e3o (TI), Ind\u00fastrias e Com\u00e9rcio, Administra\u00e7\u00e3o Municipal, e Desenvolvimento Urbano do governo de Telangana. \"Reconhecemos o poder da computa\u00e7\u00e3o em nuvem, e \u00e9 por isso que colaboramos com a AWS para melhorar a governan\u00e7a eletr\u00f4nica, a sa\u00fade e as opera\u00e7\u00f5es municipais para beneficiar os cidad\u00e3os de Telangana. Com o lan\u00e7amento da regi\u00e3o AWS \u00c1sia-Pac\u00edfico (Hyderabad), a AWS agora tem 96 zonas de disponibilidade em 30 regi\u00f5es geogr\u00e1ficas, com planos anunciados para lan\u00e7ar mais 15 zonas de disponibilidade e mais cinco regi\u00f5es da AWS na Austr\u00e1lia, Canad\u00e1, Israel, Nova Zel\u00e2ndia e Tail\u00e2ndia. As regi\u00f5es da AWS s\u00e3o compostas por zonas de disponibilidade que colocam a infraestrutura em locais geogr\u00e1ficos separados e distintos. A regi\u00e3o AWS \u00c1sia-Pac\u00edfico (Hyderabad) consiste em tr\u00eas zonas de disponibilidade e se une \u00e0 j\u00e1 existente regi\u00e3o \u00c1sia-Pac\u00edfico (Mumbai) da AWS, que foi inaugurada em junho de 2016. As zonas de disponibilidade est\u00e3o localizadas a uma dist\u00e2ncia suficiente uma da outra para dar suporte \u00e0 continuidade dos neg\u00f3cios dos clientes e pr\u00f3ximas o suficiente para fornecer baixa lat\u00eancia para aplicativos de alta disponibilidade que usam v\u00e1rias zonas de disponibilidade. Cada zona de disponibilidade possui energia, resfriamento, e seguran\u00e7a f\u00edsica independentes e est\u00e1 conectada por redes redundantes de lat\u00eancia ultrabaixa. Os clientes da AWS focados em alta disponibilidade podem criar seus aplicativos para funcionar em m\u00faltiplas zonas de disponibilidade para alcan\u00e7ar uma toler\u00e2ncia de falha ainda maior. A regi\u00e3o AWS \u00c1sia Pac\u00edfico (Hyderabad) permitir\u00e1 que clientes locais com prefer\u00eancias de resid\u00eancia de dados armazenem dados com seguran\u00e7a na \u00cdndia, enquanto proporciona aos clientes uma lat\u00eancia ainda mais baixa no pa\u00eds. A AWS planeja investir cerca de US$ 4,4 bilh\u00f5es (aprox. INR 36.300 crores) na \u00cdndia at\u00e9 2030 atrav\u00e9s da nova regi\u00e3o AWS \u00c1sia-Pac\u00edfico (Hyderabad), que inclui despesas de capital na constru\u00e7\u00e3o de centros de dados, despesas operacionais relacionadas a servi\u00e7os p\u00fablicos e custos de instala\u00e7\u00e3o em andamento, e compras de bens e servi\u00e7os de empresas regionais. Estes empregos far\u00e3o parte da cadeia de fornecimento AWS na \u00cdndia, incluindo constru\u00e7\u00e3o, manuten\u00e7\u00e3o de instala\u00e7\u00f5es, engenharia, telecomunica\u00e7\u00f5es e empregos dentro da economia mais ampla do pa\u00eds.
